translation: James Murdock, The New Testament: A Literal Translation from the Syriac Peshito Version (1851)
displayRule: One English object spans each complete admitted Murdock unit; no word-level semantic subdivision is implied.

matthew 1:1.english: THE book of the nativity of Jesus the Messiah, the son of David, son of Abraham.

matthew 1:2.english: Abraham begat Isaac: Isaac begat Jacob: Jacob begat Judah and his brothers:

matthew 1:3.english: Judah begat Pharez and Zara of Tamar: Pharez begat Hezron: Hezron begat Ram:

matthew 1:4.english: Ram begat Aminadab: Aminadab begat Nahshon: Nahshon begat Salmon:

matthew 1:5.english: Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab: Boaz begat Obed of Ruth: Obed begat Jesse:

matthew 1:6.english: Jesse begat David the king: David begat Solomon of the wife of Uriah:

matthew 1:7.english: Solomon begat Rehoboam: Rehoboam begat Abia: Abia begat Asa:

matthew 1:8.english: Asa begat Jehoshaphat: Jehoshaphat begat Joram: Joram begat Uzziah:

matthew 1:9.english: Uzziah begat Jotham: Jotham begat Ahaz: Ahaz begat Hezekiah:

matthew 1:10.english: Hezekiah begat Manasseh: Manasseh begat Amon: Amon begat Josiah:

matthew 1:11.english: Josiah begat Jeconiah and his brothers, in the captivity of Babylon.

matthew 1:12.english: And after the captivity of Babylon, Jeconiah begat Salathiel: Salathiel begat Zerubbabel:

matthew 1:13.english: Zerubbabel begat Abiud: Abiud begat Eliakim: Eliakim begat Azor:

matthew 1:14.english: Azor begat Zadok: Zadok begat Achim: Achim begat Eliud:

matthew 1:15.english: Eliud begat Eleazar: Eleazar begat Matthan: Matthan begat Jacob:

matthew 1:16.english: Jacob begat Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus who is called the Messiah.

matthew 1:17.english: All the generations, therefore, are, from Abraham to David fourteen generations, and from David to the captivity of Babylon fourteen generations, and from the captivity of Babylon to the Messiah fourteen generations.

matthew 1:18.english: And the birth of Jesus the Messiah was thus. While his mother Mary was betrothed to Joseph, before they had cohabited, she was found to be with child by the Holy Spirit.

matthew 1:19.english: And Joseph her husband was a righteous man, and unwilling to expose her: and he thought of putting her away privately.

matthew 1:20.english: And while he contemplated these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, and said to him: Joseph, son of David, fear not to take Mary thy wife; for that which is conceived in her, is from the Holy Spirit:

matthew 1:21.english: and she will bear a son; and thou shalt call his name Jesus, for he will resuscitate his people from their sins.

matthew 1:22.english: Now all this that occurred, was to fulfill what was spoken of the Lord by the prophet:

matthew 1:23.english: Behold, a virgin will conceive, and will bear a son, and thou shalt call his name Emmanuel, which is interpreted, Our God with us.

matthew 1:24.english: And when Joseph rose from his sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife.

matthew 1:25.english: And he knew her not, until she had borne her firstborn son, and called is name Jesus.

matthew 2:1.english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea, in the days of Herod the king, there came Magi from the east unto Jerusalem,

matthew 2:2.english: saying: Where is the king of the Jews that is born? For we have seen his star in the east, and have come to worship him.

matthew 2:3.english: And Herod the king heard, and he was disturbed; and all Jerusalem with him.

matthew 2:4.english: And he assembled all the chiefs of the priests and the scribes of the people, and inquired of them, Where is the birthplace of the Messiah?

matthew 2:5.english: And they said: In Bethlehem of Judaea; for thus it is written in the prophet:

matthew 2:6.english: Thou also, Bethlehem of Judaea, art not the little among the kings of Judaea, for a king shall come from thee who shall rule my people Israel.

matthew 2:7.english: Then Herod privately called the Magi, and learned from them at what time the star appeared to them.

matthew 2:8.english: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said to them, Go, search diligently for the child; and when ye have found him, come and tell me, that I also may go and worship him.

matthew 2:9.english: And they, when they had heard from the king, went forward: and lo, the star they had seen in the east went before them, until it came and stood over where the child was.

matthew 2:10.english: And when they saw the star, they rejoiced much, with great joy.

matthew 2:11.english: And they entered the house; and they saw the child, with Mary his mother; and they fell down and worshipped him: and they opened their treasures, and presented to him gifts, gold, and myrrh, and frankincense.

matthew 2:12.english: And it was shown them in a dream, that they should not return to Herod. And by another way, they returned to their country.

matthew 2:13.english: And when they were gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, and said to him, Arise, take the child and his mother, and flee into Egypt; and be thou there, until I tell thee: for Herod will seek for the child, to destroy it.

matthew 2:14.english: Then Joseph arose, took the child and his mother, by night, and fled to Egypt.

matthew 2:15.english: And he was there, until the death of Herod; that so might be fulfilled that which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, From Egypt have I called my son.

matthew 2:16.english: Then Herod, when he saw that he had been deluded by the Magi, was very angry. And he sent and slew all the children in Bethlehem, and in all its confines, from a child of two years and under, according to the time that he had carefully learned from the Magi.

matthew 2:17.english: Then was that fulfilled, which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying:

matthew 2:18.english: A voice was heard in Rama, weeping and great lamentation; Rachel bemoaning her children, and unwilling to be comforted, because they are no more.

matthew 2:19.english: But when king Herod was dead, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

matthew 2:20.english: and said to him: Arise, take the child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel; for they are dead who sought the life of the child.

matthew 2:21.english: And Joseph arose, and took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel.

matthew 2:22.english: But when he heard that Archelaus was king in Judaea, instead of his father Herod, he feared to go thither. And it was revealed to him in a dream, that he should go into the land of Galilee.

matthew 2:23.english: And he came and dwelt in a city that is called Nazareth that so might be fulfilled that which was said by the prophet, that he should be called a Nazarene.

matthew 3:1.english: And in those days came John the Baptizer. And he proclaimed in the desert of Judaea,

matthew 3:2.english: and said: Repent; the kingdom of heaven hath approached.

matthew 3:3.english: For this is he of whom it was said, by Isaiah the prophet: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make smooth his paths.

matthew 3:4.english: And as to this John, his raiment was of camel's hair, and a girdle of skin was upon his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.

matthew 3:5.english: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the country about the Jordan.

matthew 3:6.english: And they were baptized by him in the river Jordan, while they confessed their sins.

matthew 3:7.english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees, who came to be baptized, he said to them: Generation of vipers, who hath taught you to flee from the wrath that cometh?

matthew 3:8.english: Bring forth the fruits therefore, that accord with repentance.

matthew 3:9.english: And do not think, and say within yourselves, that Abraham is our father: for I say to you, that God is able of these tones to raise up children to Abraham.

matthew 3:10.english: And lo, the ax is put to the root of trees. Every tree, therefore, which beareth not good fruit, is felled, and falleth into the fire.

matthew 3:11.english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance; but he that cometh after me is more powerful than I; whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

matthew 3:12.english: His winnowing shovel is in his hand; and he will make clean his threshing-floor. The wheat he will gather into his storehouse; and the chaff he will burn with fire not extinguished.

matthew 3:13.english: Then came Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan unto John, to be baptized by him.

matthew 3:14.english: But John refused him; and said, I need to be baptized by thee, and hast thou come to me?

matthew 3:15.english: And Jesus answered, and said to him: Allow it now, for thus it becometh us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he permitted him.

matthew 3:16.english: And when Jesus was baptized, he went up immediately from the water. And heaven was opened to him; and he saw the Holy Spirit descending like a dove, and it came upon him.

matthew 3:17.english: And lo, a voice from heaven, which said: This is my beloved Son, in whom I have delight.

matthew 4:1.english: Then was Jesus led by the Holy Spirit into the desert, to be tempted by the Calumniator

matthew 4:2.english: And he fasted forty days and forty nights, and afterward he hungered.

matthew 4:3.english: And the Tempter came, and said to him: If thou art the Son of God, command these stones to become bread.

matthew 4:4.english: But he replied, and said: It is written, that not by bread only, doth man live; but by every word proceeding from the mouth of God.

matthew 4:5.english: Then the Calumniator took him to the holy city, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple,

matthew 4:6.english: and said to him: If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, that he will give his angels charge of thee, and in their hands will they sustain thee, lest thou strike thy foot against a stone.

matthew 4:7.english: Jesus said to him: It is moreover written, that thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

matthew 4:8.english: Again the Calumniator took him to a mountain that was very high, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory;

matthew 4:9.english: and said to him: All these will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

matthew 4:10.english: Then Jesus said to him: Begone, Satan; for it is written, that thou shalt worship the Lord, thy God; and him only shalt thou serve.

matthew 4:11.english: Then the Calumniator left him: and lo, angels came, and ministered to him.

matthew 4:12.english: And when Jesus had heard that John was delivered up, he retired to Galilee.

matthew 4:13.english: And he left Nazareth, and came and dwelt in Capernaum, by the side of the sea, on the confines of Zebulon and Naphthali.

matthew 4:14.english: That so might be fulfilled that which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, who said:

matthew 4:15.english: The land of Zebulon, the land of Naphthali, the way of the sea, the ford of Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

matthew 4:16.english: the people that sat in darkness, have seen great light; and to them who sat in the region and shadow of death, light is arisen.

matthew 4:17.english: From that time began Jesus to proclaim and say: Repent; for the kingdom of heaven hath approached.

matthew 4:18.english: And as he walked on the shore of the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Cephas, and Andrew his brother, who were casting nets into the sea; for they were fishermen.

matthew 4:19.english: And Jesus said to them: Follow me; and I will cause you to become fishers of men.

matthew 4:20.english: And immediately, they left their nets, and went after him.

matthew 4:21.english: And as he passed on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, who were mending their nets. And Jesus called them.

matthew 4:22.english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and went after him.

matthew 4:23.english: And Jesus traveled over all Galilee. and he taught in their synagogues and proclaimed the tidings of the kingdom; and he cured every disease and malady among the people.

matthew 4:24.english: And his fame spread through all Syria. And they brought to him all them that were very sick with diverse diseases, and them that were afflicted with pains, and demoniacs, and lunatics and paralytics; and he healed them.

matthew 4:25.english: And there followed him great multitudes from Galilee, and from the Ten Cities, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond the Jordan.

matthew 5:1.english: And when Jesus saw the multitudes, he ascended a hill; and when he was seated, his disciples drew near him:

matthew 5:2.english: and he opened his mouth, and taught them, and said:

matthew 5:3.english: Blessed are the poor in spirit for the kingdom of heaven is theirs!

matthew 5:4.english: Blessed are the mourners: for they shall be comforted!

matthew 5:5.english: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth!

matthew 5:6.english: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst for righteousness: for they shall be satiated!

matthew 5:7.english: Blessed are the merciful: for on them shall be mercies!

matthew 5:8.english: Blessed are the clean in heart: for they shall behold God!

matthew 5:9.english: Blessed are the cultivators of peace: for they shall be called sons of God!

matthew 5:10.english: Blessed are they that are persecuted on account of righteousness: for the kingdom of heaven is theirs!

matthew 5:11.english: Blessed are ye, when they revile you and persecute you, and speak every evil thing against you, falsely, on my account.

matthew 5:12.english: At that time, rejoice and be glad: for your reward in heaven is great. For so they persecuted the prophets that were before you.

matthew 5:13.english: Ye are the salt of the earth! But if the salt become insipid, with what shall it be seasoned? It is fit for nothing; but to be thrown out, and be trodden under foot by men.

matthew 5:14.english: Ye are the light of the world! A city built upon a hill, not be concealed.

matthew 5:15.english: And they do not light a lamp and place it under a bushel; but upon a lightstand, and it giveth light to all that are in the house.

matthew 5:16.english: Let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works, and may glorify your Father who is in heaven.

matthew 5:17.english: Do not suppose that I have come to subvert the law or the prophets: I have come not to subvert, but to fulfill.

matthew 5:18.english: For verily I say to you, that until heaven and earth shall pass away, one iota or one letter shall not pass from the law, until all shall be fulfilled.

matthew 5:19.english: Therefore whoever shall break one of these small commands and shall so inculcate on the children of men, shall be called little in the kingdom of heaven: but every one that shall do and teach them, shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 5:20.english: For I say to you, that unless your righteousness shall abound more than that of the Scribes and Pharisees, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 5:21.english: Ye have heard that it was said to the ancients, Thou shalt not kill: and every one that killeth, is obnoxious to judgment.

matthew 5:22.english: But I say to you, That every one who is angry with his brother rashly, is obnoxious to judgment: and every one that saith to his brother, Raka! is obnoxious to the council and every one that shall say, Fool is obnoxious to hell-fire.

matthew 5:23.english: If therefore thou shalt bring thy oblation to the altar, and shalt there remember that thy brother hath any offence against thee,

matthew 5:24.english: leave there thy oblation before the altar, and go first and be reconciled with thy brother; and then come and present thy oblation.

matthew 5:25.english: Be at agreement with thy prosecutor, forthwith, and while on the way with him; lest the prosecutor deliver thee up to the judge, and the Judge deliver thee over to the sheriff, and thou fall into the house of prisoners.

matthew 5:26.english: Verily I say to thee, Thou wilt not come out from there until thou hast paid the last farthing.

matthew 5:27.english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt not commit adultery.

matthew 5:28.english: But I say to you, That whoever gazeth on a woman with concupiscence, at once committeth adultery with her in his heart.

matthew 5:29.english: If therefore thy right eye make thee offend, pluck it out, and cast it from thee; because it is better for thee that thy one member perish, than that thy whole body fall into hell.

matthew 5:30.english: And if thy right hand make thee offend, cut it off, and cast it from thee; because it is better for thee that one of thy members perish, than that thy whole body fall into hell.

matthew 5:31.english: It hath been said, That if a man will put away his wife, he must give her a writing of divorcement.

matthew 5:32.english: But I say to you, That whoever putteth away his wife, except for the offence of whoredom, causeth her to commit adultery: and he that taketh the divorced woman, committeth adultery.

matthew 5:33.english: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said to the ancients, Thou shalt not be false in thy oaths; but thou shalt perform thine oaths to the Lord.

matthew 5:34.english: But I say to you, Swear not at all: not by heaven, for it is the throne of God:

matthew 5:35.english: and not by the earth, for it is the footstool under his feet: and likewise not by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great king.

matthew 5:36.english: Moreover, thou shalt not swear by thy head, for thou canst not make one hair in it either black or white.

matthew 5:37.english: But let your language be, Yes, yes; or No, no; for whatever is beyond these proceedeth from evil.

matthew 5:38.english: Ye have heard that it hath been said: An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.

matthew 5:39.english: But I say to you: Resist not evil; but if a person smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

matthew 5:40.english: And if one is disposed to sue thee and get away thy coat, relinquish to him also thy cloak.

matthew 5:41.english: Whoever compelleth thee to go one mile, go with him two.

matthew 5:42.english: Whoever demandeth of thee, give to him: and whoever wisheth to borrow of thee, deny him not.

matthew 5:43.english: Ye have heard that it hath been said: Thou shalt love thy neighbor, and hate thy enemy.

matthew 5:44.english: But I say to you: Love your enemies; and bless him that curseth you; and do good to him that hateth you; and pray for them that lead you in bonds, and that persecute you:

matthew 5:45.english: that ye may be the children of your Father that is in heaven, who causeth his sun to rise upon the good and upon the bad, and sendeth his rain upon the righteous and upon the unrighteous.

matthew 5:46.english: For, if ye love them that love you, what reward have ye? Do not even the publicans do this?

matthew 5:47.english: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye that is not common? Do not even publicans do this?

matthew 5:48.english: Be ye therefore perfect; even as your Father who is in heaven is perfect.

matthew 6:1.english: Be cautious in your alms-giving, not to perform it before men, so that ye may be seen of them: otherwise, ye have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

matthew 6:2.english: Therefore, when thou doest alms thou shalt not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get praise from men. Verily I say to you, They have gotten their reward.

matthew 6:3.english: But thou, when doing alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

matthew 6:4.english: that thy alms may be in secret. And thy Father, who seeth in secret, will reward thee openly.

matthew 6:5.english: And when thou prayest. thou shalt not be like the hypocrites, who are fond of standing up in the synagogues and at the corners of streets to pray, so that they may be seen by people. Verily I say to you, they have gotten their reward.

matthew 6:6.english: But thou, when thou prayest enter into thy closet and close the door, and pray to thy Father who is in secret; and thy Father, who seeth in secret, will reward thee openly.

matthew 6:7.english: And when ye pray, be not garrulous like the heathen; for they expect to be heard for their abundance of words.

matthew 6:8.english: Therefore, be not like them; for your Father knoweth what is needful for you, before ye ask him.

matthew 6:9.english: In this manner, therefore, pray ye: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name:

matthew 6:10.english: Thy kingdom come: Thy will be done; as in heaven, so on earth:

matthew 6:11.english: Give us our needful bread, this day:

matthew 6:12.english: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors:

matthew 6:13.english: And bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever and ever: Amen.

matthew 6:14.english: For if ye forgive men their faults, your Father who is in heaven will also forgive you.

matthew 6:15.english: But if ye shall not forgive men, your Father also forgiveth not you your faults.

matthew 6:16.english: And when ye fast, be not sad like the hypocrites. For they distort their faces, that they may be seen of men to fast. Verily I say to you, they have gotten their reward.

matthew 6:17.english: But, when thou fastest, wash thou thy face, and anoint thy head:

matthew 6:18.english: that thou mayest not be seen by men as a faster, but by thy Father who is in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret, will recompense thee.

matthew 6:19.english: Lay not up for yourselves treasures on the earth, where moth and rust spoil, and where thieves dig through and steal.

matthew 6:20.english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where no moth and no rust can spoil, and no thieves dig through nor steal.

matthew 6:21.english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart also be.

matthew 6:22.english: The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore thy eye shall be sound, thy whole body will be luminous.

matthew 6:23.english: But if thy eye shall be diseased, thy whole body will be dark. If then the light that is in thee be darkness, how great will be thy darkness!

matthew 6:24.english: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will honor the one and neglect the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

matthew 6:25.english: Therefore I say to you: Be not anxious about your life, what ye shall eat, and what ye shall drink; nor about your body, how ye shall clothe yourselves. Is not the life more important than food, and the body than raiment?

matthew 6:26.english: Look at the birds of heaven; which sow not, and reap not, and gather not into storehouses, but your Father who is in heaven feedeth them. Are not ye more important than they?

matthew 6:27.english: And who of you that shall be anxious, can add to his stature a cubit?

matthew 6:28.english: And about raiment, why are ye anxious? Consider the lilies of the desert, in what manner they grow. They toil not; and they spin not.

matthew 6:29.english: Yet I say to you, that not even Solomon in all his glory, was arrayed like one of them.

matthew 6:30.english: And if God so clothe the grass of the field, which exists to-day, and tomorrow falls into the oven, will he not much more clothe you, ye small in faith?

matthew 6:31.english: Therefore be not anxious; nor say, What shall we eat, or what shall we drink; or wherewith be clothed?

matthew 6:32.english: For, all these things the people of the world seek after. And your Father, who is in heaven, knoweth that all these things are needful to you.

matthew 6:33.english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness: and all these things shall be added to you.

matthew 6:34.english: Therefore be not anxious about the morrow: for the morrow hath its own anxieties. Sufficient for the day, is its own evil.

matthew 7:1.english: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

matthew 7:2.english: For with the judgment that ye judge, ye shall be judged; and by the measure that ye measure, shall it be measured to you.

matthew 7:3.english: And why observest thou the straw in thy brother's eye, and regardest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

matthew 7:4.english: Or how canst thou say to thy brother, Allow me to pluck the straw from thy eye; and lo! a beam is in thy own eye.

matthew 7:5.english: Thou hypocrite; pluck first the beam from thy own eye; and then thou wilt see clearly, to pluck the straw out of thy brother's eye.

matthew 7:6.english: Give not a holy thing to dogs: and cast not your pearls before swine; lest they tread them under their feet, and turn and lacerate you.

matthew 7:7.english: Ask, and it shall be given to you: seek, and ye shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.

matthew 7:8.english: For, every one that asketh, receiveth: and he that seeketh, findeth: and to him that knocketh, it shall be opened.

matthew 7:9.english: For what man is there among you, of whom if his son ask bread, will he reach him a stone?

matthew 7:10.english: Or if he ask of him a fish, will he reach him a serpent?

matthew 7:11.english: If ye then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

matthew 7:12.english: Whatsoever ye would that men should do to you; so also do ye to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

matthew 7:13.english: Enter ye in by the strait gate; for wide is the gate and broad the way which leadeth to destruction; and many are they that walk in it.

matthew 7:14.english: How small the gate and straitened the way that leadeth to life, and few they who find it!

matthew 7:15.english: Beware of false prophets; who come to you in the garb of sheep, but internally they are rapacious wolves.

matthew 7:16.english: And from their fruits ye shall know them. Do men gather grapes from thorn bushes; or figs from thistles?

matthew 7:17.english: So every good tree beareth good fruits; but a bad tree beareth bad fruits.

matthew 7:18.english: A good tree cannot bear bad fruits; nor can a bad tree bear good fruits.

matthew 7:19.english: Every tree that beareth not good fruits, is cut down and consigned to the fire.

matthew 7:20.english: Wherefore, by their fruits ye shall know them.

matthew 7:21.english: Not whoever may say to me, My Lord, my Lord, will enter into the kingdom of heaven: but he that doeth the will of my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 7:22.english: Many will say to me in that day, My Lord, my Lord, have-we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name cast out demons? and in thy name wrought many works of power?

matthew 7:23.english: And then will I declare to them; I never knew you. Depart from me, ye doers of evil.

matthew 7:24.english: Every one therefore that heareth these my discourses, and doeth them, will be like to a wise man, one that built his house upon a rock.

matthew 7:25.english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew; and they rushed upon that house; and it fell not, for its foundations were laid upon a rock.

matthew 7:26.english: And every one that heareth these my discourses, and doeth them not, will be like a foolish man that built his house upon sand.

matthew 7:27.english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew; and they rushed upon that house, and it fell; and great was the ruin of it.

matthew 7:28.english: And so it was, that when Jesus had ended these discourses, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching:

matthew 7:29.english: for he taught them as one having authority; and not as their Scribes and Pharisees.

matthew 8:1.english: And as he descended from the mountain, great multitudes gathered around him.

matthew 8:2.english: And behold, a leper came and worshipped him, and said: My Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

matthew 8:3.english: And Jesus stretched forth his hand, touched him, and said: I will: be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

matthew 8:4.english: And Jesus said to him, See, thou tell no man: but go, show thyself to the priests, and present an oblation as Moses enjoined, for a testimony to them.

matthew 8:5.english: And when Jesus had entered into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, and besought him,

matthew 8:6.english: and said: My Lord, my child lieth at home an is paralytic, and badly afflicted.

matthew 8:7.english: Jesus said to him, I will come and heal him.

matthew 8:8.english: The centurion replied, and said: My Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldst come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my child will be healed.

matthew 8:9.english: For I also am a man under authority, and there are soldiers under my hands, and I say to this one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this thing, and he doeth it.

matthew 8:10.english: And when Jesus heard this, he admired it; and he said to those walking with him, Verily I say to you, I have not found faith like this even in Israel.

matthew 8:11.english: And I say to you, that many shall come from the east, and from the west, and shall recline with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven;

matthew 8:12.english: but the children of the kingdom shall go forth into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 8:13.english: And Jesus said to the centurion. Go; be it to thee as thou hast believed. And his child was cured in that same hour.

matthew 8:14.english: And Jesus came to the house of Simon and saw his wife's mother prostrate, confined by a fever.

matthew 8:15.english: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose and ministered to them.

matthew 8:16.english: And when it was evening, they brought many demoniacs before him; and he expelled their demons by a word, and healed all them that were diseased:

matthew 8:17.english: that so might be fulfilled that which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, who said: He will bear our sorrows, and our infirmities he will take upon him.

matthew 8:18.english: And when Jesus saw great multitudes, around him, he ordered that they should go to the site shore.

matthew 8:19.english: And a Scribe came and said to him: Rabbi, I will follow thee to the place whither thou goest.

matthew 8:20.english: Jesus said to him, For foxes there are holes, and for the birds of heaven there are nests; but for the Son of man, there is not where he may recline his head.

matthew 8:21.english: And another of his disciples said to him: My Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

matthew 8:22.english: But Jesus said to him: Follow thou me, and leave the dead to bury their dead.

matthew 8:23.english: And when Jesus entered the ship, his disciples embarked with him.

matthew 8:24.english: And lo, a great commotion arose in the sea, so that the vessel was covered by the waves. But Jesus was asleep:

matthew 8:25.english: and his disciples came to awake him, and said to him: Our Lord, deliver us; we are perishing!

matthew 8:26.english: Jesus said to them, Why are ye afraid, ye small in faith! Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the sea; and there was great tranquillity.

matthew 8:27.english: And the men were amazed; and they said, What a man is this, to whom the winds and the sea are obedient!

matthew 8:28.english: And when Jesus arrived at the farther shore, in the country of the Gadarenes, there met him two demoniacs, who came out from the sepulchres, very furious, so that no one could pass that way.

matthew 8:29.english: And they cried out, and said: What have we to do with thee? Jesus, thou Son of God. Hast thou come hither before the time to torment us?

matthew 8:30.english: And at a distance from them there was a herd of many swine feeding

matthew 8:31.english: And the demons entreated of him, and said: If thou cast us out, suffer us to go into the herd of swine.

matthew 8:32.english: And Jesus said to them, Go ye. And immediately they came out, and entered into the swine; and that whole herd ran straight to a precipice and plunged into the sea, and perished in the waters.

matthew 8:33.english: And the herdsmen fled, and entered the city, and related all that had occurred, and concerning the demoniacs.

matthew 8:34.english: And all the city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him to retire from their coasts.

matthew 9:1.english: And he entered the ship, and passed over and came to his own city.

matthew 9:2.english: And they brought to him a paralytic, lying on a bed. And Jesus saw their faith, and said to the paralytic: Take courage, my son; thy sins are forgiven thee.

matthew 9:3.english: And some of the Scribes said in their minds, This man blasphemeth.

matthew 9:4.english: But Jesus knew their thoughts: and he said to them, Why do ye think evil things in your heart?

matthew 9:5.english: For, which is the easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven thee; or to say, Arise and walk?

matthew 9:6.english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath authority on earth to forgive sins, he said to the paralytic: Arise, take up thy bed, and go to thy home.

matthew 9:7.english: And he arose and went to his home.

matthew 9:8.english: And when the multitudes saw it, they were struck with awe; and they praised God, who had given authority like this to men.

matthew 9:9.english: And as Jesus passed on from there, he saw a man sitting at the custom-house, whose name was Matthew. And he said to him, Follow me: and he arose and followed him.

matthew 9:10.english: And as they were reclining in a house, many publicans an sinners came and reclined with Jesus and his disciples.

matthew 9:11.english: And when the Pharisees saw it they said to his disciples, Why doth your Rabbi eat with publicans and sinners?

matthew 9:12.english: And as Jesus heard it, he said to them: They who are in health have no need of a physician, but they that are very sick.

matthew 9:13.english: Go and learn what that is: I require compassion, and not a sacrifice! For I did not come to call the righteous, but the sinful.

matthew 9:14.english: Then came to him the disciples of John, and said: Why do we and the Pharisees fast much and thy disciples fast not?

matthew 9:15.english: Jesus said to them: Can the children of the nuptial chamber fast, so long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and then they will fast.

matthew 9:16.english: No one inserteth a piece of new cloth on an old garment; lest that which filleth up, tear from that garment, and the rent become greater.

matthew 9:17.english: And they do not put new wine into old sacks; lest the sacks burst, and the wine run out, and the sacks perish. But they put new wine into new sacks and they are both preserved.

matthew 9:18.english: And while he was thus discoursing with them a certain ruler came, drew near, worshipped him and said: My daughter is already dead, but come lay thy hand upon her, and she will live.

matthew 9:19.english: And Jesus rose up, and his disciples; and they followed him.

matthew 9:20.english: And behold, a woman whose blood had flowed fourteen years, came up behind him, and touched the extremity of his robe:

matthew 9:21.english: for she had said in her mind, If I but touch his garment I shall be cured.

matthew 9:22.english: And Jesus turned himself, looked at her, and said to her: Take courage, my daughter; thy faith hath given thee life. And the woman was cured from that very hour.

matthew 9:23.english: And Jesus came to the house of the ruler: and he saw there pipers, and multitudes making outcry.

matthew 9:24.english: And he said to them: Retire; for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they scoffed at him.

matthew 9:25.english: And when he had ejected the throngs, he entered in, and took her by the hand, and the maid rose up.

matthew 9:26.english: And the fame of this thing spread in all that land.

matthew 9:27.english: And when Jesus had passed from there, two blind men followed after him, and said: Have mercy on us, Thou Son of David!

matthew 9:28.english: And when he had entered a house, those blind men approached him, and Jesus said to them: Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said to him, Yes, our Lord.

matthew 9:29.english: Then he touched their eyes, and said: As ye have believed, so shall it be to you.

matthew 9:30.english: And forthwith their eyes were opened. And Jesus charged them and said: See, that no man know of it.

matthew 9:31.english: But they went out and spread the fame of it in all that land.

matthew 9:32.english: And as Jesus went out, they brought to him a dumb man in whom was a demon.

matthew 9:33.english: And when the demon had gone out, the dumb man conversed. And the multitudes admired, and said: Never was it so seen in Israel!

matthew 9:34.english: But the Pharisees said: It is by the Prince of demons, he casteth out demons.

matthew 9:35.english: And Jesus traveled over all the cities and the villages: and he taught in their synagogues, and proclaimed the tidings of the kingdom, and healed all diseases and all pains.

matthew 9:36.english: And when Jesus looked on the multitudes, he pitied them; because they were wearied and dispersed, like sheep that have no shepherd.

matthew 9:37.english: And he said to his disciples, The harvest is great, and the laborers few.

matthew 9:38.english: Entreat, therefore, of the Lord of the harvest, that he would send laborers into his harvest.

matthew 10:1.english: And he called his twelve disciples to him, and gave them authority over unclean spirits to cast them out, and to heal every pain and disease.

matthew 10:2.english: And the names of those twelve Legates are these: The first of them, Simon who is called Cephas, and Andrew his brother; and James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

matthew 10:3.english: and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Thomas, and Matthew the publican; and James the son of Alpheus, and Lebbeus who was called Thaddeus;

matthew 10:4.english: and Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, he who betrayed him.

matthew 10:5.english: These twelve Jesus sent forth: and he commanded them and said: Go not in the way of the Gentiles: and enter not the cities of the Samaritans.

matthew 10:6.english: But, go ye rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

matthew 10:7.english: And as ye go, proclaim and say: The kingdom of heaven hath approached.

matthew 10:8.english: Heal ye the sick; cleanse the leprous; raise the dead; and cast out demons. Freely ye have received; freely give.

matthew 10:9.english: Provide not gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses;

matthew 10:10.english: nor a wallet for the journey: neither two coats, nor shoes, nor a staff. For the laborer is worthy of his food.

matthew 10:11.english: And into whatever city or town ye enter, inquire, who in it is worthy; and there stay until ye depart.

matthew 10:12.english: And when ye enter a house, salute the household.

matthew 10:13.english: And if the house be worthy, your peace will come upon it; but if it be not worthy, your peace will return upon yourselves.

matthew 10:14.english: And whoever will not receive you, nor hear your discourses, when ye depart from that house or that town, shake off the dust from your feet.

matthew 10:15.english: Verily I say to you, that it will be comfortable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment, rather than for that city.

matthew 10:16.english: Behold, I send you forth as sheep among wolves. Therefore be ye sagacious as serpents, and guileless as doves.

matthew 10:17.english: And beware of men; for they will deliver you over to the tribunals, and will scourge you in their synagogues.

matthew 10:18.english: And they will bring you before governors and kings, on my account, for a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.

matthew 10:19.english: And when they deliver you up, be not anxious how or what ye shall speak; for it shall be given you in that hour what to say.

matthew 10:20.english: For it is not ye that speak, but the spirit of your Father speaking in you.

matthew 10:21.english: And brother shall deliver up his brother to death, and a father his son; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to die.

matthew 10:22.english: And ye shall be hated by every one, on account of my name. But he that shall endure to the end, shall have life.

matthew 10:23.english: And when they persecute you in one city, flee to another: for verily I say to you, Ye shall not have completed all the cities of the house of Israel, till the Son of man shall come.

matthew 10:24.english: No disciple is better than his rabbi; nor a servant, than his lord.

matthew 10:25.english: It is sufficient for the disciple, that he be as his rabbi; and the servant, as his lord. If they call the lord of the house Beelzebub, how much more the children of his family?

matthew 10:26.english: Therefore be not afraid of them; for there is nothing covered up, that shall not be exposed; nor concealed, that shall not become known.

matthew 10:27.english: Whatever I say to you in the dark, that speak ye in the light; and what ye have heard in your ears, proclaim ye on the housetops.

matthew 10:28.english: And be not afraid of them that kill the body, but cannot kill the soul; but be afraid rather of Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

matthew 10:29.english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? Yet one of them doth not fall to the ground without your Father.

matthew 10:30.english: As for you, even the hairs of your head are all numbered.

matthew 10:31.english: Therefore be not afraid: ye are more important than many sparrows.

matthew 10:32.english: Wherefore, whoever shall confess me before men, him will I also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 10:33.english: But whoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 10:34.english: Think not that I have come to sow quietness on the earth: I have not come to sow quietness, but conflict.

matthew 10:35.english: For I have come to set a man against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

matthew 10:36.english: And a man's foes will be the members of his household.

matthew 10:37.english: He that loveth father or mother more than me, is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me, is not worthy of me:

matthew 10:38.english: and he that doth not bear his cross and follow after me, is not worthy of me.

matthew 10:39.english: He that preserveth his life, shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake, shall preserve it.

matthew 10:40.english: He that entertaineth you, entertaineth me: and he that entertaineth me, entertaineth him that sent me.

matthew 10:41.english: He that entertaineth a prophet in the name of a prophet, shall receive a prophet's reward: and he that entertaineth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man, shall receive a righteous man's reward.

matthew 10:42.english: And whoever shall give one of these little ones to drink a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, verily I say to you, he shall not lose his reward.

matthew 11:1.english: And when Jesus had ended the instructions to his twelve disciples, he went from there, to teach and to proclaim in their cities.

matthew 11:2.english: Now when John, in the house of prisoners, heard of the works of Messiah, he sent by the hand of his disciples,

matthew 11:3.english: and said to him: Art thou he that cometh, or are we to expect another?

matthew 11:4.english: Jesus answered, and said to them: Go, tell John the things that ye hear and see:

matthew 11:5.english: the blind see, and the lame walk, and the leprous are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead rise up, and the needy hear good tidings:

matthew 11:6.english: and happy is he, who shall not be stumbled at me.

matthew 11:7.english: And when they were gone, Jesus began to say to the multitudes, concerning John: What went ye into the wilderness to see? A reed that waved in the wind?

matthew 11:8.english: And if not; what went ye out to see? A man clothed in delicate robes? Lo, they that are clothed in delicate robes, are in the dwelling of kings.

matthew 11:9.english: And if not; what went ye out to see? A prophet? Yes, say I to you, and more than a prophet.

matthew 11:10.english: For this is he of whom it is written: Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, that he may prepare the way before thee.

matthew 11:11.english: Verily I say to you, Among those born of women, there hath not arisen a greater than John the Baptizer: yet the small one in the kingdom of heaven, is greater than he.

matthew 11:12.english: And from the days of John the Baptizer, until now, the kingdom of heaven is assailed by force, and the violent seize it.

matthew 11:13.english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied, until the time of John.

matthew 11:14.english: And, if ye are willing, receive ye, that this is he who was to come.

matthew 11:15.english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear!

matthew 11:16.english: But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like to children, that sit in the marketplace and call to their associates,

matthew 11:17.english: and say: We have sung to you, and ye did not dance: we have wailed to you, and ye did not lament.

matthew 11:18.english: For John came, not eating and not drinking; and they said, He hath a demon.

matthew 11:19.english: The Son of man came, eating and drinking; and they say: Behold, a gluttonous man, and a wine drinker, and a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified by her works.

matthew 11:20.english: Then began Jesus to reproach the cities, in which his many deeds of power were wrought, yet they repented not.

matthew 11:21.english: And he said: Woe to thee, Chorazin! Woe to thee, Bethsaida! For if the deeds of power done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, doubtless, they would long ago have repented in sackcloth and ashes.

matthew 11:22.english: But I say to you, It will be comfortable for Tyre and Sidon, in the day of judgment, rather than for you.

matthew 11:23.english: And thou, Capernaum, which hast been lifted up to heaven, shalt be brought down to the grave. For if those deeds of power which were done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have stood to this day.

matthew 11:24.english: But I say to thee, It will be comfortable for the land of Sodom, in the day of judgment, rather than for thee.

matthew 11:25.english: At that time Jesus answered and said: I praise thee, O my Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and knowing, and hast revealed them to little children.

matthew 11:26.english: Yes, my Father; for so it seemed good before thee.

matthew 11:27.english: Every thing is given up by my Father to me. And no one knoweth the Son, except the Father. Also, no one knoweth the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son is pleased to reveal him.

matthew 11:28.english: Come unto me, all ye wearied and heavily burdened, and I will ease you.

matthew 11:29.english: Take my yoke upon you; and learn from me, that I am gentle and subdued in my heart: and ye will find rest for your souls:

matthew 11:30.english: for my yoke is pleasant, and my burden is light.

matthew 12:1.english: At that time Jesus, on the sabbath, walked in the tillage grounds: and his disciples were hungry, and began to pluck the ears and to eat.

matthew 12:2.english: And when the Pharisees saw them, they said to him: See; thy disciples are doing that which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath.

matthew 12:3.english: But he said to them, Have ye not read what David did when he was hungry, and they that were with him?

matthew 12:4.english: How he went to the house of God, and ate the bread of the Lord's table; which it was not lawful for him to eat, nor for them that were with him, but solely for the priests?

matthew 12:5.english: Or have ye not read in the law, how that in the temple the priests profane the sabbath, and are without fault?

matthew 12:6.english: But I say to you, that a greater than the temple is here.

matthew 12:7.english: And if ye had known what that is, I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; ye would not have criminated them who are without fault.

matthew 12:8.english: For the Son of man, is lord of the sabbath.

matthew 12:9.english: And Jesus went from there, and came to their synagogue.

matthew 12:10.english: And a man was there, whose hand was withered. And they questioned him and said, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath? that they might defame him.

matthew 12:11.english: And he said to them, What man among you is there, who, if he have a sheep, and it fall into a pit on the day of the sabbath, doth not lay hold of it and lift it out?

matthew 12:12.english: Now, how much better is a human being than a sheep! Wherefore it is lawful to do what is good, on the sabbath.

matthew 12:13.english: Then said he to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched out his hand; and it was restored, and like the other.

matthew 12:14.english: And the Pharisees went out and held a consultation against him, that they might destroy him.

matthew 12:15.english: But Jesus knew it; and he retired from there. And great multitudes followed him: and he cured them all.

matthew 12:16.english: And he charged them not to make him known:

matthew 12:17.english: that what was spoken by the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled, saying:

matthew 12:18.english: Behold my servant, in whom I have complacency; my beloved, in whom my soul delighteth. I will put my spirit upon him; and he shall proclaim judgment to the Gentiles.

matthew 12:19.english: He shall not contend, nor be clamorous, nor shall any one hear his voice in the market-place.

matthew 12:20.english: The crushed reed he will not break; and the flickering lamp he will not extinguish; until he bring judgment to be victorious.

matthew 12:21.english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

matthew 12:22.english: Then they brought to him a demoniac that was dumb and blind; and he healed him, so that the dumb and blind man both talked and saw.

matthew 12:23.english: And all the multitude were amazed, and said: Is not this the son of David?

matthew 12:24.english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said: This man doth not cast out demons, except by Beelzebub the prince of demons.

matthew 12:25.english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them: Every kingdom that is divided against itself, will become desolate; and every house or city which is divided against itself, will not stand.

matthew 12:26.english: Now if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how then doth his kingdom stand?

matthew 12:27.english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Wherefore they will be your judges.

matthew 12:28.english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, the kingdom of God hath come near to you.

matthew 12:29.english: Or how can one enter the house of a strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? and then he may plunder his house.

matthew 12:30.english: He that is not with me, is against me; and he that gathereth not with me actually scattereth.

matthew 12:31.english: Therefore I say to you, that all sins and contumelies shall be forgiven to men; but the contumely which is against the Spirit, shall not be forgiven to men.

matthew 12:32.english: And whoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it will be forgiven him: but whoever shall speak against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him;not in this world, and not in the world to come.

matthew 12:33.english: Either make the tree good, and its fruits good; or make the tree bad, and its fruits bad: for a tree is known by its fruits.

matthew 12:34.english: Offspring of vipers, how can ye who are evil, speak good things? For out of the fullnesses of the heart the mouth speaketh.

matthew 12:35.english: A good man out of good treasures bringeth forth good things, and a bad man out of bad treasures bringeth forth bad things.

matthew 12:36.english: For I say to you, That for every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account of it in the day of judgment.

matthew 12:37.english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified; and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

matthew 12:38.english: Then answered some of the Scribes and of the Pharisees, and said to him: Teacher, we wish to see from thee a sign.

matthew 12:39.english: But he replied and said to them: A wicked and adulterous generation demandeth a sign: but a sign will not be given to it, unless it be the sign of Jonah the prophet.

matthew 12:40.english: For as Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights; so will the Son of man be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.

matthew 12:41.english: The people of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment against this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and lo, a greater than Jonah is here.

matthew 12:42.english: The queen of the south will stand up in the judgment against this generation, and will condemn it: for she came from the extremities of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and lo, a superior to Solomon is here.

matthew 12:43.english: And when an unclean spirit goeth out of a man, it wandereth in places where is no water, and seeketh comfort and findeth it not.

matthew 12:44.english: Then it saith: I will return to my house, from which I came out. And it cometh, and findeth it vacated, and swept clean, and set in order.

matthew 12:45.english: So it goeth and taketh with it seven other spirits, worse than itself, and they enter and dwell in it; and the end of that man is worse than his beginning. So will it be to this evil generation.

matthew 12:46.english: And while he was discoursing to the multitudes, his mother and his brothers came and stood with out, and sought to speak with him.

matthew 12:47.english: And a person said to him: Lo, thy mother and thy brothers stand without, and seek to speak with thee.

matthew 12:48.english: But he replied, and said to him that informed him: Who is my mother? and who are my brothers?

matthew 12:49.english: And he stretched forth his hand towards his disciples, and said: Behold my mother, and behold my brothers!

matthew 12:50.english: For every one that doeth the good pleasure of my Father who is in heaven, that person is my brother, and my sister, and my mother.

matthew 13:1.english: And on that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the side of the sea.

matthew 13:2.english: And great multitudes assembled around him; so that he embarked and seated himself in a ship, and all the multitude stood on the shore of the sea.

matthew 13:3.english: An he discoursed with them much, by similitudes. And he said, Behold, a sower went forth to sow.

matthew 13:4.english: And as he sowed, some seed fell upon the side of a path: and a bird came and devoured it.

matthew 13:5.english: And other seed fell upon a rock, so that it had not much soil: and it sprung up forthwith, because there was no depth of earth.

matthew 13:6.english: But when the sun was up it wilted. And, because it lacked root, it dried up.

matthew 13:7.english: And other seed fell among thorns: and the thorns shot up, and choked it.

matthew 13:8.english: And other seed fell on good ground; and bore fruits, some a hundredfold, some sixtyfold, and some thirtyfold.

matthew 13:9.english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

matthew 13:10.english: And his disciples came and said to him, Why discoursest thou to them in similitudes?

matthew 13:11.english: And he answered, and said to them: Because, to you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

matthew 13:12.english: For to him that hath, shall be given; and he shall abound: but from him that hath not, even what he hath shall be taken from him.

matthew 13:13.english: For this cause I discourse to them in similitudes, because they see and do not see, and they hear and do not hear, nor understand.

matthew 13:14.english: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, who said: By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and by seeing ye see, and shall not know:

matthew 13:15.english: For the heart of this people hath grown fat, and with their ears they have heard heavily, and their eyes they have closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and should hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should turn; and I should heal them.

matthew 13:16.english: But happy are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

matthew 13:17.english: For verily I say to you, That many prophets and righteous men longed to see what ye see, and did not see it; and to hear what ye hear, and did not hear it.

matthew 13:18.english: But hear ye the similitude of the seed.

matthew 13:19.english: Every one that heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, the evil one cometh and snatcheth away the seed sowed in his heart: this is what was sowed by the side of the path.

matthew 13:20.english: And that which was sowed on the rock, is he that heareth the word, and at once receiveth it with joy.

matthew 13:21.english: Yet hath he no root in him, but is of short duration, and when there is trouble or persecution on account of the word, he soon stumbleth.

matthew 13:22.english: And that which was sowed among thorns, is he that heareth the word; and care for this world and the deceptiveness of riches, choke the word; and he is without fruits.

matthew 13:23.english: But that which was sowed on good ground, is he that heareth my word, and understandeth. and beareth fruits, and yieldeth, some a hundredfold, some sixtyfold, and some thirtyfold.

matthew 13:24.english: Another similitude he proposed to them, and said: The kingdom of heaven is like to a man who sowed good seed in his field.

matthew 13:25.english: And while people were asleep, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went away.

matthew 13:26.english: And when the plant shot up and bore fruits, then appeared also the tares.

matthew 13:27.english: And the servants of the householder came, and said to him, Our lord, didst thou not sow good seed in thy field? From whence are the tares in it.

matthew 13:28.english: And he said to them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said to him, Is it thy pleasure that we go and gather them out?

matthew 13:29.english: And he said to them, No, lest, while ye gather out the tares, ye also eradicate the wheat with them.

matthew 13:30.english: Let them both grow together until the harvest; and at the time of harvest, I will say to the reapers, Gather out first the tares, and bind them in bundles to be burned; but the wheat gather ye into my granary.

matthew 13:31.english: Another similitude proposed he to them, and said: The kingdom of heaven is like to a kernel of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.

matthew 13:32.english: And this is the least of all seeds; but when it is grown, it is greater than all the herbs, and becometh a tree, so that a bird of heaven may come and nestle in its branches.

matthew 13:33.english: Another similitude spake he to them, The kingdom of heaven is like the leaven, which a woman took and buried in three measures of meal, until the whole fermented.

matthew 13:34.english: All these things Jesus discoursed to the multitude in similitudes; and without similitudes he did not discourse with them.

matthew 13:35.english: That so might be fulfilled that which was spoken by the prophet, who said: I will open my mouth in similitudes; I will utter things concealed from before the foundation of the world.

matthew 13:36.english: Then Jesus sent away the multitudes, and went into the house. And his disciples came to him, and said: Explain to us the similitude of the tares and the field.

matthew 13:37.english: And he answered, and said to them: He that soweth the good seed, is the Son of God.

matthew 13:38.english: And the field is the world. And the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked One.

matthew 13:39.english: The enemy that sowed them, is Satan. The harvest is the end of the world and the reapers are the angels.

matthew 13:40.english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so will it be in the end of the world.

matthew 13:41.english: The Son of man will send forth his angels, and they will gather out of his kingdom all the stumbling blocks, and all the doers of evil;

matthew 13:42.english: and will cast them into a furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 13:43.english: Then will the righteous shine as the sun, in the kingdom of their Father. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

matthew 13:44.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a treasure that is hid in a field; which when a man findeth, he concealeth it, and, from his joy, he goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

matthew 13:45.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchantman, who sought after rich pearls:

matthew 13:46.english: and when he found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

matthew 13:47.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a sweep net, which was cast into the sea, and collected fishes of every kind.

matthew 13:48.english: And when it was full, they drew it to the shores of the sea; and they sat down and culled over: and the good they put into vessels, and the bad they cast away.

matthew 13:49.english: So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will go forth, and will sever the wicked from among the just;

matthew 13:50.english: and will cast them into a furnace of fire. There will be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 13:51.english: Jesus said to them: Have ye understood all these things? They say to him: Yes, our Lord.

matthew 13:52.english: He said to them: Therefore every Scribe who is instructed for the kingdom of heaven, is like a man who is master of a house, who bringeth forth from his treasures things new and old.

matthew 13:53.english: And it was so, that when Jesus had ended these similitudes, he departed thence.

matthew 13:54.english: And he entered into his own city. And he taught them in their synagogues, in such manner that they wondered, and said: Whence hath he this wisdom and these works of power?

matthew 13:55.english: Is not this man the carpenter's son? Is not his mother called Mary, and his brothers James and Joses and Simon and Judas?

matthew 13:56.english: And all his sisters, are they not with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

matthew 13:57.english: And they were stumbled at him. But Jesus said to them: There is no prophet who is little, except in his own city and in his own house.

matthew 13:58.english: And he did not perform there many works of power, because of their unbelief.

matthew 14:1.english: And at that time Herod the Tetrarch heard the fame of Jesus:

matthew 14:2.english: and he said to his servants: This is John the Baptizer: he is risen from the grave: therefore works of power are wrought by him.

matthew 14:3.english: Now this Herod had seized John, and bound him and cast him into prison; on account of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip.

matthew 14:4.english: For John had said to him: It is no lawful for her to be thy wife.

matthew 14:5.english: And he had wished to kill him; but he was afraid of the people, seeing that they regarded him as a prophet.

matthew 14:6.english: But when Herod's birthday festival occurred, the daughter of Herodias danced before the guests; and she pleased Herod.

matthew 14:7.english: Therefore he swore to her by an oath, that he would give her whatsoever she might ask.

matthew 14:8.english: And she, as she had been instructed by her mother, said: Give me here in a dish the head of John the Baptizer.

matthew 14:9.english: And it troubled the king: nevertheless, on account of the oath, and the guests, he commanded that it should be given her.

matthew 14:10.english: And he sent and cut off the head of John in the prison.

matthew 14:11.english: And the head was brought in a dish and given to the girl; and she brought it to her mother.

matthew 14:12.english: And his disciples came and bore away the corpse, and buried it; and they went and informed Jesus.

matthew 14:13.english: And Jesus, when he had heard it, retired alone, in a ship, to a desert place. And when the multitudes heard of it, they followed him by dry land from the cities.

matthew 14:14.english: And when Jesus disembarked, he saw great multitudes; and he had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

matthew 14:15.english: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, and said to him: This is a desert place, and the time is gone; send away the throngs of people, that they may go to the villages, and buy themselves food.

matthew 14:16.english: But he said to them: It is not necessary for them to go; give ye them to eat.

matthew 14:17.english: And they said to him: We have nothing here but five cakes and two fishes.

matthew 14:18.english: Jesus said to them: Bring them here to me.

matthew 14:19.english: And he commanded the multitudes to recline on the ground: and he took the five cakes and two fishes, and he looked towards heaven, and blessed, and brake, and gave to his disciples; and the disciples placed before the multitudes.

matthew 14:20.english: And they all ate, and were satisfied and they took up the broken remains, twelve full baskets.

matthew 14:21.english: And the men who had eaten were five thousand, besides the women and children.

matthew 14:22.english: And immediately he constrained his disciples to embark in a ship, and to go before him to the other side, while he sent away the multitudes.

matthew 14:23.english: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he ascended a mountain alone to pray. And when it was dark, he was there alone.

matthew 14:24.english: And the ship was distant from land many furlongs: meanwhile it was much tossed by the waves; for the wind was adverse to it.

matthew 14:25.english: And in the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came up to them, walking upon the waters.

matthew 14:26.english: And his disciples saw him as he walked upon the waters, and they were perturbated: and they said, What we see is a spectre: and they cried out through fear.

matthew 14:27.english: But Jesus immediately spoke to them, and said: Have courage: it is I; be not afraid.

matthew 14:28.english: Cephas replied, and said to him: My Lord, if it be thou, bid me come to thee on the waters.

matthew 14:29.english: And Jesus said to him, Come. And Cephas descended from the ship, and walked upon the waters to go to Jesus.

matthew 14:30.english: But when he saw the wind to be violent, he was afraid, and began to sink. And he raised his voice, and said My Lord, rescue me.

matthew 14:31.english: And immediately our Lord reached forth his hand, and caught him, and said to him: O small in faith, why didst thou distrust!

matthew 14:32.english: And as they entered the ship, the wind subsided.

matthew 14:33.english: And they that were in the ship, came and worshipped him, and said: Truly thou art the Son of God!

matthew 14:34.english: And they rowed on, and came to the land of Gennesaret.

matthew 14:35.english: And the men of that place knew him: and they sent to all the villages around them; and they brought to him all that were very sick;

matthew 14:36.english: and they entreated of him, that they might touch at least the extremity of his garment. And they who touched, were healed.

matthew 15:1.english: Then came to Jesus Pharisees and Scribes that were from Jerusalem, and said:

matthew 15:2.english: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders, and wash not their hands when they eat bread?

matthew 15:3.english: Jesus replied and said to them: Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God, on account of your tradition?

matthew 15:4.english: For God hath said: Honor thy father, and thy mother; and he that revileth his father or his mother, shall be put to death.

matthew 15:5.english: But ye say Whosoever shall say to a father or to a mother, Be that my offering, by which ye get profit from me: then he must not honor his father or his mother.

matthew 15:6.english: And thus ye make void the word of God, for the sake of your tradition.

matthew 15:7.english: Ye hypocrites, well did the prophet Isaiah prophesy of you, and say :

matthew 15:8.english: This people honoreth me with the lips, but their heart is far from me.

matthew 15:9.english: And in vain they pay me homage, while they teach doctrines that are the precepts of men.

matthew 15:10.english: And he called the multitudes, and said to them, Hear and understand.

matthew 15:11.english: Not that which entereth the mouth, defileth a man; but that which proceedeth from the mouth, that defileth a man.

matthew 15:12.english: Then came his disciples, and said to him: Knowest thou, that the Pharisees were offended when they heard that speech?

matthew 15:13.english: And he replied, and said to them: Every plant, which my Father who is in heaven hath not planted, shall be eradicated.

matthew 15:14.english: Let them alone: they are blind leaders of the blind. And if a blind man leadeth one blind, they will both fall into the ditch.

matthew 15:15.english: And Simon Cephas answered and said to him: My Lord, explain to us this similitude.

matthew 15:16.english: And he said to them: Are ye also, up to this time, without understanding?

matthew 15:17.english: Know ye not, that whatever entereth the mouth, passeth into the belly, and from there is ejected by purgation?

matthew 15:18.english: But that which proceedeth from the mouth, cometh from the heart: and that is what defileth a man.

matthew 15:19.english: For, from the heart proceed evil thoughts, adultery, murder, whoredom, theft, false testimony, reviling.

matthew 15:20.english: These are the things that defile a man. But if a man eat while his hands are unwashed, he is not defiled.

matthew 15:21.english: And Jesus departed from there, and went to the confines of Tyre and Sidon.

matthew 15:22.english: And lo, a woman, a Canaanitess from those confines, came forth, calling out and saying: Compassionate me, my Lord, thou son of David: my daughter is grievously distressed by a demon.

matthew 15:23.english: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and requested of him, and said: Send her away, for she crieth after us.

matthew 15:24.english: But he answered and said to them: I am not sent, except to the sheep that have strayed from the house of Israel.

matthew 15:25.english: And she came, and worshipped him, and said: Help me, my Lord.

matthew 15:26.english: Jesus said to her: It is not proper, to take the bread of the children and throw it to the dogs.

matthew 15:27.english: And she said: Even so, my Lord; yet the dogs eat of the fragments that fall from the tables of their masters, and live.

matthew 15:28.english: Then Jesus said to her: O woman, great is thy faith: be it to thee, as thou desirest. And her daughter was cured from that hour.

matthew 15:29.english: And Jesus departed from there, and came to the side of the sea of Galilee: and he ascended a mountain, and sat there.

matthew 15:30.english: And great multitudes came to him; and with them were the lame, and the blind, and the dumb, and the maimed, and many others: and they laid them at the feet of Jesus, and he healed them.

matthew 15:31.english: So that the multitudes were amazed, when they saw the dumb speaking, and the maimed made whole, and the lame walking, and the blind seeing: and they praised the God of Israel.

matthew 15:32.english: Then Jesus called his disciples, and said to them: I pity this multitude; for lo, these three days they have continued with me, and they have nothing to eat: and I am unwilling to send them away fasting, lest they faint by the way.

matthew 15:33.english: His disciples say to him: Whence can we get bread in the wilderness, to satisfy all this multitude?

matthew 15:34.english: Jesus said to them, How many loaves have ye? They said to him, Seven, and a few little fishes.

matthew 15:35.english: And he commanded the multitudes to recline on the ground.

matthew 15:36.english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

matthew 15:37.english: And they all ate, and were satisfied. And they took up the remains of fragments, seven full baskets.

matthew 15:38.english: And they that had eaten were four thousand men, besides women and children.

matthew 15:39.english: And when he had sent away the multitudes, he took ship, and came to the coasts of Magdala.

matthew 16:1.english: And Pharisees and Sadducees came near, tempting him, and asking him to show them a sign from heaven.

matthew 16:2.english: But he answered, and said to them: When it is evening ye say, It will be fair weather; for the heavens are red.

matthew 16:3.english: And in the morning ye say, There will be a storm to-day; for the heavens are sadly red. Ye hypocrites, ye are intelligent to discover the aspect of the heavens, but the signs of this time ye have no skill to discern.

matthew 16:4.english: A wicked and adulterous generation asketh for a sign; but no sign shall be given it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah. And he left them, and departed.

matthew 16:5.english: And when his disciples had come to the farther shore, they had forgotten to take bread with them.

matthew 16:6.english: And he said to them: Take heed, and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.

matthew 16:7.english: And they reasoned among themselves, and said, it was because they had taken no bread.

matthew 16:8.english: But Jesus knew it and said to them O ye small in faith! why reason ye among yourselves because ye have taken no bread?

matthew 16:9.english: Have ye not yet understood? Do ye not remember the five loaves and the five thousand, and the many baskets ye took up?

matthew 16:10.english: Nor the seven loaves and the four thousand, and the many baskets ye took up?

matthew 16:11.english: How is it that ye do not understand that it was not concerning bread that I spoke to you; but that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

matthew 16:12.english: Then understood they, that he did not bid them beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

matthew 16:13.english: And when Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, he questioned his disciples, and said: What do men say concerning me, that I the Son of man, am?

matthew 16:14.english: And they said: Some say that thou art John the Baptizer; but others, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

matthew 16:15.english: He said to them: But, who do ye yourselves say that I am?

matthew 16:16.english: Simon Cephas answered and said: Thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living God.

matthew 16:17.english: Jesus answered, and said to him: Blessed art thou, Simon son of Jonas; for flesh and blood have not revealed it to thee, but my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 16:18.english: Also I say to thee, that thou art Cephas: and upon this rock, I will build my church: and the gates of death shall not triumph over it.

matthew 16:19.english: To thee will I give the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever thou shalt bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven: and whatever thou shalt unbind on earth, shall be unbound in heaven.

matthew 16:20.english: Then he enjoined on his disciples, that they should tell no man that he was the Messiah.

matthew 16:21.english: And from that time Jesus began to show to his disciples, that he was to go up to Jerusalem, and to suffer much from the Elders, and from the chief priests and Scribes, and be killed, and on the third day arise.

matthew 16:22.english: And Cephas took him, and began to rebuke him; and he said: Far be it from thee, my Lord, that this should be to thee.

matthew 16:23.english: But he turned, and said to Cephas: Get thee behind me, Satan Thou art a stumbling block to me; for thou thinkest not the things of God, but the things of men.

matthew 16:24.english: Then said Jesus to his disciples: If any one desireth to come after me, let him deny himself; and let him bear his cross, and come after me.

matthew 16:25.english: For, whoever chooseth to preserve his life, shall lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake, shall find it.

matthew 16:26.english: For what will it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and shall lose his soul? Or what will a man give in exchange for his soul?

matthew 16:27.english: For the Son of man is to come in the glory of his Father, with all his holy angels; and then will he recompense to every man as his deeds are.

matthew 16:28.english: Verily I say to you: There are some persons standing here, who shall not taste death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

matthew 17:1.english: And after six days Jesus took Cephas, and James, and John his brother, and conducted them alone to a high mountain.

matthew 17:2.english: And Jesus was changed before them: and his face shone like the sun; and his vestments became white like the light.

matthew 17:3.english: And there appeared to them Moses and Elijah, in conversation with him.

matthew 17:4.english: Then Cephas answered and said to Jesus: My Lord, it is good for us to be here: and, if it please thee, we will make here three booths; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

matthew 17:5.english: And while he was yet speaking, lo, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and there was a voice from the cloud which said: This is my beloved Son, in whom I have pleasure; hear ye him.

matthew 17:6.english: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were much afraid.

matthew 17:7.english: And Jesus came to them and touched them, and said: Arise, and be not afraid.

matthew 17:8.english: And they raised their eyes, and they saw no person, except Jesus only.

matthew 17:9.english: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, and said to them: Speak of this vision before no person, until the Son of man shall have arisen from the dead.

matthew 17:10.english: And his disciples asked him, and said to him: Why then do the Scribes say, that Elijah must first come?

matthew 17:11.english: Jesus answered, and said to them: Elijah doth first come, to fulfill every thing.

matthew 17:12.english: And I say to you. That, behold, Elijah hath come, and they did not know him; and they have done to him whatever they pleased: and, in like manner, also the Son of man is to suffer from them.

matthew 17:13.english: Then the disciples understood, that he spake to them of John the Baptizer.

matthew 17:14.english: And when they came to the multitude, a man approached him, and bowed himself on his knees,
