matthew 17:15.english: and said to him: My Lord, compassionate me. I have a son who is a lunatic, and grievously afflicted; for often he falleth into the fire, and often into the water.

matthew 17:16.english: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not heal him.

matthew 17:17.english: Jesus answered and said: O unbelieving and perverse generation! How long shall I be with you? and how long bear with you? Bring him here to me.

matthew 17:18.english: And Jesus rebuked the demon, and it departed from him: and from that hour the child was healed.

matthew 17:19.english: Then came the disciples to Jesus, apart, and said to him: Why could not we heal him?

matthew 17:20.english: Jesus said to them: Because of your unbelief. For verily I say to you, That if there be in you faith like a grain of mustard seed, ye may say to this mountain, Remove hence, and it will remove: and nothing will be too hard for you.

matthew 17:21.english: But this kind goeth not out, except by fasting and prayer.

matthew 17:22.english: And while they were resident in Galilee, Jesus said to them: The Son of man is to be betrayed into the hands of men;

matthew 17:23.english: and they will kill him; and the third day he will arise. And it saddened them much.

matthew 17:24.english: And when they came to Capernaum, those who receive the two drachmas of capitation money came to Cephas, and said to him: Doth not your rabbi pay his two drachmas?

matthew 17:25.english: He said to them, Yes. And when Cephas had entered the house, Jesus anticipated him and said to him: How doth it appear to thee, Simon? The kings of the earth, of whom do they receive tribute and capitation money? of their children, or of aliens?

matthew 17:26.english: Simon said to him: Of aliens. Jesus said to him: Then the children are free.

matthew 17:27.english: But still, lest they be stumbled with us, go thou to the sea and cast in a fish-hook, and the fish that shall first come up, open its mouth, and thou wilt find a stater that take, and give for me and for thyself.

matthew 18:1.english: In that hour the disciples approached Jesus, and said: Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

matthew 18:2.english: And Jesus called a child, and placed him in the midst of them,

matthew 18:3.english: and said: Verily I say to you, that unless ye be converted, and become like children, ye will not enter the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 18:4.english: He therefore that shall humble himself like this child, he will be great in the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 18:5.english: And he that shall receive in my name one who is like to this child, he receiveth me.

matthew 18:6.english: And whosoever shall stumble one of these little ones that believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were suspended to his neck, and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

matthew 18:7.english: Woe to the world because of stumbling blocks! For it must be, that stumbling blocks come. But, woe to the person by whose means the stumbling blocks come.

matthew 18:8.english: If then thy hand or thy foot make thee stumble, cut it off and cast it from thee: for it is good for thee to enter into life lame or mutilated, and not that, with two hands or two feet, thou fall into eternal fire.

matthew 18:9.english: And if thine eye make thee stumble, pluck it out and cast it from thee: for it is good for thee to enter into life with one eye, and not that, with two eyes, thou fall into the hell of fire.

matthew 18:10.english: See that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say to you, That their angels in heaven, at all times, are beholding the face of my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 18:11.english: For the Son of man, hath come to give life to that which was lost.

matthew 18:12.english: How doth it appear to you? If a man should have a hundred sheep, and one of them should go astray, will he not leave the ninety and nine in the mountains, and go and seek the one that strayed?

matthew 18:13.english: And if he find it, verily I say to you, that he rejoiceth in it, more than in the ninety and nine that did not stray.

matthew 18:14.english: Just so, it is not the pleasure of your Father who is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

matthew 18:15.english: Moreover, if thy brother commit an offence against thee, go and admonish him between thee and him only. If he hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

matthew 18:16.english: But if he hear thee not, take with thee one or two, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

matthew 18:17.english: And if he will also not hear them, tell it to the church. And if he will also not hear the church, let him be to thee as a publican and a heathen.

matthew 18:18.english: Verily I say to you, That whatever ye shall bind on earth, shall be bound in heaven: and whatever ye shall unbind on earth, shall be unbound in heaven.

matthew 18:19.english: Again I say to you, That if two of you shall agree on earth concerning any thing that they shall ask, it shall be to them from my Father who is in heaven.

matthew 18:20.english: For where two or three are assembled in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

matthew 18:21.english: Then Cephas approached him, and said to him: My Lord, how many times, if my brother commit offence against me, shall I forgive him? up to seven times?

matthew 18:22.english: Jesus said to him: I do not say to thee, up to seven times, but up to seventy times seven.

matthew 18:23.english: Therefore the kingdom of heaven is like to some king, who wished to have a reckoning with his servants.

matthew 18:24.english: And when he began to reckon, they brought to him one debtor of ten thousand talents.

matthew 18:25.english: And as he had not wherewith to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, him and his wife and his children, and all that he possessed, and payment to be made.

matthew 18:26.english: And that servant fell down and worshipped him, and said: My lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee the whole.

matthew 18:27.english: And his lord had compassion on that servant, and set him free, and forgave him his debt.

matthew 18:28.english: Then that servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants who owed him a hundred denarii. And he laid hold of him and choked him, and said to him: Pay me what thou owest me.

matthew 18:29.english: And that fellow-servant fell at his feet and entreated him, and said: Have patience with me, and I will pay thee the whole.

matthew 18:30.english: But he would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay him what he owed him.

matthew 18:31.english: And when their fellow-servants saw what was done, it grieved them much; and they came and made known to their lord all that had occurred.

matthew 18:32.english: Then his lord called him, and said to him: Thou vile servant! Lo, I forgave thee that whole debt, because thou entreatedst of me:

matthew 18:33.english: oughtest not thou also to have compassion on thy fellow-servant, as I had compassion on thee?

matthew 18:34.english: And his lord was angry, and delivered him over to the torturers, until he should pay all he owed him.

matthew 18:35.english: So will my Father who is in heaven do to you, unless ye from your heart forgive each his brother his offence.

matthew 19:1.english: And when Jesus had ended these discourses, he removed from Galilee, and came to the confines of Judaea on the other side of Jordan.

matthew 19:2.english: And great multitudes followed after him, and he healed them there.

matthew 19:3.english: And Pharisees came to him, and tempted him and said: Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for every cause?

matthew 19:4.english: And he answered and said to them: Have ye not read, that he who made them at the beginning, made them a male and a female?

matthew 19:5.english: And he said: For this reason, a man shall leave his father and his mother, and adhere to his wife; and they two shall be one flesh.

matthew 19:6.english: Wherefore they were not two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath united, let not man sunder.

matthew 19:7.english: They say to him: Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorce, and to put her away?

matthew 19:8.english: He said to them: Moses, on account of the hardness of your heart, permitted you to divorce your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

matthew 19:9.english: And I say to you, That whoever leaveth his wife not being an adulteress, and taketh another, committeth adultery. And whoever taketh her that is divorced, committeth adultery.

matthew 19:10.english: His disciples say to him: If such is the case between man and wife, it is not expedient to take a wife.

matthew 19:11.english: But he said to them: Not every one is capable of that thing, but he only to whom it is given.

matthew 19:12.english: For there are some eunuchs, born so from their mother's womb; and there are some eunuchs, who were made eunuchs by men; and there are some eunuchs who have made themselves eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. He that can be contented let him be contented.

matthew 19:13.english: Then they brought children to him, that he might lay his hand upon them and pray. And his disciples rebuked them.

matthew 19:14.english: But Jesus said to them: Allow children to come to me, and forbid them not; for of those that are like them is the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 19:15.english: And he laid his hand upon them, and departed from there.

matthew 19:16.english: And one came, drew near, and said to him: Good Teacher, what good thing must I do, that eternal life may be mine?

matthew 19:17.english: And he said to him: Why callest thou me good? There is none good, except one, namely, God. But if thou wouldst enter into life, keep the commandments.

matthew 19:18.english: He said to him, Which? And Jesus said to him: Thou shalt not kill; and thou shalt not commit adultery; and thou shalt not steal; and thou shalt not bear false testimony;

matthew 19:19.english: and honor thy father and thy mother; and thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

matthew 19:20.english: The young man saith to him: All these have I kept from my childhood. What do I lack?

matthew 19:21.english: Jesus saith to him: If thou desirest to be perfect, go, sell thy property, and give to the poor; and there shall be for thee a treasure in heaven; and come thou after me.

matthew 19:22.english: And the young man heard that speech, and he went away in sadness; for he had much property.

matthew 19:23.english: And Jesus said to his disciples: Verily I say to you, it is difficult for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.

matthew 19:24.english: And again, I say to you: It is easier for a camel to enter the aperture of a needle, than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God

matthew 19:25.english: And when the disciples heard it, they wondered greatly, and said: Who then can attain to life!

matthew 19:26.english: Jesus looked on them, and said to them: With men this is not practicable, but with God every thing is practicable.

matthew 19:27.english: Then answered Cephas, and said to him: Lo, we have forsaken every thing, and come after thee: What therefore shall we receive?

matthew 19:28.english: Jesus said to them: Verily I say to you, that, as for you who have followed me, when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory in the new world, ye also shall sit on twelve seats, and shall judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

matthew 19:29.english: And every man that relinquisheth houses, or brothers or sisters, or father or mother, or wife or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.

matthew 19:30.english: But there are many first who shall be last, and last who shall be first.

matthew 20:1.english: For the kingdom of heaven is like a man, the lord of a house, who went out, at dawn of day, to hire laborers for his vineyard.

matthew 20:2.english: And he contracted with the labors for a denarius a day: and sent them into his vineyard.

matthew 20:3.english: And he went out at the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the market-place:

matthew 20:4.english: and he said to them, Go ye also into my vineyard, and what is right I will give you;

matthew 20:5.english: and they went. And again he went out at the sixth and ninth hours, and did the same.

matthew 20:6.english: And about the eleventh hour, he went out and found others who were standing and idle; and he said to them: Why stand ye all the day, and are idle?

matthew 20:7.english: They say to him, Because no one hath hired us. He saith to them: Go ye also into the vineyard; and what is right ye shall receive.

matthew 20:8.english: And when it was evening, the lord of the vineyard said to his steward: Call the laborers, and give them their wages; and commence with the last, and proceed to the first.

matthew 20:9.english: And those of the eleventh hour came, and received each a denarius.

matthew 20:10.english: And when the first came, they supposed they should receive more; but they also received each a denarius.

matthew 20:11.english: And when they received it, they murmured against the lord of the house,

matthew 20:12.english: and said: These last have labored but one hour, and thou hast made them equal with us who have borne the burden of the day and the heat of it.

matthew 20:13.english: But he answered, and said to one of them: My friend, I do thee no injustice: was it not for a denarius that thou didst contract with me?

matthew 20:14.english: Take what belongeth to thee, and go: for I am disposed to give to this last, as to thee.

matthew 20:15.english: Is it not lawful for me, to do what I please with what belongeth to me; or is thy eye evil, because I am good?

matthew 20:16.english: Thus the last shall be first, and the first last: for the called are many, but the chosen are few.

matthew 20:17.english: And Jesus was about to go up to Jerusalem: and he took his twelve disciples aside, on the way, and said to them:

matthew 20:18.english: Behold we are going to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be delivered up to the chief priests and to the Scribes, and they will condemn him to death.

matthew 20:19.english: And they will deliver him over to the Gentiles: and they will mock him, and will scourge him, and will crucify him; and the third day, he will arise.

matthew 20:20.english: Then came, to him the mother of Zebedee's children, she and her sons; and she worshipped him, and asked something from him.

matthew 20:21.english: And he said to her, What desirest thou? She said to him: Say, that these my two sons shall sit, the one on thy right hand and the other on thy left, in thy kingdom.

matthew 20:22.english: Jesus answered and said: Ye know not what ye ask for. Can ye drink of the cup, of which I am to drink? or be baptized with the baptism, that I am baptized with? They say to him: We can.

matthew 20:23.english: He saith to them: Ye will indeed drink of my cup, and will be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but that ye should sit on my right hand and on my left, is not mine to give, except to those for whom it is prepared by my Father.

matthew 20:24.english: And when the ten heard it, they were angry against the two brothers.

matthew 20:25.english: And Jesus called them, and said to them: Ye know that the princes of the nations are their lords, and their great men exercise authority over them.

matthew 20:26.english: Not so shall it be among you. But whoever among you desireth to be great, let him be to you, a ministerer:

matthew 20:27.english: and whoever among you desireth to be first, let him be your servant:

matthew 20:28.english: even as the Son of man came, not to be served, but to serve; and to give his life a ransom for many.

matthew 20:29.english: And as Jesus passed out of Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

matthew 20:30.english: And lo, two blind men were sitting by the way side. And when they heard that Jesus was passing, they called out, and said: Have compassion on us, my Lord, thou son of David!

matthew 20:31.english: And the multitudes rebuked them, that they might be silent. But they raised their voice the more, and said: Our Lord, have compassion on us, thou son of David.

matthew 20:32.english: And Jesus stopped, and called them, and said: What wish ye, that I should do for you?

matthew 20:33.english: They said to him: Our Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

matthew 20:34.english: And he had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes were opened, and they followed him.

matthew 21:1.english: And as he approached Jerusalem, and came to Bethphage, by the side of the mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples;

matthew 21:2.english: and said to them: Go into this village which is over against you, and directly ye will find an ass tied, and a colt with her. Untie and bring them to me.

matthew 21:3.english: And if any man say ought to you, tell him, That they are needed by our Lord: and at once he will send them hither.

matthew 21:4.english: Now this whole occurrence was, that so might be fulfilled that which was spoken by the prophet, saying:

matthew 21:5.english: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy king cometh to thee, meek, and riding on an ass, and on a colt the foal of an ass.

matthew 21:6.english: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them.

matthew 21:7.english: And they brought the ass and the colt. And they placed their garments on the colt, and set Jesus upon it.

matthew 21:8.english: And a very great throng strewed their clothes in the path; and others cut branches from the trees, and cast them in the path.

matthew 21:9.english: And the multitudes that went before him, and that followed after him, shouted and said: Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

matthew 21:10.english: And as he entered Jerusalem, the whole city was in commotion; and they said, Who is this?

matthew 21:11.english: And the multitudes said, This is Jesus the prophet, who is from Nazareth of Galilee.

matthew 21:12.english: And Jesus entered into the temple of God, and expelled all them that bought and sold in the temple, and overset the counters of the money-brokers, and the seats of them that sold doves.

matthew 21:13.english: And he said to them: It is written, my house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of robbers.

matthew 21:14.english: And there came to him in the temple the blind and the lame; and he healed them.

matthew 21:15.english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees saw the wonderful things which he performed, and the children shouting in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David, their indignation was excited.

matthew 21:16.english: And they said to him: Hearest thou what these are saying? Jesus said to them: Yes. Have ye never read, Out of the mouth of children and infants thou hast acquired praise? And he left them, and retired out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

matthew 21:17.english: And they said to him: Hearest thou what these are saying? Jesus said to them: Yes. Have ye never read, Out of the mouth of children and infants thou hast acquired praise? And he left them, and retired out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

matthew 21:18.english: And in the morning, when he returned to the city, he was hungry.

matthew 21:19.english: And he saw a fig-tree by the way, and came to it and found nothing on it, except leaves only. And he said to it: There shall no more be fruit on thee for ever. And immediately the fig-tree withered.

matthew 21:20.english: And the disciples saw it, and admired, and said: How suddenly hath the fig-tree withered!

matthew 21:21.english: Jesus replied and said to them: Verily I say to you, That if there be faith in you, and ye shall not doubt, ye may not only do this thing of the fig-tree, but also if ye shall say to this mountain, be thou lifted up, and fall into the sea, it will be so.

matthew 21:22.english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, and shall believe, ye shall receive.

matthew 21:23.english: And when Jesus came to the temple, the chief priests and the Elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said to him: By what authority doest thou these things? And who gave thee this authority?

matthew 21:24.english: Jesus replied and said to them: I also will ask you one question, and if ye will tell me, I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.

matthew 21:25.english: The baptism of John, from whence was it? From heaven, or from men? And they reasoned among themselves, and said: If we should say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why did ye not believe in him?

matthew 21:26.english: And if we should say, From men; we are afraid of the multitude, for they all hold John as a prophet.

matthew 21:27.english: And they answered, and said to him: We do not know. Jesus said to them: Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

matthew 21:28.english: But how appeareth it to you? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first and said to him, My son, go, labor to-day in the vineyard.

matthew 21:29.english: And he answered and said, I am not willing. But afterwards he repented and went.

matthew 21:30.english: And he came to the other, and said the same to him. And he answered and said: I go, my lord, but did not go.

matthew 21:31.english: Which of these two performed the pleasure of his father? They say to him, The first. Jesus said to them: Verily I say to you That publicans and harlots go before you into the kingdom of God.

matthew 21:32.english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not; but the publicans and harlots believed him: and ye, after ye had seen it, did not even then repent and believe in him.

matthew 21:33.english: Hear ye another similitude. A certain man, the lord of a house, planted a vineyard, and inclosed it with a hedge, and digged in it a wine-press, and built a tower in it, and leased it to cultivators, and removed to a distance.

matthew 21:34.english: And when the time for the fruits arrived, he sent his servants to the cultivators that they might remit to him of the fruits of the vineyard.

matthew 21:35.english: And the cultivators laid hold of his servants, and beat one, and stoned another and one they slew.

matthew 21:36.english: And again he sent other servants, more numerous than the first; and they did the like to them.

matthew 21:37.english: And at last he sent to them his son: for he said, Perhaps they will respect my son.

matthew 21:38.english: But the cultivators, when they saw the son, said among themselves: This is the heir: Come; let us kill him, and retain his inheritance.

matthew 21:39.english: And they laid hold of him, thrust him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

matthew 21:40.english: When the lord of the vineyard, therefore, shall come; what will he do to those cultivators?

matthew 21:41.english: They say to him: He will utterly destroy them; and will lease the vineyard to other cultivators, who will render him the fruits in their seasons.

matthew 21:42.english: Jesus said to them: Have ye never read in the scripture, The stone which the builders rejected, hath become the head of the corner: this is from the Lord; and it is marvellous in our eyes?

matthew 21:43.english: Therefore I say to you, That the kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and shall be given to a people that will yield fruits.

matthew 21:44.english: And whoever shall fall upon this stone, will be fractured; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will crush him to atoms?

matthew 21:45.english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his similitudes, they understood that he spoke in reference to them.

matthew 21:46.english: And they sought to apprehend him, but were afraid of the multitude, because they accounted him as a prophet.

matthew 22:1.english: And Jesus answered again by similitudes, and said:

matthew 22:2.english: The kingdom of heaven is like to a royal person, who made a feast for his son.

matthew 22:3.english: And he sent his servants to call those that had been invited, to the feast: and they would not come.

matthew 22:4.english: And again he sent other servants, and said: Tell those invited, Behold, my entertainment is prepared, my oxen and my fatlings are slain, and every thing is prepared; come ye to the feast.

matthew 22:5.english: But they showed contempt, and went away, one to his farm, and another to his merchandise;

matthew 22:6.english: and the rest seized his servants, and abused them, and slew them.

matthew 22:7.english: And when the king heard of it, he was angry; and he sent his military forces, and destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

matthew 22:8.english: Then said he to his servants, The feast is prepared, but they who were invited were unworthy.

matthew 22:9.english: Go ye therefore to the terminations of the streets; and as many as ye find, bid to the feast.

matthew 22:10.english: And those servants went out into the streets, and collected all they found, both bad and good; and the place of feasting was filled with guests.

matthew 22:11.english: And the king went in to see the guests: and he saw there a man who was not clad in the festal garments.

matthew 22:12.english: And he said to him: My friend, how camest thou here without the festal robes? But he was silent.

matthew 22:13.english: Then said the king to the servitors: Bind his hands and his feet, and cast him into the outer darkness: there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 22:14.english: For the called are many, and the chosen are few.

matthew 22:15.english: Then went the Pharisees and took counsel, how they might ensnare him in discourse.

matthew 22:16.english: And they sent to him their disciples, with domestics of Herod, and said to him: Teacher, we know that thou art veracious, and teachest the way of God with truth, regardless of man, for thou hast no respect of persons.

matthew 22:17.english: Tell us, therefore, how doth it appear to thee: is it lawful to pay capitation money to Caesar, or not?

matthew 22:18.english: But Jesus knew their wickedness, and said: Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

matthew 22:19.english: Show me a denarius of the capitation money. And they brought to him a denarius.

matthew 22:20.english: And Jesus said to them: Whose is this image and inscription?

matthew 22:21.english: They say, Caesar's. He saith to them: Give then Caesar's things to Caesar, and God's things to God.

matthew 22:22.english: And when they heard it they were surprised: and they left him, and went away.

matthew 22:23.english: The same day came Sadducees, and said to him: There is no life of the dead. And they questioned him,

matthew 22:24.english: and said to him: Teacher; Moses commanded us, that if a man should die childless, his brother must take his wife and raise up seed to his brother.

matthew 22:25.english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first took a wife, and deceased; and, as he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.

matthew 22:26.english: In like manner also the second, and the third, and up to the whole seven.

matthew 22:27.english: And after them all, the woman also herself died.

matthew 22:28.english: In the resurrection, therefore, to which of those seven will she be the wife? For they all had taken her?

matthew 22:29.english: Jesus answered, and said to them: Ye do err, from not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

matthew 22:30.english: For in the resurrection of the dead, they do not take wives, nor are wives given to husbands; but they are as the angels of God in heaven.

matthew 22:31.english: But as to the resurrection of the dead,: have ye not read what was spoken to you by God, who said:

matthew 22:32.english: I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob? Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

matthew 22:33.english: And when the multitude heard it they were astonished at his doctrine.

matthew 22:34.english: And when the Pharisees heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they assembled together;

matthew 22:35.english: and one of them, who was expert in the law, to tempt him, inquired:

matthew 22:36.english: Teacher, which is the great command in the law?

matthew 22:37.english: Jesus said to him: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might, and with all thy mind.

matthew 22:38.english: This is the great and first command.

matthew 22:39.english: And the second, which is like it, is, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

matthew 22:40.english: On these two commands hang the law and the prophets.

matthew 22:41.english: And while the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them,

matthew 22:42.english: and said: What say ye respecting, the Messiah? Whose son is he? They say to him; The son of David.

matthew 22:43.english: He saith to them: How then doth David, by the Spirit, call him Lord? for he said:

matthew 22:44.english: The Lord said to my Lord, Seat thyself at my right hand, until I place thy enemies under thy feet.

matthew 22:45.english: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

matthew 22:46.english: And no one was able to give him an answer? And from that day, no one dared to question him.

matthew 23:1.english: Then Jesus conversed with the multitude and with his disciples,

matthew 23:2.english: and said to them: The Scribes and Pharisees sit in the seat of Moses.

matthew 23:3.english: Whatever therefore they tell you to observe, that observe and do. But according to their deeds, practise ye not: for they say, and do not.

matthew 23:4.english: They tie up heavy burdens, and lay them on men's shoulders; but will not themselves touch them with their finger.

matthew 23:5.english: And all their works they do, to be seen of men: for they make their phylacteries broad, and extend the fringes of their garments.

matthew 23:6.english: And they love the highest couches at suppers and the highest seats in the synagogues,

matthew 23:7.english: and the greeting in the market places, and to be addressed by men with Rabbi.

matthew 23:8.english: But be not ye called Rabbi; for one is your Rabbi, and ye are all brethren.

matthew 23:9.english: And ye shall not call yourselves Father on earth; for one is your Father, who is in heaven.

matthew 23:10.english: And be ye not called guides; for one is your Guide, the Messiah.

matthew 23:11.english: And the great one among you will be your servitor.

matthew 23:12.english: For whoever shall exalt himself, will be abased: and whoever shall abase himself, will be exalted.

matthew 23:13.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye devour the houses of widows, under the disguise of protracting your prayers. Therefore ye shall receive greater condemnation.

matthew 23:14.english: Woe to you. Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye hold the kingdom of heaven closed before men; for ye enter not yourselves, and those that would enter ye suffer not to enter.

matthew 23:15.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye traverse sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he is gained, ye make him a child of hell twofold more than yourselves.

matthew 23:16.english: Woe to you, ye blind guides: for ye say, Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold that is in the temple, he is holden.

matthew 23:17.english: Ye fools, and blind: for which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

matthew 23:18.english: And, whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing: but whoever shall swear by the oblation upon it, he is holden.

matthew 23:19.english: Ye fools, and blind: for which is greater, the oblation, or the altar that sanctifieth the oblation?

matthew 23:20.english: He therefore who sweareth by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all that is upon it.

matthew 23:21.english: And he who sweareth by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth in it.

matthew 23:22.english: And he who sweareth by heaven, sweareth by throne of God, and by him that sitteth on it.

matthew 23:23.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye tithe mint, and anise, and cummin, and omit the graver matters of the law, judgment, and mercy, and fidelity: these ought ye to do, and those not to omit.

matthew 23:24.english: Ye blind guides, who strain out gnats, and swallow down camels.

matthew 23:25.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye cleanse the outside of the cup and the dish, while within they are full of rapine and wickedness.

matthew 23:26.english: Ye blind Pharisees, cleanse first the inside of the cup and dish, that their outside may be clean also.

matthew 23:27.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye are like whited sepulchres, which appear comely without, but are within full of bones of the dead and all impurity.

matthew 23:28.english: So ye also, outwardly, appear to men as righteous; but within, ye are full of iniquity and hypocrisy.

matthew 23:29.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites: for ye build the tombs of the prophets and ye adorn the sepulchres of the righteous;

matthew 23:30.english: and ye say: If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been participators with them in the blood of the prophets.

matthew 23:31.english: Wherefore ye are witnesses, against yourselves, that ye are the children of them that killed the prophets.

matthew 23:32.english: And as for you, fill ye up the measure of your fathers.

matthew 23:33.english: Ye serpents, ye race of vipers: how can ye escape the condemnation of hell?

matthew 23:34.english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes; some of whom ye will kill and crucify, and some of them ye will scourge in your synagogues, and will persecute them from city to city:

matthew 23:35.english: so that on you may come all the blood of the righteous, which hath been shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zachariah, son of Barachiah, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

matthew 23:36.english: Verily I say to you, that all these things will come upon this generation.

matthew 23:37.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent to thee: how often would I have gathered thy children, as a hen gathereth her young under her wings, and ye would not.

matthew 23:38.english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate!

matthew 23:39.english: For I say to you, That ye shall not see me henceforth, until ye shall say: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

matthew 24:1.english: And Jesus passed out of the temple to go away: and his disciples came to him, showing him the structure of the temple.

matthew 24:2.english: And he said to them: See ye not all these? Verily I say to you, There will not be left here a stone upon a stone, that is not demolished.

matthew 24:3.english: And as Jesus sat on the mount of Olives, his disciples came, and said between themselves and him: Tell us when these things are to be; and what will be the sign of thy coming, and of the consummation of the world.

matthew 24:4.english: Jesus answered and said to them: Take heed, that no one deceive you.

matthew 24:5.english: For many will come in my name, and will say, I am the Messiah: and they will deceive many.

matthew 24:6.english: And ye are to hear of conflicts, and the rumor of battles. See that ye be not disquieted: for all these things must come; but the consummation is not yet.

matthew 24:7.english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes in divers places.

matthew 24:8.english: But all these are only the commencement of sorrows.

matthew 24:9.english: And they will deliver you up to tribulation, and will kill you: and ye will be hated by all nations, on account of my name.

matthew 24:10.english: Then many will be stumbled: and they will hate one another, and will betray one another.

matthew 24:11.english: And many false prophets will rise up; and they will deceive many.

matthew 24:12.english: And on account of the abounding of iniquity, the love of many will decline.

matthew 24:13.english: But he that shall persevere to the end, will have life.

matthew 24:14.english: And this announcement of the kingdom shall be published in all the world, for a testimony to all nations: and then will come the consummation.

matthew 24:15.english: And when ye see the abominable sign of desolation, which was spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place; then let the reader consider;

matthew 24:16.english: and then let them who are in Judaea, flee to the mountain:

matthew 24:17.english: and let him who is on the roof, not come down to take what is in his house:

matthew 24:18.english: and let him who is in the field, not return back to take his clothing.

matthew 24:19.english: But woe to those with child, and to them that are nursing, in those days.

matthew 24:20.english: And pray ye, that your flight be not in winter, or on the sabbath.

matthew 24:21.english: For there will then be great distress, such as hath not been from the commencement of the world, until now, and will not be.

matthew 24:22.english: And unless those days should be cut short, no flesh would remain alive. But, for the elect's sake, those days will be cut short.

matthew 24:23.english: Then, if any one shall say to you, Lo, the Messiah is here, or is there; give no credence.

matthew 24:24.english: For there will arise false Messiahs, and mendacious prophets; who will exhibit great signs, so as to deceive, if possible, even the elect.

matthew 24:25.english: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

matthew 24:26.english: If therefore they say to you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not out: or, Behold, he is in a secret chamber; give no credence.

matthew 24:27.english: As the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth unto the west, so will be the coming of the Son of man.

matthew 24:28.english: And wherever the carcass may be, there will the eagles be congregated.

matthew 24:29.english: And immediately after the distress of those days, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not show her light, and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of heaven will be agitated.

matthew 24:30.english: And then will be seen the signal of the Son of man in heaven: and then will all the tribes of the earth mourn, when they see the Son of man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

matthew 24:31.english: And he will send his angels with a great trumpet and they will collect together his elect from the four winds, from one extremity of heaven to the other.

matthew 24:32.english: And learn ye an illustration from the fig-tree. As soon as its branches become tender and its leaves shoot forth, ye know that summer is coming on.

matthew 24:33.english: So also ye, when ye perceive all these things, know ye, that he is nigh, even at the door.

matthew 24:34.english: Verily I say to you, That this generation shall not pass away, till all these things shall be.

matthew 24:35.english: Heaven and earth will pass away; but my words shall not pass away.

matthew 24:36.english: But of that day and of that hour, knoweth no man, nor even the angels of heaven, but the Father only.

matthew 24:37.english: And as the days of Noah, so will the coming of the Son of man be.

matthew 24:38.english: For as, before the flood, they were eating and drinking, taking wives and giving to husbands, up to the day that Noah entered the ark,

matthew 24:39.english: and knew not, until the flood came and took them all away; so will the coming of the Son of man be.

matthew 24:40.english: Then will two men be in the field; the one will be taken, and the other left.

matthew 24:41.english: Two women will be grinding at the mill; the one taken, and the other left.

matthew 24:42.english: Watch, therefore, since ye know not at what hour your Lord cometh.

matthew 24:43.english: But know this, that if the lord of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have been awake, and would not have suffered his house to be broken into.

matthew 24:44.english: Therefore, be ye also ready; for at an hour ye do not expect, the Son of man will come.

matthew 24:45.english: Who then, is that faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath placed over his domestics, to give them their food in its time?

matthew 24:46.english: Happy is that servant, whom, when his lord shall come, he will find so doing.

matthew 24:47.english: Verily I say to you, He will place him over all that he hath.

matthew 24:48.english: But if that servant, being wicked, shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

matthew 24:49.english: and shall begin to beat his fellow-servants, and shall be eating and drinking with drunkards;

matthew 24:50.english: the lord of that servant will come in a day he will not expect, and in an hour he knoweth not,

matthew 24:51.english: and will cut him asunder, and will assign him his portion with the hypocrites; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 25:1.english: Then may the kingdom of heaven be shadowed forth by ten virgins, who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom and bride.

matthew 25:2.english: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

matthew 25:3.english: And the foolish took their lamps, but took no oil with them.

matthew 25:4.english: But the wise took oil in vessels, with their lamps.

matthew 25:5.english: And while the bridegroom delayed, they all became sleepy and fell asleep.

matthew 25:6.english: And at midnight there was an outcry: Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

matthew 25:7.english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

matthew 25:8.english: And the foolish said to the wise; Give us of your oil; for, behold, our lamps have gone out.

matthew 25:9.english: The wise answered and said: We must refuse, lest there should not be enough for us and for you: but go ye to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

matthew 25:10.english: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready, went with him into the house of the nuptials, and the door was shut.

matthew 25:11.english: And at length came also the other virgins, and said: Our lord, our lord, open to us.

matthew 25:12.english: But he answered, and said to them: Verily I say to you, I know you not.

matthew 25:13.english: Watch, therefore, seeing ye know not the day nor the hour.

matthew 25:14.english: For, as a man that took a journey, called his servants and delivered to them his property;

matthew 25:15.english: to one he gave five talents; to another, two; and to another, one: to each, according to his ability: and he immediately departed.

matthew 25:16.english: Then he that received five talents, went and traded with them, and gained five more.

matthew 25:17.english: And likewise: the one of two talents, by trading gained two more.

matthew 25:18.english: But he that received one, went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

matthew 25:19.english: And after a long time, the lord of those servants came, and received account from them.

matthew 25:20.english: And he who had received the five talents, came and brought five others; and said, My lord, thou gavest me five talents; behold, I have gained by trading five more to them.

matthew 25:21.english: His lord said to him: Well done! good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful with a little; I will set thee over much: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

matthew 25:22.english: And he of the two talents came, and said: My lord, thou gavest me two talents; behold, I have by trading gained two more to them.

matthew 25:23.english: His lord said to him: Well done! good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful with a little; I will set thee over much: enter thou into the Joy of thy lord.

matthew 25:24.english: And he also that received the one talent, came and said: My lord, I knew thee, that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou hast not sowed, and gathering where thou hast not scattered;

matthew 25:25.english: and I was afraid, and I went and hid thy talent in the earth. Behold, thou hast what is thine.

matthew 25:26.english: His lord answered, and said to him: Wicked and slothful servant! Thou knewest me, that I reap where I have not sowed, and gather where I have not scattered!

matthew 25:27.english: Thou oughtest to have cast my money into the exchange; and I might have come and demanded my property with its interest.

matthew 25:28.english: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it to him that hath ten talents.

matthew 25:29.english: For, to him that hath, shall be given, and he shall have more; but from him that hath not, even what he hath shall be taken away.

matthew 25:30.english: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

matthew 25:31.english: And when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all his holy angels with him, then will he sit upon the throne of his glory.

matthew 25:32.english: And before him will be gathered all nations; and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd severeth the sheep from the goats.

matthew 25:33.english: And he will place the sheep on his right hand, and the goats on his left.

matthew 25:34.english: Then will the king say to those on his right hand: Come, ye blessed of my Father; inherit the kingdom that was prepared for you from the foundation of the world.

matthew 25:35.english: For I was hungry, and ye gave me food; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me home;

matthew 25:36.english: I was naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came to me.

matthew 25:37.english: Then will the righteous say to him: Our Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

matthew 25:38.english: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee home? or naked, and clothed thee?

matthew 25:39.english: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came to thee?

matthew 25:40.english: And the king will answer, and say to them: Verily I Say to you, That inasmuch as ye did so to one of these my little brothers, ye did so to me.

matthew 25:41.english: Then will he say also to them on his left hand: Go from me, ye accursed, into everlasting fire, which was prepared for the Calumniator and his angels,

matthew 25:42.english: For I was hungry, and ye gave me no food; and I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;

matthew 25:43.english: and I was a stranger, and ye took me not home; and I was naked, and ye clothed me not; and I was sick and in prison, and ye did not visit me.

matthew 25:44.english: Then will they also answer and say: Our Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister to thee?

matthew 25:45.english: Then will he answer, and say to them: Verily I say to you, That in as much as ye did not so to one of these little ones, ye did not so to me.

matthew 25:46.english: And these will go into everlasting torment, and the righteous into everlasting life.

matthew 26:1.english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had concluded all these discourses, that he said to his disciples:

matthew 26:2.english: Ye know that after two days is the Passover; and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

matthew 26:3.english: Then assembled the chief priests and the Scribes and the Elders of the people, at the hall of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

matthew 26:4.english: And they held a counsel against Jesus, that they might take him by guile, and kill him.

matthew 26:5.english: But they said: Not on the festival, lest there be a commotion among the people.

matthew 26:6.english: And when Jesus was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

matthew 26:7.english: there came to him a woman having a vase of aromatic ointment very precious, and she poured it on the head of Jesus as he was reclining.

matthew 26:8.english: And when his disciples saw it they were displeased, and said: Why is this waste?

matthew 26:9.english: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and have been given to the poor.

matthew 26:10.english: But Jesus knew their dissatisfaction, and said to them: Why trouble ye the woman? She hath performed a good deed towards me.

matthew 26:11.english: For the poor ye have at all times with you; but I am not with you always

matthew 26:12.english: And this her act, pouring the ointment on my body, she hath done as it were for my burial.

matthew 26:13.english: Verily I say to you, That wherever this my gospel shall be proclaimed, in all the world, this thing that she hath done shall be told for a memorial of her.

matthew 26:14.english: Then one of the twelve, named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

matthew 26:15.english: and said to them: What will ye give me, if I will deliver him to you? And they promised him thirty pieces of silver.

matthew 26:16.english: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

matthew 26:17.english: And on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, and said to him: Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the Passover?

matthew 26:18.english: And he said to them: Go ye into the city, to such a man, and say to him: Our Rabbi saith, My time approaches: with thee will I keep the Passover with my disciples

matthew 26:19.english: And his disciples did as Jesus directed them, and made ready the Passover.

matthew 26:20.english: And when it was evening, he reclined with his twelve disciples.

matthew 26:21.english: And as they were eating, he said: Verily I say to you, That one of you will betray me.

matthew 26:22.english: And it troubled them much. And they began each one of them to say to him; My Lord is it I?

matthew 26:23.english: And he answered and said: One that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, he will betray me.

matthew 26:24.english: And the Son of man goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man, by whom the Son of man is betrayed. It would have been better for that man, if he had not been born.

matthew 26:25.english: Judas the betrayer answered and said: Rabbi, is it I? Jesus said to him: Thou hast said.

matthew 26:26.english: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake; and gave to his disciples, and said: Take, eat; this is my body.

matthew 26:27.english: And he took the cup, and offered thanks and gave it to them, saying: Take, drink of this all of you.

matthew 26:28.english: This is my blood of the new testament, which, in behalf of many, is shed for the remission of sins.

matthew 26:29.english: But I say to you, that I will henceforth not drink of this product of the vine, until the day in which I shall drink it with you new in the kingdom of God. And they sang praises, and went forth to the mount of Olives.

matthew 26:30.english: : Then said Jesus to them: Ye will all be offended in me this night; for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of his flock will be dispersed.

matthew 26:31.english: : Then said Jesus to them: Ye will all be offended in me this night; for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of his flock will be dispersed.

matthew 26:32.english: But after I am arisen, I will go before you into Galilee.

matthew 26:33.english: Cephas replied, and said to him: Though all men should be offended in thee, I will never be offended in thee.

matthew 26:34.english: Jesus said to him: Verily I say to thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou wilt thrice deny me.

matthew 26:35.english: Cephas said to him: If I were to die with thee, I would not deny thee: and so also said all the disciples.

matthew 26:36.english: Then came Jesus with them to a place called Gethsemane: and he said to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray.

matthew 26:37.english: And he took Cephas and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be dejected and sorrowful.

matthew 26:38.english: And he said to them: There is anguish in my soul, even unto death. Wait for me here; and watch with me.

matthew 26:39.english: And retiring a little, he fell on his face, and prayed, and said: My Father, if it can be so, let this cup pass from me. Yet not as I choose, but as thou.

matthew 26:40.english: And he came to his disciples, and found them asleep: and he said to Cephas: So! could ye not watch with me one hour?

matthew 26:41.english: Wake ye, and pray, lest ye fall into temptation. The mind is prepared, but the body is infirm.

matthew 26:42.english: Again he went away the second time, and prayed, and said: My Father, if it cannot be that this cup pass, except I drink it, thy will be done.

matthew 26:43.english: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

matthew 26:44.english: And he left them, and went again and prayed the third time, and used the same language.

matthew 26:45.english: : Then he came to his disciples, and said to them: Sleep on now, and take rest. Behold, the hour is come: and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners. Arise, let us go. Behold, he that betrayeth me hath come. And while he was yet speaking, lo, Judas the betrayer, one of the twelve, arrived; and a great multitude with him, with swords and clubs, from the presence of the chief priests and elders of the people. And Judas the betrayer had given them a sign, saying: He it is, whom I shall kiss: him seize ye. And forthwith he approached Jesus, and said: Hail, Rabbi; and kissed him. And Jesus said to him: My friend, is it for this thou hast come? Then they came up, and laid their hands on Jesus, and took him. And lo, one of them with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear. Then Jesus said to him: Return the sword to its place; for all they that take swords, shall die by swords. Supposest thou that I cannot ask of my Father, and he now assign me more than twelve legions of angels? But how then would the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be? At that time Jesus said to the multitude: Have ye come out, as against a cut-throat, with swords and clubs, to take me? I daily sat with you, and taught in the temple, and ye did not apprehend me. And this occurred, that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then the disciples all forsook him and fled. And they who apprehended Jesus carried him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the Scribes and Elders were assembled. And Simon Cephas followed after him at a distance, unto the high priest's hall, and entered, and sat with the servants within, that he might see the issue. And the chief priests and the Elders and the whole assembly sought for witnesses against Jesus, that they might put him to death; and found them not. And many false witnesses came; and at last, two came forward, and said: This man said, I can destroy the temple of God, and in three days rebuild it. And the high priest rose up and said to him: Respondest thou nothing? What do these testify against thee? And Jesus was silent. And the high priest answered, and said to him: I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou art the Messiah, the Son of God. Jesus saith to him: Thou hast said. And I say to you, That hereafter ye will see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven. Then the high priest rent his clothes, and said: Behold, he hath blasphemed! Why therefore should we seek for witnesses? Behold, ye have now heard his blasphemy. What is your pleasure? They answered and said: He is liable to death. Then they spit in his face, and buffeted him, and others smote him, and said to him: Prophesy to us, thou Messiah, who is it smote thee? And Cephas was sitting without in the hall, and a certain maid approached him, and said to him: Thou also wast with Jesus the Nazarean. But he denied it before them all, and said: I know not what thou sayest. And as he went out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said to them: This man was also there with Jesus the Nazarean. And again he denied, with oaths: I know not that man. And a little after, those standing there came up and said to Cephas: Certainly, thou too art one of them; and thy speech maketh thee manifest. Then he began to imprecate and to swear, I know not that man. And in that hour the cock crew. And Cephas remembered the declaration of Jesus, who said to him: Before the cock croweth, thou wilt three times deny me. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

matthew 27:1.english: And when it was morning, the chief priests and the elders of the people held a council against Jesus, how they might put him to death. And they bound him, and carried him and delivered him up to Pilate, the president. Then Judas the betrayer, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, repented. And he went and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders; and said: I have sinned, by betraying innocent blood. And they said: What is that to us? See to it thyself. And he cast down the silver in the temple, and retiring, went and strangled himself And the chief priests took up the silver, and said: It is not lawful to put it into the treasury, because it is the price of blood. And they took counsel, and bought with it the potter's field, for a place to bury strangers. Wherefore that field is called the field of blood, unto this day. Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by the prophet, saying: I took the thirty shekels of silver, the price of the precious one, which they of the children of Israel had stipulated; and I gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord directed me. And Jesus stood before the president. And the resident asked him, and said to him: Art thou the king of the Jews? And Jesus said to him: Thou hast said. And when the chief priests and elders accused him, he made no reply. Then Pilate said to him: Hearest thou not how much they testify against thee? But he gave him no answer, not even one word: and therefore Pilate wondered greatly. And at each festival, the president was accustomed to release to the people one prisoner, such as they preferred. And they had then in bonds a noted prisoner, called Bar Abas. And when they were assembled, Pilate said to them: Whom will ye, that I release to you, Bar Abas, or Jesus who is called Messiah? For Pilate knew that it was from enmity they had delivered him up. And as the president was sitting on his tribunal, his wife sent to him, and said: Have thou nothing to do with that just man; for I have suffered much this I day in a dream because of him. But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitude that they should demand Bar Abas, and destroy Jesus. And the president answered, and said to them: Which of the two, will ye, that I release to you? And they said: Bar Abas. Pilate said to them: And what shall I do to Jesus who is called Messiah? They all replied: Let him be crucified. The president said to them: But what hath he done, that is evil? And they cried out the more, and said: Let him be crucified. And Pilate, when he saw that it availed nothing, but rather that tumult was produced, took water, and washed his hands before the eyes of the multitude, and said: I am pure from the blood of this just man: see ye to it. And all the people answered, and said His blood be on us, and on our children! Then released he to them Bar Abas; and scourged Jesus with whips and delivered him to be crucified. Then the soldiers of the president took Jesus into the Praetorium, and assembled the whole regiment against him. And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet military cloak. And they wove a crown of thorns, and set it on his head, and put a reed in his hand, and they bowed their knees before him, and mocked him, and said: Hail, thou king of the Jews. And they spit in his face, and took the reed, and smote him on his head. And when they had mocked him, they divested him of the cloak, and clothed him in his own garments, and led him out to be crucified. And as they went out, they found a man of Cyrene whose name was Simon; him they compelled to bear his cross. And they came to a place which is called Golgotha, which is interpreted a skull. And they gave him to drink vinegar mixed with gall. And he tasted it, and would not drink. And when they had crucified him, they distributed his garments by lot. And they sat down, and watched him there And they placed over his head the cause of his death, in the writing: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS. And there were crucified with him two robbers, the one on his right hand, and the other on his left. And they that passed by reviled him, and shook their heads and said: Destroyer of the temple, and builder of it in three days, deliver thyself; if thou art the Son of God, and come down from the cross. So also the chief priests mocked, with the Scribes and Elders and Pharisees, and said: He gave life to others, his own life he cannot preserve. If he is the king of Israel, let him now descend from the cross, and we will believe in him. † He trusted in God; let him rescue him now, if he hath pleasure in him: for he said, I am the Son of God. In like manner the marauders also, that were crucified with him, reproached him. And from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land, until the ninth hour. And about the ninth hour, Jesus cried with a loud voice and said: O God, O God; why hast thou forsaken me? And some of them that stood there, when they heard it, said: He calleth for Elijah. And immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink. But the rest said: Desist; we will see if Elijah will come to rescue him. Then Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit. And instantly, the curtain of the door of the temple was torn asunder, from the top to the bottom; and the earth shook; and the rocks rived; and graves were opened; and many bodies of saints who slept, arose, and came forth; and, after his resurrection, entered into the holy city, and appeared to many. And the centurion, and they that were with him guarding Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that occurred, feared greatly, and said: Verily, this was the Son of God. And many women were there, looking on from a distance; the same who had followed Jesus from Galilee, and had ministered to him. One of them was Mary of Magdala, also Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children. And when it was evening, there came a rich man of Ramath, whose name was a Joseph, who was also a disciple of Jesus. This man went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. And Pilate directed the body to be given him. And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a winding-sheet of clean linen; and laid it in his new sepulchre, that was excavated in a rock. And he rolled a great stone against the door of the sepulchre, and departed: And there were present Mary of Magdala, and the other Mary, who sat over against the grave. And on the day that was next after the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate, and said to him: Our Lord, we remember that this deceiver said, while he was alive, After three days, I shall arise. Command, therefore to guard the sepulchre; until the third day; lest his disciples come and steal him away by night, and say to the people that he hath risen from the dead; and the last delusion be worse than the first. Pilate said to them: Ye have soldiers: go and guard it, as ye know how. And they went and set a guard to the sepulchre, and sealed the stone.

And they gave him to drink vinegar mixed with gall. And he tasted it, and would not drink. And when they had crucified him, they distributed his garments by lot. And they sat down, and watched him there And they placed over his head the cause of his death, in the writing: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS. And there were crucified with him two robbers, the one on his right hand, and the other on his left. And they that passed by reviled him, and shook their heads and said: Destroyer of the temple, and builder of it in three days, deliver thyself; if thou art the Son of God, and come down from the cross. So also the chief priests mocked, with the Scribes and Elders and Pharisees, and said: He gave life to others, his own life he cannot preserve. If he is the king of Israel, let him now descend from the cross, and we will believe in him. † He trusted in God; let him rescue him now, if he hath pleasure in him: for he said, I am the Son of God. In like manner the marauders also, that were crucified with him, reproached him. And from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land, until the ninth hour. And about the ninth hour, Jesus cried with a loud voice and said: O God, O God; why hast thou forsaken me? And some of them that stood there, when they heard it, said: He calleth for Elijah. And immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink. But the rest said: Desist; we will see if Elijah will come to rescue him. Then Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit. And instantly, the curtain of the door of the temple was torn asunder, from the top to the bottom; and the earth shook; and the rocks rived; and graves were opened; and many bodies of saints who slept, arose, and came forth; and, after his resurrection, entered into the holy city, and appeared to many. And the centurion, and they that were with him guarding Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that occurred, feared greatly, and said: Verily, this was the Son of God. And many women were there, looking on from a distance; the same who had followed Jesus from Galilee, and had ministered to him. One of them was Mary of Magdala, also Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children. And when it was evening, there came a rich man of Ramath, whose name was a Joseph, who was also a disciple of Jesus. This man went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. And Pilate directed the body to be given him. And Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a winding-sheet of clean linen; and laid it in his new sepulchre, that was excavated in a rock. And he rolled a great stone against the door of the sepulchre, and departed: And there were present Mary of Magdala, and the other Mary, who sat over against the grave. And on the day that was next after the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate, and said to him: Our Lord, we remember that this deceiver said, while he was alive, After three days, I shall arise. Command, therefore to guard the sepulchre; until the third day; lest his disciples come and steal him away by night, and say to the people that he hath risen from the dead; and the last delusion be worse than the first. Pilate said to them: Ye have soldiers: go and guard it, as ye know how. And they went and set a guard to the sepulchre, and sealed the stone.

matthew 27:66.english: And when it was morning, the chief priests and the elders of the people held a council against Jesus, how they might put him to death. And they bound him, and carried him and delivered him up to Pilate, the president. Then Judas the betrayer, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, repented. And he went and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders; and said: I have sinned, by betraying innocent blood. And they said: What is that to us? See to it thyself. And he cast down the silver in the temple, and retiring, went and strangled himself And the chief priests took up the silver, and said: It is not lawful to put it into the treasury, because it is the price of blood. And they took counsel, and bought with it the potter's field, for a place to bury strangers. Wherefore that field is called the field of blood, unto this day. Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by the prophet, saying: I took the thirty shekels of silver, the price of the precious one, which they of the children of Israel had stipulated; and I gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord directed me. And Jesus stood before the president. And the resident asked him, and said to him: Art thou the king of the Jews? And Jesus said to him: Thou hast said. And when the chief priests and elders accused him, he made no reply. Then Pilate said to him: Hearest thou not how much they testify against thee? But he gave him no answer, not even one word: and therefore Pilate wondered greatly. And at each festival, the president was accustomed to release to the people one prisoner, such as they preferred. And they had then in bonds a noted prisoner, called Bar Abas. And when they were assembled, Pilate said to them: Whom will ye, that I release to you, Bar Abas, or Jesus who is called Messiah? For Pilate knew that it was from enmity they had delivered him up. And as the president was sitting on his tribunal, his wife sent to him, and said: Have thou nothing to do with that just man; for I have suffered much this I day in a dream because of him. But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitude that they should demand Bar Abas, and destroy Jesus. And the president answered, and said to them: Which of the two, will ye, that I release to you? And they said: Bar Abas. Pilate said to them: And what shall I do to Jesus who is called Messiah? They all replied: Let him be crucified. The president said to them: But what hath he done, that is evil? And they cried out the more, and said: Let him be crucified. And Pilate, when he saw that it availed nothing, but rather that tumult was produced, took water, and washed his hands before the eyes of the multitude, and said: I am pure from the blood of this just man: see ye to it. And all the people answered, and said His blood be on us, and on our children! Then released he to them Bar Abas; and scourged Jesus with whips and delivered him to be crucified. Then the soldiers of the president took Jesus into the Praetorium, and assembled the whole regiment against him. And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet military cloak. And they wove a crown of thorns, and set it on his head, and put a reed in his hand, and they bowed their knees before him, and mocked him, and said: Hail, thou king of the Jews. And they spit in his face, and took the reed, and smote him on his head. And when they had mocked him, they divested him of the cloak, and clothed him in his own garments, and led him out to be crucified. And as they went out, they found a man of Cyrene whose name was Simon; him they compelled to bear his cross. And they came to a place which is called Golgotha, which is interpreted a skull. And they gave him to drink vinegar mixed with gall. And he tasted it, and would not drink. And when they had crucified him, they distributed his garments by lot. And they sat down, and watched him there And they placed over his head the cause of his death, in the writing: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS. So also the chief priests mocked, with the Scribes and Elders and Pharisees, and said: He gave life to others, his own life he cannot preserve. If he is the king of Israel, let him now descend from the cross, and we will believe in him. † He trusted in God; let him rescue him now, if he hath pleasure in him: for he said, I am the Son of God. In like manner the marauders also, that were crucified with him, reproached him. And from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land, until the ninth hour. And about the ninth hour, Jesus cried with a loud voice and said: O God, O God; why hast thou forsaken me? And some of them that stood there, when they heard it, said: He calleth for Elijah. And immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink. But the rest said: Desist; we will see if Elijah will come to rescue him. Then Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit. And instantly, the curtain of the door of the temple was torn asunder, from the top to the bottom; and the earth shook; and the rocks rived; and graves were opened; and many bodies of saints who slept, arose, and came forth; and, after his resurrection, entered into the holy city, and appeared to many. matthew 28:1.english: And in the close evening of the sabbath, as the first day of the week began to dawn, came Mary of Magdala and the other Mary, to view the sepulchre.

matthew 28:2.english: And lo, there was a great earthquake: for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

matthew 28:3.english: And his aspect was like the lightning; and his raiment white like snow:

matthew 28:4.english: and from fear of him the keepers were astounded, and became as dead men.

matthew 28:5.english: And the angel answered, and said to the women: Be not ye afraid, for I know that ye seek Jesus who was crucified.

matthew 28:6.english: He is not here; for he is risen, as he predicted. Come ye, see the place where our Lord was laid.

matthew 28:7.english: And then go quickly, tell his disciples, that he is risen from the dead; and lo, he precedeth you to Galilee; there will ye see him. Behold, I have told you.

matthew 28:8.english: And they went quickly from the sepulchre, with fear and great joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

matthew 28:9.english: And lo, Jesus met them, and said to them: Hail, ye. And they came and clasped his feet, and worshipped him.

matthew 28:10.english: Then Jesus said to them: Be not afraid; but go, tell my brethren, that they go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

matthew 28:11.english: And while they were going, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all that had occurred.

matthew 28:12.english: And they assembled with the Elders, and held a council; and they gave no little money to the guards,

matthew 28:13.english: and said to them: Say ye, that his disciples came and stole him away by night, while we were asleep.

matthew 28:14.english: And if this should be reported before the President, we will pacify him, and cause you not to be troubled.

matthew 28:15.english: And they, having received the money, did as they were instructed. And this story is current among the Jews to this day.

matthew 28:16.english: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain which Jesus had appointed for them.

matthew 28:17.english: And when they beheld him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

matthew 28:18.english: And Jesus came near, and discoursed with them, and said to them: All authority is given to me, in heaven and on earth. And as my Father sent me, so also I send you.

matthew 28:19.english: Go ye, therefore, and instruct all nations; and baptize them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

matthew 28:20.english: And teach them to observe all that I have commanded you. And, behold, I am with you always, unto the consummation of the worlds Amen. Completion of the Holy Gospel as published by Matthew; and which he published in Hebrew, in the land of the Palestineans.

mark 1:1.english: THE beginning of the gospel of Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God.

mark 1:2.english: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, who shall prepare thy way.

mark 1:3.english: The voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare ye the way of the Lord; make smooth his paths.

mark 1:4.english: John baptized in the wilderness, and proclaimed the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

mark 1:5.english: And there went out to him all the region of Judaea, and all the people of Jerusalem; and he baptized them in the river Jordan, while they confessed their sins.

mark 1:6.english: And this John was clad in raiment of camels' hair; and was girded with a cincture of skin about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.

mark 1:7.english: And he proclaimed, and said: Behold, after me cometh one more powerful than I, of whom I am not worthy to stoop and untie the fastenings of his shoes.

mark 1:8.english: I have baptized you with water; but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.

mark 1:9.english: And it occurred, in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and was baptized in Jordan by John.

mark 1:10.english: And immediately on his coming from the water, he saw the heavens cleft, and the Spirit descending like a dove upon him.

mark 1:11.english: And there was a voice from the heavens: Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I delight.

mark 1:12.english: And directly the Spirit carried him into the wilderness:

mark 1:13.english: and he was there in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. And he was with the wild beasts; and angels ministered to him.

mark 1:14.english: After John was delivered up, Jesus came into Galilee, and proclaimed the tidings, of the kingdom of God,

mark 1:15.english: and said: The time is completed, and the kingdom of God is near. Repent ye, and believe the tidings.

mark 1:16.english: And as he walked near the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

mark 1:17.english: And Jesus said to them: Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.

mark 1:18.english: And immediately they left their nets, and went after him.

mark 1:19.english: And as he passed on a little, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in a ship, and mending their nets.

mark 1:20.english: And he called them: and immediately they left Zebedee their father in the ship, with the hired servants, and went after him.

mark 1:21.english: And when they entered Capernaum, he immediately taught on the sabbath in their synagogues.

mark 1:22.english: And they were astonished at his doctrine; for he taught them, as having authority, and not as their Scribes.

mark 1:23.english: And in their synagogue was a man, in whom was an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

mark 1:24.english: and said: What have we to do with thee? Jesus thou Nazarean. Hast thou come to destroy us? I know thee, who thou art, the Holy One of God.

mark 1:25.english: And Jesus rebuked him, and said: Shut thy mouth, and come out of him.

mark 1:26.english: And the unclean spirit threw him down, and cried with a loud voice, and came out of him.

mark 1:27.english: And they were all amazed, and inquired one of another, and said: What is this? What new doctrine is this? For with authority he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

mark 1:28.english: And immediately his fame spread into all the land of Galilee.

mark 1:29.english: And he retired from the synagogue, and entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

mark 1:30.english: And Simon's mother-in-law was lying sick with a fever: and they told him about her.

mark 1:31.english: And he came, and took her hand, and raised her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered to them.

mark 1:32.english: And in the evening at the setting of the sun, they brought to him all them that were diseased, and demoniacs.

mark 1:33.english: And all the city was collected at the door.
