mark 15:13.english: And they again cried out: Crucify him.

mark 15:14.english: And Pilate said to them: But what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more: Crucify him.

mark 15:15.english: And Pilate was willing to gratify the wishes of the multitudes; and he released to them Bar Abas; and, having scourged Jesus, he delivered him to them to be crucified.

mark 15:16.english: And the soldiers led him into the hall which was the Praetorium; and they called together the whole regiment;

mark 15:17.english: and they clothed him in purple, and braided a crown of thorns and put upon him;

mark 15:18.english: and began to salute him with, " Hail, king of the Jews!"

mark 15:19.english: And they smote him on the head with a reed and spit in his face, and bowed upon their knees and worshipped him.

mark 15:20.english: And having mocked him, they divested him of the purple, and clothed him in his own garments, and led him forth to crucify him.

mark 15:21.english: And they compelled a passer-by, Simon the Cyrenian, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was coming from the fields, to bear his cross.

mark 15:22.english: And they brought him to Golgotha, the place which is interpreted a Skull.

mark 15:23.english: And they gave him to drink wine in which myrrh was mixed; and he would not receive it.

mark 15:24.english: And when they had crucified him, they divided his garments; and cast the lot upon them, what each should take.

mark 15:25.english: And it was the third hour when they crucified him.

mark 15:26.english: And the cause of his death was written in the inscription: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

mark 15:27.english: And they crucified with him two robbers, the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

mark 15:28.english: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith: He was accounted among the wicked.

mark 15:29.english: And they also that passed by, reviled him; and, nodding their heads, they said: Aha, thou that destroyest the temple and buildest it in three days,

mark 15:30.english: rescue thyself, and come down from the cross.

mark 15:31.english: And so also the chief priests, jeering one with another, and the Scribes, said: He gave life to others, his own life he cannot save.

mark 15:32.english: Let Messiah, the king of the Jews, now descend from the cross, that we may see it and believe in him. And those also who were crucified with him, derided him.

mark 15:33.english: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

mark 15:34.english: And at the ninth hour, Jesus cried with a loud voice, and said: Il, Il, lemono shebakthone; that is: My God, my God; why hast thou forsaken me?

mark 15:35.english: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said: He calleth for Elijah.

mark 15:36.english: And one ran and filled a sponge with vinegar, and tied it on a reed, to offer him drink. And they said: Desist; let us see if Elijah will come to take him down.

mark 15:37.english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and expired.

mark 15:38.english: And the curtain of the door of the temple was rent, from the top to the bottom.

mark 15:39.english: And when the centurion, who was standing near him, saw that he so cried and expired, he said: Verily, this was the Son of God.

mark 15:40.english: And there were women looking on, from a distance, Mary Magdalena, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

mark 15:41.english: who, when he was in Galilee adhered to him, and ministered to him; and many other women, who had come up with him to Jerusalem.

mark 15:42.english: And, as it was the eve of preparation, which precedeth the sabbath,

mark 15:43.english: Joseph of Ramath, an honorable counsellor, who also himself waited for the kingdom of God, came, and assuming courage, went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

mark 15:44.english: And Pilate wondered that he should be already dead. And he called the centurion, and inquired if he had been any time dead.

mark 15:45.english: And when he learned it, he gave his body to Joseph.

mark 15:46.english: And Joseph bought fine linen, and took it down, and wrapped it in the linen, and deposited it in a sepulchre that was hewed in a rock, and rolled a stone against the door of the sepulchre.

mark 15:47.english: And Mary Magdalena and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was laid.

mark 16:1.english: And when the sabbath had passed, Mary Magdalena, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought aromatics, that they might come and anoint him.

mark 16:2.english: And in the morning of the first day of the week, they came to the sepulchre as the sun arose.

mark 16:3.english: And they said among them. selves: Who will roll back for us the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

mark 16:4.english: And they looked, and saw that the stone was rolled away; for it was very great.

mark 16:5.english: And entering the sepulchre, they saw a youth sitting on the right hand, and clothed in a white robe: and they were in perturbation.

mark 16:6.english: But he said to them: Be not affrighted. Ye are seeking Jesus the Nazarean, who was crucified. He is risen; he is not here. Behold the place where he was laid.

mark 16:7.english: But go, tell his disciples and Cephas: Lo, he precedeth you into Galilee; there will ye see him, as he said to you.

mark 16:8.english: And when they heard, they fled and left the sepulchre; for astonishment and trembling had seized them; and they said nothing to any one, for they were in fear.

mark 16:9.english: And in the morning of the first day of the week, he arose; and he appeared first to Mary Magdalena, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

mark 16:10.english: And she went and told them that had been with him, while they were mourning and weeping.

mark 16:11.english: And they, when they heard the women say that he was alive, and that he had appeared to them, did not believe them.

mark 16:12.english: After this he appeared, under another aspect, to two of them as they walked and went into the country.

mark 16:13.english: And these went and told the rest; but they would not believe them

mark 16:14.english: And at last, he appeared to the eleven: as they reclined at table; and he reproved the slenderness of their faith, and the hardness of their heart; because they believed not those who had seen him actually risen.

mark 16:15.english: And he said to them: Go ye into all the world, and proclaim my tidings in the whole creation.

mark 16:16.english: He that believeth, and is baptized, liveth; but he that believeth not, is condemned.

mark 16:17.english: And these signs shall attend them that believe: In my name, they will cast out demons; and in new tongues will they speak.

mark 16:18.english: And they will take up serpents; and if they should drink a deadly poison, it will not harm them; and they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be healed.

mark 16:19.english: And Jesus, our Lord, after he had conversed with them, ascended to heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

mark 16:20.english: And they went forth, and preached everywhere: and our Lord aided them, and confirmed their discourses by the signs which they wrought. Completion of the Holy Gospels, the announcement of Mark; which he uttered and proclaimed in Latin at Rome.

luke 1:1.english: SINCE many have been disposed to write narratives of those events, of which we have full assurance,

luke 1:2.english: as they delivered them to us, who from the first were eye-witnesses and ministers of the word;

luke 1:3.english: it seemed proper for me also, as I had examined them all accurately, to write out the whole, methodically, for thee, excellent Theophilus:

luke 1:4.english: that thou mayest know the truth of the statements, which thou hast been taught.

luke 1:5.english: In the days of Herod the king of Judaea, there was a certain priest, whose name was Zachariah, of the ministration of the house of Abijah; and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

luke 1:6.english: And they were both upright before God, and walked in all his commandments, and in the righteousness of the Lord, without reproach.

luke 1:7.english: But they had no child, because Elisabeth was barren: and they were both advanced in life.

luke 1:8.english: And it occurred, that as he performed the priestly functions in the order of his ministration before the Lord,

luke 1:9.english: according to the usage of the priesthood, it fell to him to offer the incense. And he went into the temple of the Lord,

luke 1:10.english: and the whole multitude of the people were praying without, at the time of incense.

luke 1:11.english: And the angel of the Lord appeared to Zachariah, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

luke 1:12.english: And when Zachariah saw him, he was agitated, and fear fell upon him.

luke 1:13.english: And the angel said to him: Fear not, Zachariah; for thy prayer is heard, and thy wife Elisabeth will bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

luke 1:14.english: And thou wilt have joy and gladness: and many will rejoice at his birth.

luke 1:15.english: For he will be great before the Lord; and he will not drink wine nor strong drink, and will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb.

luke 1:16.english: And many of the children of Israel will he convert to the Lord their God.

luke 1:17.english: And he will go before him, in the spirit and power of Elijah the prophet, and will turn the heart of the fathers unto the children, and them that are disobedient to the knowledge of the righteous, and will prepare a perfect people for the Lord.

luke 1:18.english: And Zachariah said to the angel: How shall I know this? For I am old, and my wife is advanced in life.

luke 1:19.english: The angel answered, and said to him: I am Gabriel, who stand before God; and I am sent to converse with thee, and to tell thee these things.

luke 1:20.english: Henceforth thou wilt be dumb, and unable to speak, until the day when these things take place: because thou believedst not my words, which will be fulfilled in their time.

luke 1:21.english: And the people were standing and waiting for Zachariah; and they wondered at his tarrying so long in the temple.

luke 1:22.english: And when Zachariah came forth, he could not speak with them: and they understood that he had seen a vision in the temple: and he made many signs to them, and remained speechless.

luke 1:23.english: And when the days of his ministration were accomplished, he came to his house.

luke 1:24.english: And it was after those days, that Elisabeth his wife conceived. And she secluded herself five months; and she said:

luke 1:25.english: These things hath the Lord done for me, in the days when he looked upon me to take away my reproach among men.

luke 1:26.english: And in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent by God into Galilee, to a city named Nazareth,

luke 1:27.english: to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

luke 1:28.english: And the angel entered the house, and said to her: Peace to thee, thou full of grace! The Lord is with thee: and blessed art thou among women.

luke 1:29.english: And when she saw him, she was agitated by his speech; and she pondered, what this salutation could mean.

luke 1:30.english: And the angel said to her: Fear not, Mary; for thou hast found favor with God.

luke 1:31.english: For lo, thou wilt conceive in thy womb, and wilt bear a son, and wilt call his name Jesus.

luke 1:32.english: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High, and the Lord God will give him the throne of his father David.

luke 1:33.english: And he will reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his reign there will be no end.

luke 1:34.english: And Mary said to the angel: How can this be, as I have not known a man?

luke 1:35.english: The angel replied, and said to her: The Holy Spirit will come, and the power of the Most High will overshadow thee; therefore he that is born of thee is holy, and will be called the Son of God.

luke 1:36.english: And lo, Elisabeth thy kinswoman, even she too hath conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who is called barren.

luke 1:37.english: Because nothing is difficult for God.

luke 1:38.english: Mary said: Behold, I am the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me, according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

luke 1:39.english: And Mary arose in those days, and went hastily to the mountain district, to a city of Judaea;

luke 1:40.english: and entered the house of Zachariah, and saluted Elisabeth.

luke 1:41.english: And it was so, that when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the child leaped in her womb, and she was filled with the Holy Spirit.

luke 1:42.english: And she cried out with a loud voice, and said to Mary: Blessed art thou among women; and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

luke 1:43.english: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

luke 1:44.english: For lo, as the voice of thy salutation fell upon my ears, with great joy the child leaped in my womb.

luke 1:45.english: And happy is she that believed; for there will be a fulfillment of those things that were told her by the Lord.

luke 1:46.english: And Mary said: My soul doth magnify the Lord:

luke 1:47.english: and my spirit rejoiceth in God the author of my life.

luke 1:48.english: For he hath looked upon the humble condition of his hand maid; and lo, henceforth all generations will ascribe blessedness to me.

luke 1:49.english: And He that is mighty hath done for me great things; and holy is his name.

luke 1:50.english: And his mercy is on them that fear him, for generations and posterities.

luke 1:51.english: He hath wrought victory with his arm; and hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their heart.

luke 1:52.english: He hath cast down the mighty from their thrones, and hath exalted the lowly.

luke 1:53.english: The hungry hath he satisfied with good things, and the rich hath he sent away empty.

luke 1:54.english: He hath aided Israel his servant, and remembered his mercy,

luke 1:55.english: (as he spoke with the fathers,) with Abraham and his seed, for ever.

luke 1:56.english: And Mary remained with Elisabeth about three months, and returned to her home.

luke 1:57.english: And Elisabeth's time of bringing forth arrived; and she bore a son.

luke 1:58.english: And her neighbors and relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy to her, and they rejoiced with her.

luke 1:59.english: And it occurred, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child. And they called him by the name of his father, Zachariah.

luke 1:60.english: And his mother answered and said: Not so; but John, shall he be called.

luke 1:61.english: And they said to her: There is no one among thy kindred called by that name.

luke 1:62.english: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him named.

luke 1:63.english: And he asked for a tablet, and wrote, and said: John is his name. And every one was surprised.

luke 1:64.english: And immediately his mouth was opened, and his tongue; and he spoke, and praised God.

luke 1:65.english: And fear came upon all their neighbors; and these things were talked of in all the mountain district of Judaea.

luke 1:66.english: And all who heard, pondered them in their heart, and said: What will this child be? And the hand of the Lord was with him.

luke 1:67.english: And Zachariah his father was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, and said:

luke 1:68.english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who hath visited his people, and wrought redemption for them:

luke 1:69.english: And hath raised up a horn of redemption for us, in the house of David his servant:

luke 1:70.english: as he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, who were of old,

luke 1:71.english: that he would redeem us from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us.

luke 1:72.english: And he hath exercised his mercy to our fathers, and hath remembered his holy covenants,

luke 1:73.english: and the oath that he sware to Abraham our father, that he would grant to us,

luke 1:74.english: to be redeemed from the hand of our enemies; and that we should worship before him, without fear,

luke 1:75.english: all our days, in rectitude and uprightness.

luke 1:76.english: And thou, child, wilt be called a prophet of the Most High; for thou wilt go before the face of the Lord, to prepare his way,

luke 1:77.english: that he may give the knowledge of life to his people, and forgiveness of their sins,

luke 1:78.english: through the compassion of the mercy of our God; whereby the day-spring from on high will visit us,

luke 1:79.english: to give light to them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death; and to guide our feet into the way of peace.

luke 1:80.english: And the child grew, and was strengthened in spirit. And he was in the wilderness, until the day of his manifestation to Israel.

luke 2:1.english: And in those days it occurred, that a decree went forth from Augustus Caesar, that all the people of his dominion should be enrolled.

luke 2:2.english: And this enrollment was first made under the presidency of Quirinus in Syria.

luke 2:3.english: And everyone went to his own city to be enrolled.

luke 2:4.english: And Joseph also went up from Nazareth of Galilee to Judaea, to the city of David which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David,

luke 2:5.english: with Mary his espoused, then pregnant, to be enrolled.

luke 2:6.english: And it was while they were there, that the days for her to bring forth were completed.

luke 2:7.english: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in bandages, and laid him in the stall; for they had no place where they could lodge.

luke 2:8.english: And there were shepherds in that region, who abode there and kept watch of their flocks by night.

luke 2:9.english: And lo, the angel of God came to them, and the glory of the Lord shone upon them: and they feared with great fear.

luke 2:10.english: And the angel said to them: Fear not; for, behold I announce to you great joy, which will be to all the world.

luke 2:11.english: For there is born to you this day a deliverer, who is the Lord Messiah, in the city of David

luke 2:12.english: And this is the sign for you: Ye will find the babe wrapped in bandages, and placed in a stall.

luke 2:13.english: And instantly there were seen with the angel, the many hosts of heaven, praising God, and saying:

luke 2:14.english: Glory to God in the highest heavens, and on earth peace and good hope for men.

luke 2:15.english: And it was so, that when the angels had gone from them into heaven, the shepherds conferred with one another, and said: Let us go down to Bethlehem, and see this thing which hath occurred, as the Lord hath made known to us.

luke 2:16.english: And they came hastily, and found Mary and Joseph, and the babe laid in the stall.

luke 2:17.english: And when they saw, they made known the information which was given to them concerning the child.

luke 2:18.english: And all that heard, wondered at the things that were told them by the shepherds.

luke 2:19.english: And Mary laid up all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

luke 2:20.english: And the shepherds returned glorifying and praising God for all that they had seen and heard, as it was told them.

luke 2:21.english: And when the eight days for the circumcision of the child were completed, his name was called JESUS; as he was named by the angel, before he was conceived in the womb

luke 2:22.english: And when the days of their purification were completed, according to the law of Moses, they carried him to Jerusalem, to present him before the Lord:

luke 2:23.english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, that every male opening the womb shall be called holy to the Lord:)

luke 2:24.english: and to offer a sacrifice, according as it is written in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtle-doves, or two young pigeons.

luke 2:25.english: And there was a certain man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon. This man was upright and just, and was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

luke 2:26.english: And it had been told him by the Holy Spirit, that he would not see death, until he should see the Messiah of the Lord.

luke 2:27.english: This man came, by the Spirit, into the temple; and when his parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him as is commanded in the law,

luke 2:28.english: he took him in his arms, and blessed God, and said:

luke 2:29.english: My Lord, now release thou thy servant in peace, as thou hast said:

luke 2:30.english: for lo, my eyes have seen thy mercy,

luke 2:31.english: which thou hast prepared in the presence of all nations,

luke 2:32.english: a light for a revelation to the Gentiles, and a glory for thy people Israel.

luke 2:33.english: And Joseph and his mother were astonished at those things which were spoken concerning him.

luke 2:34.english: And Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary his mother: Behold, this child is set forth for the fall and for the rising of many in Israel, and for a standard of contention;

luke 2:35.english: (and also a dart will pierce thy own soul); that the thoughts of the hearts of many may be disclosed.

luke 2:36.english: And Hanna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, she also was aged in days, and, from her maidenhood, had lived seven years with her husband,

luke 2:37.english: and was a widow of about eighty and four years, and departed not from the temple, but worshipped by day and by night with fasting and prayer;

luke 2:38.english: and she too stood up, in that hour, and gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to every one that waited for the redemption of Jerusalem.

luke 2:39.english: And when they had accomplished all things, according to the law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their city Nazareth.

luke 2:40.english: And the child grew, and was strengthened in spirit, and was filled with wisdom; and the grace of God was upon him.

luke 2:41.english: And his people went up to Jerusalem every year, at the feast of the passover.

luke 2:42.english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to the feast, as they were accustomed.

luke 2:43.english: And when the days were completed, they returned: but the child Jesus remained at Jerusalem, and Joseph and his mother knew not of it;

luke 2:44.english: for they supposed he was with his companions. And when they had travelled a day's journey, they sought him among their people, and inquired of every one that knew them.

luke 2:45.english: And they did not find him. And they returned again to Jerusalem, searching for him.

luke 2:46.english: And after three days, they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, and listening to them, and asking them questions.

luke 2:47.english: And all they that heard him, were astonished at his wisdom and his answers.

luke 2:48.english: And when they saw him they were amazed. And his mother said to him: My son, why hast thou done so to us? For lo, I and thy father have been seeking for thee with great anxiety.

luke 2:49.english: He said to them: Why did ye seek me? Do ye not know, that it behooveth me to be in my Father's house?

luke 2:50.english: But they did not comprehend the word that he spoke to them.

luke 2:51.english: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was obedient to them. And his mother laid up all these things in her heart.

luke 2:52.english: And Jesus increased in stature, and in wisdom, and in grace, before God and men.

luke 3:1.english: And in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, in the presidency of Pontius Pilate in Judaea, while Herod was Tetrarch in Galilee, and Philip his brother Tetrarch in Ituraea and in the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias Tetrarch of Abilene,

luke 3:2.english: in the high priesthood of Annas and of Caiaphas; the word of God was upon John the son of Zachariah, in the wilderness.

luke 3:3.english: And he came into all the region about the Jordan, proclaiming the baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

luke 3:4.english: As it is written in the book of the discourses of Isaiah the prophet, who said: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord; and make straight paths in the plain for our God.

luke 3:5.english: All valleys shall be filled up, and all mountains and hills be lowered; and the hillock shall be levelled down, and the rough place become smooth.

luke 3:6.english: And all flesh shall see the life which is of God.

luke 3:7.english: And he said to the multitudes, who came to him to be baptized: Ye progeny of vipers, who hath instructed you to flee from the future wrath?

luke 3:8.english: Bring forth, therefore, fruits comporting, with repentance. And begin not to say in yourselves: We have Abraham for our father; for I say to you, that God can, from these stones, raise up sons to Abraham.

luke 3:9.english: And lo, the ax is put to the root of trees. Every tree therefore that beareth not good fruits, is hewed down, and falleth into the fire.

luke 3:10.english: And the multitudes asked him, and said: What, then, shall we do?

luke 3:11.english: He answered and said to them: Whoever hath two tunics, let him give one to him that hath none; and whoever hath food, let him do the same.

luke 3:12.english: And publicans also came to be baptized. And they said to him: Teacher, what shall we do?

luke 3:13.english: And he said to them: Exact no more than ye are required to exact.

luke 3:14.english: And those serving in war inquired of him, and said: And what shall we do? He said to them: Be insolent to no one, and oppress no one, and let your pay satisfy you.

luke 3:15.english: And while the people were thinking of John, and all pondered in their heart, whether he were the Messiah;

luke 3:16.english: John answered and said to them: Behold, I baptize you with water; but after me cometh one mightier than I, the strings of whose shoes I am not worthy to untie; he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

luke 3:17.english: He holdeth his winnowing shovel in his hand, and he will make clean his threshing floor; and the wheat he gathereth into his garners, and the chaff he will burn with fire not extinguished.

luke 3:18.english: And many other things also, he taught and proclaimed to the people.

luke 3:19.english: But Herod the Tetrarch, because he was reproved by John, on account of Herodias the wife of his brother Philip, and on account of all the evil things he had done,

luke 3:20.english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

luke 3:21.english: And it occurred, when all the people were baptized, that Jesus also was baptized. And as he prayed, the heavens were opened;

luke 3:22.english: and the Holy Spirit descended upon him, in the bodily likeness of a dove: and there was a voice from heaven, which said: Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I have delight.

luke 3:23.english: And Jesus was about thirty years old. And he was accounted the son of Joseph, the son of Heli,

luke 3:24.english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Janna, the son of Joseph,

luke 3:25.english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

luke 3:26.english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Shimei, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

luke 3:27.english: the son of Joanna, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zorubbabel, the son of Salathiel, the son of Neri,

luke 3:28.english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

luke 3:29.english: the son of Joses, the son of Eliezer, the son of Joram, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

luke 3:30.english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,

luke 3:31.english: the son of Melcah, the son of Mainan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

luke 3:32.english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon

luke 3:33.english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Pharez, the son of Judah

luke 3:34.english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

luke 3:35.english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Salah,

luke 3:36.english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

luke 3:37.english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mehalaleel, the son of Cainan,

luke 3:38.english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

luke 4:1.english: And Jesus, being full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan. And the Spirit led him into the wilderness,

luke 4:2.english: forty days, to be tempted by the Calumniator. And during those days, he ate nothing; and when he had completed them, he was at last hungry.

luke 4:3.english: And the Calumniator said to him: If thou art the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.

luke 4:4.english: Jesus replied, and said to him: It is written, Not by bread only, doth man live; but by every thing of God.

luke 4:5.english: And Satan conducted him to a high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the land, in a little time.

luke 4:6.english: And the Calumniator said to him: To thee will I give all this dominion, and the glory of it, which is committed to me, and to whom I please, I give it:

luke 4:7.english: if therefore thou wilt worship before me, the whole shall be thine.

luke 4:8.english: But Jesus replied, and said to him: It is written Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

luke 4:9.english: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said to him: If thou art the Son of God, cast thyself down hence:

luke 4:10.english: for it is written, He will give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

luke 4:11.english: and in their arms will they sustain thee, lest thou strike thy foot against a stone.

luke 4:12.english: And Jesus replied and said to him: It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

luke 4:13.english: And when the Calumniator had finished all his temptations, he departed from him for a time.

luke 4:14.english: And Jesus returned, in the power of the Spirit, to Galilee; and fame concerning him spread in all the region around them.

luke 4:15.english: And he taught in their synagogues, and was lauded by every one.

luke 4:16.english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and he went, as he was accustomed, into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and rose up to read.

luke 4:17.english: And there was delivered to him the book of Isaiah the prophet. And Jesus opened the book, and found the place where it is written:

luke 4:18.english: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me; and therefore he hath anointed me to proclaim tidings to the poor; and hath sent me to heal the contrite in heart, and to proclaim release to the captives, and sight to the blind; and to send away the contrite with forgiveness of their sins;

luke 4:19.english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.

luke 4:20.english: And he rolled up the book, and gave it to the servitor, and went and sat down. And the eyes of all in the synagogue were gazing upon him.

luke 4:21.english: And he began to say to them: This day, is this scripture which ye have heard, fulfilled.

luke 4:22.english: And all bare him witness, and admired the gracious words which proceeded from his mouth; and they said: Is not this the son of Joseph?

luke 4:23.english: Jesus said to them: Perhaps, ye will speak to me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: and whatever we have heard of thy doing in Capernaum, do thou here also in thy city.

luke 4:24.english: And he said to them: Verily I say to you, There is no prophet who is acceptable in his own city.

luke 4:25.english: And I tell you the truth, that there were many widows in the house of Israel, in the days of Elijah the prophet, when the heavens were closed up three years and six months, and there was a great famine in all the land:

luke 4:26.english: but to no one of them was Elijah sent, except to Sarepta of Sidon, unto a widow woman.

luke 4:27.english: And there were many leprous in the house of Israel, in the days of Elisha the prophet; but none of them was cleansed, except Naaman the Syrian.

luke 4:28.english: And when they heard these things, those in the synagogue were all filled with wrath.

luke 4:29.english: And they rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and brought him to the top of the hill on which the city was built, that they might cast him down from the rock.

luke 4:30.english: But he passed through the midst of them, and went away.

luke 4:31.english: And he went down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee; and taught them on sabbath days.

luke 4:32.english: And they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was authoritative.

luke 4:33.english: And there was in the synagogue a man, in whom was an unclean demon: and he cried out, with a loud voice,

luke 4:34.english: and said: Let me alone: What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Nazarean? Hast thou come to destroy us? I know thee, who thou art, the Holy One of God.

luke 4:35.english: And Jesus rebuked him, and said: Shut thy mouth; and come out of him. And the demon threw him down in the midst, and came out of him, having not harmed him at all.

luke 4:36.english: And wonder seized every one, and they talked together, and said: What a word is this! For, with authority and efficiency, he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out

luke 4:37.english: And his fame went out into all the surrounding region.

luke 4:38.english: And when Jesus went out of the synagogue, he entered the house of Simon. And the mother-in-law of Simon was afflicted with a severe fever: and they besought him in her behalf.

luke 4:39.english: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. And immediately she arose and ministered to them.

luke 4:40.english: And when the sun was set, all those that had sick persons, afflicted with divers diseases, brought them to him; and he laid his hand on every one of them, and healed them.

luke 4:41.english: And demons went out of many, crying out and saying: Thou art the Messiah, the Son of God. And he rebuked them, and suffered them not to say, that they knew him to be Messiah.

luke 4:42.english: And at the dawn of day, he went out and retired to a desert place. And the multitudes sought him, and went out to him, and held him fast, that he might not retire from them.

luke 4:43.english: And Jesus said to them: It behooveth me to announce the kingdom of God to other cities also; for therefore was I sent.

luke 4:44.english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

luke 5:1.english: And it occurred, that a multitude gathered about him, to hear the word of God. And he was standing by the side of the sea of Gennesaret,

luke 5:2.english: and he saw two ships standing near the sea, and the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

luke 5:3.english: And one of them belonged to Simon Cephas: and Jesus entered and sat in it. And he told them to draw off a little from the shore, into the sea: and he seated himself, and taught the multitude from the ship.

luke 5:4.english: And when he ceased from speaking, he said to Simon: Launch out into the deep, and cast your net for a draught.

luke 5:5.english: Simon answered, and said to him: Rabbi, all the night we have toiled, and have caught nothing: but, at thy bidding, I will cast the net.

luke 5:6.english: And when they had done so, they inclosed very many fishes, so that the net was rent.

luke 5:7.english: And they made signs to their associates, in the other ship, to come and help them. And when they came, they filled both the ships, so that they were near to sinking.

luke 5:8.english: And when Simon Cephas saw it, he fell before the feet of Jesus, and said to him: I beseech thee, my Lord, that thou leave me, for I am a sinful man.

luke 5:9.english: For astonishment had seized him, and all that were with him, at the draught of fishes which they had caught:

luke 5:10.english: and in like manner also James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were partners of Simon. But Jesus said: Fear thou not; henceforth thou shalt catch men unto life.

luke 5:11.english: And they brought the vessels to the land: and they left all and followed him.

luke 5:12.english: And when Jesus was in one of the cities, a man came all full of leprosy and seeing Jesus, he fell upon his face, and besought him, and said to him: My Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst cleanse me.

luke 5:13.english: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, and said to him: I will it; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy went from him.

luke 5:14.english: And he charged him: Speak to no one; but go and show thyself to the priests, and offer the oblation for thy purification, as Moses hath commanded, for a testimony to them.

luke 5:15.english: And his fame spread abroad still more: and much people assembled to hear him, and to be cured of their diseases.

luke 5:16.english: And he retired into a desert, and prayed.

luke 5:17.english: And it occurred, on one of the days when Jesus was teaching, that Pharisees and Doctors of the law were sitting by, who had come from all the villages of Galilee and of Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

luke 5:18.english: And some persons brought a paralytic man, on a couch, and sought to bring him in, and to place him before him.

luke 5:19.english: And when they could not thus introduce him, because of the multitude of the people, they ascended to the roof, and let him down with the couch, from the covering, into the midst, before Jesus.

luke 5:20.english: And when Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic: Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

luke 5:21.english: And the Scribes and Pharisees began to reason, and to say: Who is this that speaketh blasphemy? Who can forgive sins, but God only?

luke 5:22.english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them: What think ye in your heart?

luke 5:23.english: Which is the easier, to say, Thy sins are forgiven thee, or to say, Arise and walk?

luke 5:24.english: But that ye may know, that the Son of man is competent to forgive sins on the earth, he said to the paralytic: I say to thee, Arise, take up thy couch, and go to thy home.

luke 5:25.english: And instantly, he rose up before their eyes, and took up his couch, and went home, glorifying God.

luke 5:26.english: And astonishment seized every one; and they Praised God; and they were filled with awe, and said: We have seen wonders today.

luke 5:27.english: And after these things, Jesus went out and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting among the publicans; and he said to him: Come after me.

luke 5:28.english: And he left every thing, and arose, and went after him.

luke 5:29.english: And Levi made a great entertainment for him at his house; and there was a numerous company of publicans and others who reclined with them.

luke 5:30.english: And the Scribes and Pharisees murmured, and said to his disciples: Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

luke 5:31.english: And Jesus answered and said to them: A physician is not sought after for the well, but for those very sick.

luke 5:32.english: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.

luke 5:33.english: And they said to him: Why do the disciples of John fast often, and pray, and also those of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

luke 5:34.english: And he said to them: Ye cannot make the guests of the nuptial chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them.

luke 5:35.english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom will be taken up from them, and then will they fast, in those days.

luke 5:36.english: And he spoke a similitude to them: No one teareth a patch from a new garment, and putteth it to an old garment; lest he tear the new, and the patch from the new cease to make the old garment whole.

luke 5:37.english: And no one putteth new wine into old sacks; otherwise, the new wine will burst the sacks, and the wine will run out, and the sacks be ruined.

luke 5:38.english: But they put new wine into new sacks, and both are preserved.

luke 5:39.english: And no one drinketh old wine, and immediately calleth for new; for he saith, The old is the delicious.

luke 6:1.english: And on a sabbath it occurred, as Jesus walked among the tilled grounds, that his disciples plucked ears, and rubbed them in their hands and ate.

luke 6:2.english: And some of the Pharisees said to them: Why do ye that, which it is not lawful to do on the sabbath?

luke 6:3.english: Jesus replied, and said to them: Have ye not read what David did, when he was hungry, he and those with him?

luke 6:4.english: How he entered into the house of God, and took and ate the bread of the Lord's table, and gave it to those that were with him; which it was not lawful, except for the priests only, to eat?

luke 6:5.english: And he said to them: The Son of man is lord of the sabbath.

luke 6:6.english: And on another sabbath, he entered a synagogue and taught. And a man was there, whose right hand was withered.

luke 6:7.english: And the Scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath; that they might be able to accuse him.

luke 6:8.english: And as he knew their thoughts, he said to the man with a withered hand: Rise and come into the midst of the congregation. And when he came and stood there,

luke 6:9.english: Jesus said to them: I ask you, What is it lawful to do on the sabbath? that which is good? or that which is evil? to save life or to destroy it?

luke 6:10.english: And he looked upon them all; and then said to him, Stretch forth thy hand. And he stretched out his hand, and it was restored like the other.

luke 6:11.english: And they were filled with envy; and they conferred one with another, what they should do to Jesus.

luke 6:12.english: And in those days, Jesus retired to a mountain to pray; and he passed the night there, in prayer to God.

luke 6:13.english: And when the day dawned, he called his disciples, and selected from them twelve, whom he named Legates :

luke 6:14.english: Simon whom he named Cephas, and Andrew his brother, and James, and John, and Philip, and Bartholomew,

luke 6:15.english: and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alpheus, and Simon who was called Zelotes,

luke 6:16.english: and Judas the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

luke 6:17.english: And Jesus descended with them, and stood in the plain; and a great company of his disciples, and a multitude of assembled people, from all Judaea, and from Jerusalem and from the seashore of Tyre and Sidon; who came to hear his discourse, and to be healed of their diseases;

luke 6:18.english: and they who were afflicted by unclean spirits: and they were healed.

luke 6:19.english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him; for there went a virtue out of him and healed them all.

luke 6:20.english: And he lifted his eyes upon his disciples, and said: Blessed are ye poor; for the kingdom of God is yours.

luke 6:21.english: Blessed are ye that hunger now; for ye will be satisfied. Blessed are ye that weep now; for ye will laugh.

luke 6:22.english: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and repel you, and revile you, and cast out your names as base, for the Son of man's sake.

luke 6:23.english: Rejoice in that day and exult, for your reward is great in heaven; for so did their fathers to the prophets.

luke 6:24.english: But, woe to you that are rich; for ye have received your consolation.

luke 6:25.english: Woe to you that are full; for ye will hunger. Woe to you that laugh now, for ye will weep and mourn.

luke 6:26.english: Woe to you, when men shall speak your praise; for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

luke 6:27.english: And to you who hear, I say: Love your enemies; and do favors to them that hate you;

luke 6:28.english: and bless them that curse you; and pray for them that drag you with violence.

luke 6:29.english: To him that smiteth thee on thy cheek, offer the other: and from him that taketh away thy cloak, keep not back thy tunic.

luke 6:30.english: To every one that asketh of thee, give thou: and from him that taketh thy property, demand it not.

luke 6:31.english: And as ye would that men should do to you, so do ye also to them.

luke 6:32.english: For, if ye love them that love you, what goodness is it in you? For even sinners love those that love them.

luke 6:33.english: And if ye do good to them that do good to you, what goodness is it in you? For even sinners do the same.

luke 6:34.english: And if ye lend to one from whom ye expect recompense, what goodness is it in you? For sinners also lend to sinners, to receive adequate recompense.

luke 6:35.english: But love ye your enemies, and do them good; and lend ye, and disappoint the hopes of no one: and great will be your reward, and ye will be children of the Highest; for he is kind to the evil, and to the unthankful.

luke 6:36.english: Be ye therefore merciful, as also your Father is merciful.

luke 6:37.english: Judge not, and ye will not be judged: condemn not, and ye will not be condemned: release, and ye will be released.

luke 6:38.english: Give ye, and it will be given to you; in good measure, pressed down, and running over, will they cast into your lap. For, with what measure ye measure, it will be measured to you.

luke 6:39.english: And he spake a similitude to them: Can a blind man lead a blind? Will not both fall into the ditch?

luke 6:40.english: No disciple is better than his teacher; for whoever is perfect, will be like his teacher.

luke 6:41.english: And why observest thou the straw that is in thy brother's eye, but regardest not the beam that is in thy own eye?

luke 6:42.english: Or how canst thou say to thy brothers, My brother, allow me to pluck the straw from thy eye; when, lo, the beam that is in thy own eye, thou regardest not. Hypocrite! first cast the beam out thy eye, and then thy vision will be clear to pluck the straw from thy brother's eye.

luke 6:43.english: There is no good tree, that beareth bad fruits; nor a bad tree, that beareth good fruits.

luke 6:44.english: For every tree is known by its fruits. Do men gather figs from thorn-bushes? So, neither do they pluck grapes from brambles.

luke 6:45.english: A good man, from the good treasure that is in his heart, bringeth out good things: and a bad man, from the bad treasure that is in his heart, bringeth out bad things. For, from the abundance of the heart, the lips speak.

luke 6:46.english: And why call ye me, My Lord, my Lord; while ye do not that which I command you?

luke 6:47.english: Every one that cometh to me, and heareth my words, and doeth them, I will show to whom he is like:

luke 6:48.english: He is like a man that built a house; and he dug and went deep, and laid the foundations on a rock: and when a flood occurred, the flood rushed upon that house, and could not move it, for its foundation rested on a rock.

luke 6:49.english: But he that heareth and doeth not, is like a man that built his house upon the earth, without a foundation; and when the torrent rushed upon it, it fell immediately, and the ruin of that house was great.

luke 7:1.english: And when he had finished all these discourses in the audience of the people, Jesus entered into Capernaum.

luke 7:2.english: And the servant of a centurion, who was dear to him, was very sick, and near to death.

luke 7:3.english: And he heard of Jesus, and sent the Elders of the Jews to him, and requested of him that he would come and save the life of his servant.

luke 7:4.english: And when they came to Jesus, they entreated him earnestly, and said: He is worthy that thou shouldst do this for him;

luke 7:5.english: for he loveth our nation, and hath also built us a house of assembly.

luke 7:6.english: And Jesus went with them. And when he was not far from the house, the centurion sent his friends to him, and said to him: My Lord, trouble not thyself, for I am not worthy that thou shouldst come under my roof:

luke 7:7.english: therefore I deemed myself not worthy to approach thee myself; but speak the word only, and my young man will be healed.

luke 7:8.english: For I also am a man subjected to authority; and I have soldiers under my command; and I say to this one, Go; and he goeth: and to another, Come; and he cometh: and to my servant, Do this; and he doeth it.

luke 7:9.english: And when Jesus heard these things, he admired him; and he turned, and said to the throng that followed him: I say to you, I have not found faith like this even in Israel.

luke 7:10.english: And they that were sent, returned to the house; and they found the servant that had been sick, now well.

luke 7:11.english: And the following day, he went to a city called Nain; and his disciples were with him, and a great multitude.

luke 7:12.english: And as he approached the gate of the city, he saw a procession bearing a dead man, the only son of his mother, and she a widow; and a great company of the people of the city were with her.

luke 7:13.english: And Jesus looked upon her, and had compassion on her; and he said to her, Weep not.

luke 7:14.english: And he went, and touched the bier; and they that bore him stood still. And he said: Young man, I say to thee, Arise.

luke 7:15.english: And the dead man sat up, and began to speak: and he delivered him to his mother.

luke 7:16.english: And awe seized all the people; and they glorified God, and said: A great prophet hath arisen among us, and God hath visited his people.

luke 7:17.english: And that saying respecting him went out through all Judaea and all the surrounding region.

luke 7:18.english: And the disciples of John told him all these things.

luke 7:19.english: And John called two of his disciples, and sent them to Jesus, and said: Art thou he that cometh, or shall we look for another?

luke 7:20.english: And they came to Jesus, and said to him: John the Baptizer hath sent us to thee, and saith: Art thou he that cometh, or shall we look for another?

luke 7:21.english: And in that hour he healed many persons of their diseases, and of plagues, and of unclean spirits, and gave sight to many blind persons.

luke 7:22.english: And Jesus replied, and said to them: Go ye, and tell John all that ye have seen and heard; that the blind see, and the lame walk, and the leprous are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead arise, and to the poor good news is proclaimed:

luke 7:23.english: and blessed is he that is not stumbled in me.

luke 7:24.english: And when John's disciples were gone, Jesus began to say to the multitude, concerning John: What went ye into the wilderness to see? a reed agitated by the wind?

luke 7:25.english: Or if not; what went ye out to see? a man clad in soft raiment? Lo, they that use splendid garments and luxuries, are in kings' palaces.

luke 7:26.english: Or if not; what went ye out to see? a prophet? Yea, say I to you; and more than a prophet.

luke 7:27.english: For this is he, of whom it is written: Behold I send my messenger before thy face, to prepare thy way before thee.

luke 7:28.english: I say to you, that no prophet, among those born of women, was greater than John the Baptizer: and yet the little one in the kingdom of God, is greater than he.

luke 7:29.english: And all the people that heard him, justified God, as they had been baptized with John's baptism.

luke 7:30.english: But the Pharisees and Scribes rejected the good pleasure of God, against themselves; as they were not baptized by him.

luke 7:31.english: To what, therefore, shall I compare this generation? and to what are they like?

luke 7:32.english: They are like children, that sit in the market-place, and call to their fellows and say: We have piped to you, and ye did not dance; we have howled to you, and ye did not weep.

luke 7:33.english: For John the Baptizer came, not eating bread, and not drinking wine; and ye say: He hath a demon.

luke 7:34.english: The Son of man came, eating and drinking; and ye say: Behold, a gluttonous man, and a wine drinker, and one fond of publicans and sinners.

luke 7:35.english: But wisdom is justified by all her children.

luke 7:36.english: And one of the Pharisees came, and asked him to eat with him. And he entered the house of the Pharisee, and reclined.

luke 7:37.english: And there was a woman in the city, who was a sinner; and when she learned that he reclined in the Pharisee's house, she took an alabaster box of perfume,

luke 7:38.english: and stood behind him, at his feet, and wept; and she began to bathe his feet with her tears, and to wipe them with the hair of her head; and she kissed his feet, and anointed them with the perfume.

luke 7:39.english: And when the Pharisee that invited him, saw it, he thought within himself, and said: If this man were a prophet, he would know who she is, and what is her reputation; for the woman that toucheth him, is a sinner.

luke 7:40.english: And Jesus answered, and said to him: Simon, I have something to say to thee. He said to him: Say it, Rabbi. Jesus said to him:

luke 7:41.english: There were two debtors to a certain creditor; the one owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty denarii.

luke 7:42.english: And as they had not the means of pay, he released them both. Which of them, therefore will love him most?

luke 7:43.english: Simon replied, and said: I suppose he to whom most was released. Jesus said to him: Thou hast judged correctly.

luke 7:44.english: And he turned to the woman, and said to Simon: Seest thou this woman? I entered thy house, and thou gavest me no water for my feet; but she hath bathed my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.

luke 7:45.english: Thou gavest me no kiss; but this woman, since she came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

luke 7:46.english: Thou didst not anoint my head with perfume; but she hath anointed my feet with perfumed ointment.

luke 7:47.english: I therefore say to thee: Her many sins are forgiven her, for she loveth much. But he, to whom little is forgiven, loveth little.

luke 7:48.english: And he said to the woman: Thy sins are forgiven thee.

luke 7:49.english: And they that were reclining, began to say in themselves: Who is this, that even forgiveth sins?

luke 7:50.english: And Jesus said to the woman: Thy faith hath given thee life. Go, in peace.

luke 8:1.english: And after these things Jesus travelled about the cities and the villages, and proclaimed and announced the kingdom of God. And with him were his twelve disciples,

luke 8:2.english: and those women who were healed of infirmities and of unclean spirits, Mary called Magdalena, out of whom went seven demons,

luke 8:3.english: and Joanna the wife of Chusa, Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, who ministered to them of their property.

luke 8:4.english: And when a great multitude was assembled, and people came to him from all the cities, he said, in similitudes:

luke 8:5.english: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the side of the path, and was trodden upon, and a bird devoured it.

luke 8:6.english: And other fell upon a rock, and sprung up forthwith; but, as it lacked moisture, it dried up.

luke 8:7.english: And other fell among thorns, and the thorns sprung up with it, and choked it.

luke 8:8.english: And other fell on good and fair ground, and sprung up, and bore fruits, a hundred for one. Having said these things, he cried: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

luke 8:9.english: And his disciples asked him: what meaneth this similitude?

luke 8:10.english: And he said to them: To you it is given, to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God; but to others, it is spoken in allegories; that, while seeing, they may not see, and while hearing, may not understand.

luke 8:11.english: But this is the similitude: The seed is the word of God.

luke 8:12.english: And those by the side of the path, are they that hear the word, and the enemy cometh and taketh the word out of their heart, that they may not believe and live.

luke 8:13.english: And those upon the rock, are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy: but they have no root in them, and their faith is temporary, and in time of temptation they are stumbled.

luke 8:14.english: And that which fell among thorns, are those who hear the word, but are choked by cares, and by riches, and by worldly desires, and bear no fruits.

luke 8:15.english: And that on good ground, are those who, with a humble and good heart, hear the word, and retain it, and with patience bring forth fruits.

luke 8:16.english: No one lighteth a lamp, and covereth it with a vessel, or placeth it under a bed, but setteth it upon a light-stand, that all who come in, may see the light of it.

luke 8:17.english: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be uncovered; nor concealed, that shall not be known and become manifest.

luke 8:18.english: Take heed how ye hear: for to him that hath, shall be given; and from him that hath not, shall be taken even what he thinketh he hath.

luke 8:19.english: And his mother and his brothers came to him, and they could not speak with him, because of the multitude.

luke 8:20.english: And they say to him: Thy mother and thy brothers stand without, and wish to see thee.

luke 8:21.english: And he answered and said: My mother and my brothers, are they who hear the word of God, and do it.

luke 8:22.english: And on a certain day Jesus embarked and sat in a ship, he and his disciples. And he said to them; Let us pass over to the other side of the sea.

luke 8:23.english: And while they were rowing, Jesus fell asleep. And there was a tempest of wind on the sea; and the ship was near to sinking.

luke 8:24.english: And they came and awaked him, and said to him: Our Rabbi, our Rabbi, we are perishing! And he arose, and rebuked the winds and the agitations of the water; and they ceased, and there was a calm.

luke 8:25.english: And he said to them: Where is your faith? And they being in awe, wondered, and said one to another: Who is this, that commandeth even the winds, and the waves, and the sea; and they obey him?

luke 8:26.english: And they rowed on, and came to the country of the Gadarenes, which lieth over against Galilee.

luke 8:27.english: And when he went out upon the land, there, met him a man of the city, in whom had been a demon for a long time; and he wore no clothing, and did not reside in a house, but among the tombs.

luke 8:28.english: And when he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and said, with a loud voice: What have we to do with thee? Jesus, thou Son of the exalted God. I entreat of thee, torment me not.

luke 8:29.english: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit, to come out of the man: for, of a long time he had been held captive by him; and he had been bound with chains, and held in fetters; but he had burst the bonds, and had been driven by the demon into the desert.

luke 8:30.english: And Jesus demanded of him: What is thy name? And he said to him: Legion: because many demons had entered into him.

luke 8:31.english: And they besought him, not to command them to depart into the abyss.

luke 8:32.english: And there was a herd of many swine grazing on the mountain. And they besought him, that he would permit them to enter the swine. And he permitted them.

luke 8:33.english: And the demons went out of the man, and entered the swine; and the whole herd ran to a precipice, and plunged into the sea, and were strangled.

luke 8:34.english: And when the herdmen saw what had occurred, they fled, and told it in the cities and the villages.

luke 8:35.english: And the men went out to see what was done. And they came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the demons had gone, now clothed, and modest, and sitting at the feet of Jesus; and they were awed.

luke 8:36.english: And they that saw it, related to them in what manner the demoniac was cured.

luke 8:37.english: And the whole throng of the Gadarenes requested him, that he would depart from them: for great fear had seized them. And Jesus embarked in a ship, and retired from among them.

luke 8:38.english: And the man, from whom the demons had gone out, requested that he might remain with him. But Jesus dismissed him, and said to him:

luke 8:39.english: Return to thy home, and relate what God hath done for thee. And he went away, and proclaimed through all the city what Jesus had done for him.

luke 8:40.english: And when Jesus returned, a great multitude received him; for all were looking for him.

luke 8:41.english: And a man, whose name was Jairus, a chief of the synagogue, fell down at the feet of Jesus, and besought him to enter his house;

luke 8:42.english: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, and she was near dying. And as Jesus went with him, a great multitude pressed upon him.

luke 8:43.english: And a certain woman, whose blood had flowed twelve years, and who had expended all her property among physicians, and could not be cured by any one,

luke 8:44.english: came up behind him, and touched the border of his garment; and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

luke 8:45.english: And Jesus said: Who touched me? And when all denied, Simon Cephas and those with him said to him: Our Rabbi, crowds press upon thee and sayest thou, Who touched me?

luke 8:46.english: And he said: Some one touched me; for I perceive, that energy hath gone out from me.

luke 8:47.english: And the woman, when she saw that she had not escaped his notice, came trembling, and fell down and worshipped him. And in the presence of all the people, she declared for what cause she had touched him, and that she was instantly healed.

luke 8:48.english: And Jesus said to her: Take courage, my daughter: Thy faith hath given thee life: Go in peace.

luke 8:49.english: And while he was speaking, one came from the house of the chief of the synagogue, and said to him: Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the teacher.

luke 8:50.english: And Jesus heard it, and said to the father of the maid: Fear not; believe only, and she will live.

luke 8:51.english: And Jesus came to the house; and he suffered none to go in with him, except Simon, and James, and John, and the father and mother of the maid.

luke 8:52.english: And all were weeping and wailing over her. And Jesus said: Weep not; for she is not dead, but sleepeth

luke 8:53.english: And they derided him, knowing that she was dead.

luke 8:54.english: And he put every one out, and took her by the hand, and called, and said: Maid, arise.

luke 8:55.english: And her spirit returned, and she instantly arose. And he directed them to give her food.

luke 8:56.english: And her parents were astonished: and he charged them to tell no one what had occurred.

luke 9:1.english: And Jesus called his twelve, and gave them power and authority over all demons and diseases, to heal them.

luke 9:2.english: And he sent them forth, to proclaim the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

luke 9:3.english: And he said to them: Take nothing for the journey, neither a staff, nor a wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two tunics.

luke 9:4.english: And into whatever house ye enter, there stay, and thence depart.

luke 9:5.english: And against them that receive you not, when ye go out of that city, shake off even the dust of your feet against them, for a testimony.

luke 9:6.english: And the Legates went forth, and travelled about the villages and cities, and preached and healed everywhere.

luke 9:7.english: And Herod the Tetrarch heard of all the things done by him, and he was disturbed; because some said, that John had arisen from the dead.

luke 9:8.english: But others said, that Elijah hath appeared; and others, that a prophet from among the ancient prophets hath arisen.

luke 9:9.english: And Herod said: The head of John, I have cut off; but who is this, of whom I hear these things? And he was desirous to see him.

luke 9:10.english: And when the Legates returned, they narrated, to Jesus all they had done. And he took them aside, to the desert part of Bethsaida.

luke 9:11.english: And when the multitude knew it, they followed him: and he received them, and conversed with them respecting the kingdom of God: and such as had need of healing, he healed.

luke 9:12.english: And when the day began to decline, his disciples came near, and said to him: Send away the multitude, that they may go to the villages around us and to the towns, to lodge in them, and to procure themselves food, for we are in a desert place.

luke 9:13.english: Jesus said to then: Give ye them to eat. And they say: We have no more than five loaves and two fishes; unless we go and buy food for all this people:

luke 9:14.english: for they were about five thousand men. Jesus said to them: Make them recline by companies, fifty persons in a company.

luke 9:15.english: And the disciples did so, and made them all recline.

luke 9:16.english: And Jesus took the five loaves and two fishes, and looked towards heaven, and blessed, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before the multitudes.

luke 9:17.english: And they all ate, and were satisfied: and they took up the fragments of remains, twelve baskets.

luke 9:18.english: And as he was praying in private with his disciples, he asked them, and said: Who, do the multitudes say of me, that I am?

luke 9:19.english: They answer and say to him: John the Baptizer; others, Elijah and others, a prophet, one of the ancient prophets arisen.

luke 9:20.english: He said to them: But who, do ye say, that I am? Simon answered, and said: The Messiah of God.

luke 9:21.english: And he chided them, and charged them, that they should say this to no one.

luke 9:22.english: And he said to them: The Son of man is to suffer many things, and to be rejected by the Elders and the chief priests and Scribes; and they will kill him; and on the third day, he will arise.

luke 9:23.english: And he said before all the people: He that would follow me, must deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and so come after me.

luke 9:24.english: For he that will preserve his life, shall lose it; but he that shall lose his life, for my sake, will preserve it.

luke 9:25.english: For, what will a man be profited, if he gain the whole world, and lose his life or be deprived of it?

luke 9:26.english: And whoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father, with his holy angels.

luke 9:27.english: I tell you the truth, that there are some standing here, who will not taste death, until they shall see the kingdom of God.

luke 9:28.english: And it was about eight days after these discourses, that Jesus took Simon and James and John, and went up a mountain to pray.

luke 9:29.english: And while he prayed, the aspect of his countenance was changed, and his garments became white and brilliant.

luke 9:30.english: And lo, two men were talking with him: and they were Moses and Elijah,

luke 9:31.english: who appeared in glory. And they were conversing on his departure, which was to be consummated at Jerusalem.

luke 9:32.english: And Simon and those with him were oppressed with drowsiness; and being scarcely awake, they saw his glory, and those two men who stood near him.

luke 9:33.english: And when they began t to retire from him, Simon said to Jesus: Rabbi, it is delightful for us to be here. And let us make here three booths, one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah. But he knew not what he said.

luke 9:34.english: And as he thus spoke, there was a cloud; and it overshadowed them; and they were afraid, when they saw Moses and Elijah go up into the cloud.

luke 9:35.english: And there was a voice from the cloud, which said: This is my beloved Son; hear ye him.

luke 9:36.english: And when the voice had passed, Jesus was found to be alone. And they kept silence, and told no one in those days what they had seen.

luke 9:37.english: And the next day, as they came down from the mountain, a great multitude met them.

luke 9:38.english: And a man from the throng cried out, and said: Teacher, I beseech thee, turn thyself to me. Here is my only son:

luke 9:39.english: and a spirit cometh upon him, and he suddenly crieth out, and gnasheth his teeth, and foameth; and he hardly leaveth him, when he hath crushed him.

luke 9:40.english: And I requested thy disciples to expel him; and they could not.

luke 9:41.english: And Jesus answered, and said: O the unbelieving and perverse generation! How long shall I be with you, and bear with you? Bring hither thy son.

luke 9:42.english: And while he was bringing him, the demon threw him down, and convulsed him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the lad, and delivered him to his father.

luke 9:43.english: And they were all amazed at the majesty of God. And while every one admired at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples:

luke 9:44.english: Lay up these words in your minds: for the Son of man is to be delivered into the hands of men.

luke 9:45.english: But they understood not that speech; because it was hidden from them, that they should not know it: and they feared to ask him concerning that speech.

luke 9:46.english: And the thought arose among them, which of them was to be the greatest.

luke 9:47.english: And Jesus knew the thought of their heart: and he took a child, and placed him near to him;

luke 9:48.english: and said to them: Whoever receiveth a child like this, in my name, receiveth me; and he that receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me. For he that shall be least among you all, he will be the great one.

luke 9:49.english: And John answered, and said: Our Rabbi, we saw a man casting out demons in thy name; and we forbad him, because he doth not, with us, follow thee.

luke 9:50.english: Jesus said to them: Forbid not: for, whoever is not against you, is for you.

luke 9:51.english: And when the days for his ascension were completed, so it was, that he set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

luke 9:52.english: And he sent messengers before his face; and they went, and entered a village of the Samaritans, to prepare lodgings for him.

luke 9:53.english: And they received him not, because he had set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

luke 9:54.english: And when his disciples James and John saw it, they said to him: Our Lord, wilt thou that we speak, and fire come down from heaven, and consume them, as also did Elijah?

luke 9:55.english: And he turned and rebuked them, and said: Ye know not of what spirit ye are.

luke 9:56.english: For the Son of man hath not come to destroy souls; but to quicken them. And they went to another village.

luke 9:57.english: And as they went by the way, one said to him: I will follow thee to whatever place thou goest, my Lord.

luke 9:58.english: Jesus said to him: The foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven have coverts; but the Son of man hath not where he may lay his head.

luke 9:59.english: And he said to another: Come thou after me. And he said to him: My Lord, permit me first to go and bury my father.

luke 9:60.english: And Jesus said to him: Allow the dead to bury their dead; and go thou and proclaim the kingdom of God.

luke 9:61.english: Another said to him: I will follow thee, my Lord; but allow me first to bid adieu to my household, and I will come.

luke 9:62.english: Jesus said to him: No man putting his hand to the ox-plough, and looking backward, is fit for the kingdom of God.

luke 10:1.english: And after these things, Jesus separated from among his disciples seventy other persons, and sent them, two and two, before his face, to every place and city whither he was to go.

luke 10:2.english: And he said to them: The harvest is great, and the laborers few: pray ye, therefore, the lord of the harvest that he would send laborers into his harvest.

luke 10:3.english: Go ye: lo, I send you forth, as sheep among wolves.

luke 10:4.english: Take to you no purses, nor wallets, nor shoes; and salute no man by the way.

luke 10:5.english: And into whatever house ye enter, first say: Peace be to this house.

luke 10:6.english: And if the son of peace is there, your salutation will rest upon it; but if not, your salutation will return to you.

luke 10:7.english: And remain in that house, eating and drinking of what it affords; for the laborer is worthy of his hire. And pass not from house to house.

luke 10:8.english: And into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you; eat that which set before you.

luke 10:9.english: And heal them that are sick in it; and say to them: The kingdom of God hath come near you.

luke 10:10.english: And into whatever city ye enter, and they receive you not; go out into the street, and say:

luke 10:11.english: Even the dust of your city which adhereth to our feet, we shake off against you: but this know ye, that the kingdom of God hath come near to you.

luke 10:12.english: I say to you, that for Sodom there will be comfort in that day, rather than for that city.

luke 10:13.english: Woe to thee, Chorazin; woe to thee, Bethsaida; for if in Tyre and Sidon there had been the mighty deeds, that were in you, they would long ago have repented in sackcloth and ashes.

luke 10:14.english: But for Tyre and Sidon there will be comfort in the day of judgment, rather than for you.

luke 10:15.english: And thou Capernaum, that art lifted up to heaven, shalt be brought down to hell.

luke 10:16.english: He that heareth you, heareth me; and he that despiseth you, despiseth me; and he that despiseth me, despiseth him that sent me.

luke 10:17.english: And the seventy whom he sent forth, returned with great joy, and say to him: Our Lord, even the demons were subject to us, in thy name.

luke 10:18.english: And he said to them: I saw Satan fall, like the lightning from heaven.

luke 10:19.english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents, and scorpions, and on all the power of the adversary: and nothing shall harm you.

luke 10:20.english: Yet rejoice not in this, that the demons are subject to you; but rejoice, that your names are written in heaven.

luke 10:21.english: In that hour Jesus exulted in the Holy Spirit, and said: I thank thee, my Father, thou Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and intelligent, and hast revealed them to babes: yes, my Father, for such was thy good pleasure.

luke 10:22.english: And he turned himself to his disciples, and said to them: Every thing is committed to me by my Father: and no one knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; or who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son is pleased to reveal him.

luke 10:23.english: And he turned to his disciples, privately, and said: Blessed are the eyes that see, what ye see.

luke 10:24.english: For I say to you, that many prophets and kings desired to see what ye see, and did not see it; and to hear what ye hear, and did not hear it.

luke 10:25.english: And behold, a Scribe stood up to try him, and said: Teacher, what must I do, to inherit eternal life?

luke 10:26.english: And Jesus said to him: How is it written in the law? How readest thou?

luke 10:27.english: He answered and said to him: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God, with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbor, as thyself

luke 10:28.english: Jesus said to him: Thou hast said correctly; do thus, and thou wilt live.

luke 10:29.english: And he, being disposed to justify himself, said: And who is my neighbor?

luke 10:30.english: Jesus said to him: A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and robbers fell upon him, and plundered him, and smote him, and left him with little life in him, and went their way.

luke 10:31.english: And a certain priest went down by that way; and he saw him, and passed on.

luke 10:32.english: So also a Levite came, approached the spot, and saw him, and passed on.

luke 10:33.english: But a Samaritan, as he travelled, came where he was, and saw him, and took pity on him,

luke 10:34.english: and went to him, and bound up his wounds, and poured wine and oil on them, and placed him upon his ass, and brought him to the inn, and took care of him.

luke 10:35.english: And on the morning of the next day, he took out two denarii and gave to the host, and said: Take good care of him; and if thou expendest any more, when I return, I will repay thee.

luke 10:36.english: Which therefore of these three, appears to thee, to have been neighbor to him that fell into the hands of marauders?

luke 10:37.english: And he said: He that had pity on him. Jesus said to him: Go, and do thou also the like.

luke 10:38.english: And it occurred, as they travelled by the way, that he entered a certain village, and a woman whose name was Martha, received him at her house.

luke 10:39.english: And she had a sister whose name, was Mary and she came and seated herself at the feet of our Lord, and listened to his discourses.

luke 10:40.english: But Martha was occupied with much service; and she came, and said to him: My Lord, hast thou no concern, that my sister hath left me to serve alone? Bid her assist me.

luke 10:41.english: Jesus answered, and said to her: Martha, Martha, thou art anxious and troubled about many things:

luke 10:42.english: yet but one thing is necessary; and Mary hath chosen for herself the good part, which shall not be taken from her.

luke 11:1.english: And as he was praying in a certain place, it occurred, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Our Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

luke 11:2.english: Jesus said to them: When ye pray, thus speak ye: Our Father who art in heaven, hallow be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy pleasure be done, as in heaven, so on earth;

luke 11:3.english: give us daily the bread we need;

luke 11:4.english: and remit to us our sins, for we also remit to all that are indebted to us; and bring us not into trials, but deliver us from evil.

luke 11:5.english: And he said to them: Which of you shall have a friend, that shall come to him at midnight and say to him, My friend, lend me three cakes;

luke 11:6.english: for a friend hath come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him?

luke 11:7.english: And his friend within shall answer, and say to him: Do not disturb me, for lo, the door is closed, and my children with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

luke 11:8.english: I say to you: If he give him not, on account of friendship, yet on account of his importunity, he will arise and give him as much as he asketh.

luke 11:9.english: I say also to you: Ask, and it will be given you; seek, and ye will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.

luke 11:10.english: For every one that asketh, receiveth; and he that seeketh, findeth; and to him that knocketh, it is opened.
