luke 11:11.english: For which of you being a father, if his son shall ask him for bread, will he reach to him a stone? Or, if he ask of him a fish, will he, instead of a fish, reach to him a serpent?

luke 11:12.english: Or, if he ask of him an egg, will he reach to him a scorpion?

luke 11:13.english: And if ye, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father from heaven give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

luke 11:14.english: And as he was casting out a demon that was dumb, it occurred, that when the demon had gone out, the dumb man conversed: and the multitudes admired.

luke 11:15.english: But some of them said: It is by Beelzebub, the prince of demons, that he casteth out demons.

luke 11:16.english: And others, to tempt him, asked of him a sign from heaven.

luke 11:17.english: But Jesus, as he knew their thoughts, said to them: Every kingdom that is divided against itself, will become a desolation: and a house that is divided against itself, will fall.

luke 11:18.english: And if Satan be divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? since ye say, that I by Beelzebub cast out demons.

luke 11:19.english: And if I, by Beelzebub, cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore will they be to you judges.

luke 11:20.english: But if I, by the finger of God, cast out demons, the kingdom of God hath come near to you.

luke 11:21.english: When a strong man armed keepeth his doorway, his property rests securely.

luke 11:22.english: But if a stronger than he come and overpower him, he taketh away all his arms on which he relied, and divideth the spoil of him.

luke 11:23.english: He that is not for me, is against me; and he that gathereth not with me, actually scattereth.

luke 11:24.english: An unclean spirit, when he goeth out of a man, goeth wandering in places where no water is, in order to find rest; and, as he cannot find it he saith: I will return to my habitation, from which I came.

luke 11:25.english: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept clean and set in order.

luke 11:26.english: Then he goeth and taketh seven other spirits, worse than himself, and they enter in and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

luke 11:27.english: And while he was saying these things, a certain woman from the crowd, lifted up her voice, and said to him: Blessed is the womb that carried thee, and the breasts that nursed thee.

luke 11:28.english: He said to her: Blessed are they who hear the word of God, and keep it.

luke 11:29.english: And when multitudes were assembled, he began to say: This evil generation seeketh a sign; and no sign will be given it, but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

luke 11:30.english: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of man be a sign to this generation.

luke 11:31.english: The queen of the south will stand up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them; for she came from the other side of the earth, to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and lo, one superior to Solomon is here.

luke 11:32.english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and lo, one superior to Jonah is here.

luke 11:33.english: No one lighteth a lamp, and putteth it in a secret place, or under a bushel, but upon a light-stand; that they who come in, may see its light.

luke 11:34.english: The lamp of thy body is thy eye. Therefore, when thy eye is sound, thy whole body will be enlightened; but if it be bad, thy body also will be dark.

luke 11:35.english: See to it, therefore, lest the light that is in thee, be darkness.

luke 11:36.english: For if thy whole body be enlightened, and no part in it be dark, the whole will be luminous, as if a lamp enlightened thee by its radiance.

luke 11:37.english: And while he was speaking, a certain Pharisee requested him to dine with him: and he went in, and reclined.

luke 11:38.english: And the Pharisee noticing him, wondered that he did not previously baptize before dinner.

luke 11:39.english: And Jesus said to him: Now ye Pharisees make clean the exterior of the cup and the dish; but your interior is full of extortion and wickedness.

luke 11:40.english: Ye deficient in understanding! did not he who made the exterior, make also the interior?

luke 11:41.english: But, give ye alms from what ye possess; and lo, every thing will be clean to you.

luke 11:42.english: But woe to you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue, and every pot-herb; but pass over justice and the love of God. Now ye ought to do these things, and not to omit those.

luke 11:43.english: Woe to you, Pharisees! who love the chief seats in the synagogues, and a salutation in the streets.

luke 11:44.english: Woe to you, Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like graves that are unknown, and men walk over them and do not know it.

luke 11:45.english: And one of the Scribes replied, and said to him: Teacher, while saying these things, thou reproachest us also.

luke 11:46.english: And he said: Woe to you also! ye Scribes, who lade men with heavy burdens; yet ye yourselves will not touch those burdens with one of your fingers

luke 11:47.english: Woe to you! who build the sepulchres of the prophets, whom your fathers slew.

luke 11:48.english: Thus ye testify, that ye acquiesce in the deeds of your fathers; for they slew them, and ye build their sepulchres.

luke 11:49.english: Therefore hath wisdom said: Lo, I will send to them prophets and legates; and some of them they will persecute and slay;

luke 11:50.english: that from this generation may be required, the blood of all the prophets, which hath been shed since the world was created;

luke 11:51.english: from the blood of Abel, to the blood of Zachariah who was slain between the temple and the altar. Yea, say I to you: It will be required of this generation.

luke 11:52.english: Woe to you, Scribes; for ye have taken away the keys of knowledge: ye yourselves enter not, and them that are entering ye hinder.

luke 11:53.english: And when he had said these things to them, the Scribes and Pharisees began to be offended, and became angry, and carped at his discourses,

luke 11:54.english: and practised many wiles upon him, seeking to catch some thing from his lips, that they might accuse him.

luke 12:1.english: And when great multitudes were assembled by myriads, so that they trod one upon another, Jesus began to say to his disciples: First of all, beware for yourselves of that leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

luke 12:2.english: For there is nothing hidden, which will not be revealed; nor concealed, that will not be known.

luke 12:3.english: For whatever ye speak in the dark, will be heard in the light; and what in secret chambers, ye whisper in the ear, will be proclaimed on the house-tops.

luke 12:4.english: And to you, my friends, I say: Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and afterwards have nothing more they can do.

luke 12:5.english: But I will show you, of whom to be afraid: of him who, after he hath killed, hath authority to cast into hell. Yea, say I to you: be afraid of him.

luke 12:6.english: Are not five sparrows sold for two assarii? and not one of them is forgotten before God.

luke 12:7.english: And as for you, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not, therefore; for ye are superior to many sparrows.

luke 12:8.english: And I say to you, that every one that shall confess me before men, the Son of man will also confess him before the angels of God.

luke 12:9.english: But he that shall deny me before men, shall himself be denied before the angels of God.

luke 12:10.english: And every one that shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but he that shall reproach the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him.

luke 12:11.english: And when they shall bring you into the synagogues, before chiefs and men in authority, be not anxious how ye shall make defence, or what ye shall say;

luke 12:12.english: for the Holy Spirit will, in that hour, instruct you what to say.

luke 12:13.english: And one of the assembly said to him: Teacher, tell my brother, to divide the inheritance with me.

luke 12:14.english: But Jesus said to him: Man, who established me a judge and distributor over you?

luke 12:15.english: And he said to his disciples: Beware of all avarice, for life consisteth not in abundance of riches.

luke 12:16.english: And he spoke to them a similitude: The land of a certain rich man brought forth produce in abundance.

luke 12:17.english: And he considered with himself, and said: What shall I do; for I have not where I can store up my produce?

luke 12:18.english: And he said This will I do; I will pull down my storehouses, and build them larger; and there will I store up all my corn and my good things:

luke 12:19.english: and I will say to my soul: My soul, thou hast good things in abundance, which are stored up for many years; take thy ease; eat, drink, and live in pleasure.

luke 12:20.english: But God said to him: Thou void of reason! This night, thy soul will be required of thee; and to whom will belong these things provided by thee?

luke 12:21.english: Such is he that layeth up treasures for himself, and is not rich in God.

luke 12:22.english: And he said to his disciples: Therefore I tell you, Be not anxious for your life, what ye shall eat; nor for your body, what ye shall put on.

luke 12:23.english: For the life is more important than food, and the body than raiment.

luke 12:24.english: Consider the ravens, which sow not, nor reap, nor have cellars and storehouses; yet God provideth them food. How much more important now are ye, than the birds!

luke 12:25.english: And which of you, by taking pains, can add one cubit to his stature?

luke 12:26.english: And if ye are impotent for that which is least, why are ye anxious about the rest?

luke 12:27.english: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they toil not, nor do they spin. Yet I say to you, that not even Solomon in all his glory, was clothed like one of these.

luke 12:28.english: And if God so clothe the herb, which to-day exists in the field, and to-morrow falls into the oven, how much more you, ye little in faith?

luke 12:29.english: And inquire not, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor let your mind wander upon these things.

luke 12:30.english: For all these things the people of the world seek after; and your father knoweth that, for you also, these things are needful.

luke 12:31.english: But seek ye the kingdom of God, and all these things will be added to you.

luke 12:32.english: Fear not, little flock; for your Father is disposed to give you the kingdom

luke 12:33.english: Sell your property, and give alms: make for yourselves bags that do not become old, and a treasure that is not transient, in the heavens; where no thief approacheth, and no moth eateth.

luke 12:34.english: For where your treasure is, there also will your heart be.

luke 12:35.english: Let your loins be girded, and your lamps burning.

luke 12:36.english: And be ye like persons who are waiting for their lord, when he shall return from the house of feasting, that, when he shall come and knock, they may open to him immediately.

luke 12:37.english: Happy are those servants, whom their lord, when he cometh, shall find so doing. Verily I say to you: He will gird his loins, and make them recline, and will pass around and serve them.

luke 12:38.english: And if in the second watch, or in the third, he shall come and so find them, happy are those servants.

luke 12:39.english: And this know ye, that if the lord of the house had known at what watch the thief would come, he would have been awake and would not have suffered his house to be broken into.

luke 12:40.english: Therefore be ye also ready; for at an hour that ye think not, the Son of man cometh.

luke 12:41.english: Simon Cephas saith to him: Our Lord, speakest thou this similitude to us, or also to all men?

luke 12:42.english: Jesus said to him: Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will place over all his domestics, to give them their portion in due time?

luke 12:43.english: Happy is that servant whom his lord, when he cometh, shall find so doing.

luke 12:44.english: Verily I say to you: He will place him over all his possessions.

luke 12:45.english: But if that servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to smite the servants and the maidens of his lord; and shall begin to eat and to drink and be drunk;

luke 12:46.english: the lord of that servant will come in a day he thinketh not, and in an hour he knoweth not, and will cut him in two; and will assign him his portion with them that are unfaithful.

luke 12:47.english: And the servant that knew his lord's pleasure, and did not prepare for him according to his pleasure, shall be beaten with many stripes.

luke 12:48.english: But he that knew not, yet did that which deserved stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For to whomsoever much is given, from him will much be required; and to whom much is committed, the more will be required at his hand.

luke 12:49.english: I have come to cast fire on the earth; and I would, that it already burned.

luke 12:50.english: And I have a baptism to be baptized with; and I am much pressed until it be accomplished.

luke 12:51.english: Suppose ye, that I have come to produce tranquillity on the earth? I tell you, No: but division.

luke 12:52.english: For from this time, there will be five persons in one house, who will be divided, three against two, and two against three.

luke 12:53.english: For a father will be divided against his son, and a son against his father; a mother against her daughter, and a daughter against her mother; a mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

luke 12:54.english: And he said to the multitudes: When you see a cloud rising out of the west, ye at once say: Rain is coming; and it is so.

luke 12:55.english: And when a south wind bloweth, ye say: It will be hot: and it is so.

luke 12:56.english: Ye hypocrites, ye know how to distinguish the aspect of the heavens and the earth; and why can ye not distinguish the present time?

luke 12:57.english: And why do ye not, of yourselves, judge correctly?

luke 12:58.english: And when thou goest with thy adversary to the ruler, while on the way, make effort to be released by him; lest he bring thee to the judge and the judge deliver thee to the exactor, and the exactor cast thee into prison.

luke 12:59.english: For verily I say to thee: Thou wilt not come out thence, until thou pay the last mite.

luke 13:1.english: And at that time, some came and told him of those Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

luke 13:2.english: And Jesus replied, and said to them: Suppose ye, that these Galileans were sinners beyond all the Galileans, because this occurred to them?

luke 13:3.english: No. And I say to you, That all of you also, unless ye repent, will likewise perish.

luke 13:4.english: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, suppose ye, that they were sinners beyond all the men inhabiting Jerusalem?

luke 13:5.english: No. And I say to you, That except ye resent, ye like them will all of you perish.

luke 13:6.english: And he spoke this similitude: A man had a fig-tree that was planted in his vineyard: and he came, seeking fruits upon it, and found none.

luke 13:7.english: And he said to the cultivator: Lo, these three years, I have come seeking fruits on this fig-tree, and I find none. Cut it down: why should it cumber the ground?

luke 13:8.english: The cultivator said to him: My Lord, spare it this year also, until I shall work about it, and manure it.

luke 13:9.english: And if it bear fruits, well; and if not, thou wilt cut it down: why should it live?

luke 13:10.english: And when Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues, on the sabbath,

luke 13:11.english: a woman was there who had had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years; and she was bent over, and could not straighten herself at all.

luke 13:12.english: And Jesus saw her, and called her, and said to her: Woman, thou art released from thy infirmity.

luke 13:13.english: And he put his hand upon her; and immediately she straightened her self up, and glorified God.

luke 13:14.english: And the chief of the synagogue, being angry that Jesus had healed on the sabbath, answered, and said to the multitude: There are six days, on which it is lawful to work; on them come ye, and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

luke 13:15.english: But Jesus replied, and said to him: Thou hypocrite! Doth not every one of you, on the sabbath, loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him to water?

luke 13:16.english: And this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom the Calumniator hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, ought she not to be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

luke 13:17.english: And when he had said these things, all those that stood up against him were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced in all the miracles that were wrought by his hand.

luke 13:18.english: And Jesus said: To what is the kingdom of God like? and with what shall I compare it?

luke 13:19.english: It is like a grain of mustard, which a man took and cast into his garden; and it grew, and became a large tree; and a bird of heaven made her nest in its branches.

luke 13:20.english: Jesus said again: With what shall I compare the kingdom of God?

luke 13:21.english: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three seahs of meal, until the whole was fermented.

luke 13:22.english: And he travelled through the villages and cities, teaching and going towards Jerusalem.

luke 13:23.english: And a person asked him, whether they were few who would have life?

luke 13:24.english: And Jesus said to them: Strive to enter the narrow gate: for I say to you, many will seek to enter, and will not be able.

luke 13:25.english: From the time that the lord of the house shall rise and close the door, then ye will stand without, and knock at the door; and ye will begin to say: Our Lord, our Lord, open to us and he will answer, and say: I tell you, I know you not, whence ye are.

luke 13:26.english: And ye will begin to say: We have eaten and drunken before thee; and thou hast taught in our streets.

luke 13:27.english: And he will say to you: I know you not, whence ye are: depart from me, ye doers of falsehood.

luke 13:28.english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye will see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God; and yourselves will be thrust out.

luke 13:29.english: And they will come from the east and from the west, and from the south and from the north, and will recline in the kingdom of God.

luke 13:30.english: And lo, there are last that will be first, and there are first that will be last.

luke 13:31.english: On the same day came some of the Pharisees, and said to him: Go, depart hence; for Herod purposeth to kill thee.

luke 13:32.english: Jesus said to them: Go ye and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures, to-day and to-morrow, and on the third day I shall be consummated.

luke 13:33.english: But I must labor to-day and to-morrow, and on the following day I will go; because it cannot be, that a prophet should perish away from Jerusalem.

luke 13:34.english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent to thee; how many times would I have gathered thy children, as a hen that gathereth her young under her wings, and ye would not?

luke 13:35.english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. For I say to you: Ye will not see me, until ye will say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

luke 14:1.english: And it occurred, that, as he entered the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread, on the sabbath day, they watched him.

luke 14:2.english: And lo, a dropsical man was before him.

luke 14:3.english: And Jews answered, and said to the Scribes and Pharisees: Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath?

luke 14:4.english: And they were silent. And he took him, and healed him, and dismissed him.

luke 14:5.english: And he said to them: Which of you, if his son or his ox fall into a pit on the sabbath day, doth not immediately lift and draw him out?

luke 14:6.english: And they could give him no answer to that.

luke 14:7.english: And he spoke a similitude to the guests that were present, as he noticed how they chose places on the highest couches.

luke 14:8.english: When thou art invited by any one to a house of feasting, go not and recline on the highest couch; lest there should be invited there, one more honorable than thou;

luke 14:9.english: and he that invited both him and thee come and say to thee, Give place to this man; and thou be ashamed, when thou risest, and takest a lower couch.

luke 14:10.english: But when thou art invited, go and recline on the lowest couch; that when he who invited thee come, he may say to thee: My friend, come up higher and recline. And thou wilt have honor, before all that recline with thee.

luke 14:11.english: For, every one that exalteth himself, will be humbled: and every one that humbleth himself, will be exalted.

luke 14:12.english: And he said to him that invited him: When thou makest a dinner or a supper, invite not thy friends, nor thy brothers, nor thy relatives, nor thy rich neighbors; lest they also invite thee, and thou have this recompense.

luke 14:13.english: But when thou makest a feast, invite the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind.

luke 14:14.english: And thou wilt be blessed. For they cannot recompense thee; but thy recompense will be at the resurrection of the just.

luke 14:15.english: And when one of those reclining heard these things, he said to him: Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

luke 14:16.english: Jesus said to him: A certain man made a great supper, and invited many.

luke 14:17.english: And at the time for supper, he sent his servant to say to those invited: Lo, every thing is ready for you; come.

luke 14:18.english: And they all to a man, began to excuse themselves. The first said to him: I have bought a field, and am constrained to go out and see it. I pray thee, allow me to be excused.

luke 14:19.english: Another said: I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to inspect them. I pray thee, allow me to be excused.

luke 14:20.english: Another said: I have married a wife, and on this account I cannot come.

luke 14:21.english: And the servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the lord of the house was angry: and he said to his servant, Go out quickly into the market-places and streets of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the diseased, and the lame, and the blind.

luke 14:22.english: And the servant said: My lord, it is done as thou commandedst; and still there is room.

luke 14:23.english: And the lord said to his servant: Go out to the by-paths, and among the hedges, and constrain them to come in; that my house may be filled.

luke 14:24.english: For I declare to you, that not one of those men that were invited, shall taste of my supper.

luke 14:25.english: And when great multitudes were travelling with him, he turned himself, and said to them:

luke 14:26.english: He that cometh to me, and hateth not his father and his mother, and his brothers and his sisters, and his wife and his children, and his own life also, cannot become a disciple to me.

luke 14:27.english: And he that doth not take up his cross and come after me, cannot become a disciple to me.

luke 14:28.english: For, which of you, wishing to build a tower, doth not first sit down and compute the expense, whether he have the means to complete it?

luke 14:29.english: lest, when he hath laid the foundation, and is unable to finish, all that see it begin to deride him;

luke 14:30.english: and say: This man began to build, and was unable to finish.

luke 14:31.english: Or what king, that is going to contend in battle with his neighbor king, doth not first consider, whether he is able, with ten thousand, to meet him that is coming against him with twenty thousand?

luke 14:32.english: and if not; while he is yet far from him, he sendeth envoys, and sueth for peace.

luke 14:33.english: So every one of you who doth not give up all his possessions, cannot be my disciple.

luke 14:34.english: Salt is a good thing: but if the salt itself hath become insipid, wherewith shall it be salted?

luke 14:35.english: It is fit for neither the earth, nor the dunghill. They cast it away. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

luke 15:1.english: And publicans and sinners came to him, to hear him.

luke 15:2.english: And the Scribes and Pharisees murmured, and said: This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

luke 15:3.english: And Jesus spoke to them this similitude:

luke 15:4.english: What man among you, that hath a hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the desert, and go and seek for that which is lost, until he find it?

luke 15:5.english: And when he findeth it, he rejoiceth, and taketh it upon his shoulders;

luke 15:6.english: and he cometh home, and he calleth together his friends and neighbors, and saith to them: Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep that was lost.

luke 15:7.english: I say to you, that there will thus be joy in heaven, over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just ones, to whom repentance was not necessary.

luke 15:8.english: Or what woman is there, who, if she have ten drachmas, and lose one of them, doth not light a lamp, and sweep the house, and search for it carefully, until she find it?

luke 15:9.english: And when she hath found it, she calleth together her friends and neighbors, and saith to them: Rejoice with me, for I have found my drachma that was lost.

luke 15:10.english: I say to you, That there will thus be joy, before the angels of God, over one sinner that repenteth.

luke 15:11.english: And Jesus said to them again: A certain man had two sons.

luke 15:12.english: And his younger son said to him: My father, give me the portion that falleth to me from thy house. And he divided to them his property.

luke 15:13.english: And after a few days, the younger son collected together all that fell to him, and went to a distant place and there squandered his property, by living in dissipation.

luke 15:14.english: And when he had consumed all that he had, there occurred a great famine in that place; and he began to be in want.

luke 15:15.english: And he went and connected himself with one of the citizens of that place: and he sent him into the field to tend swine.

luke 15:16.english: And he longed to fill his belly with those pods which the swine ate: and no one gave to him.

luke 15:17.english: And when he came to himself, he said: How many hired servants are now at my father's house, who have bread enough, and I am here perishing with hunger.

luke 15:18.english: I will arise and go to my father, and say to him: My father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee;

luke 15:19.english: and am no longer worthy to be called thy son. Make me like one of thy hired servants.

luke 15:20.english: And he arose and went towards his father. And he was yet at a distance, when his father saw him; and he pitied him, and ran, and fell upon his neck and kissed him.

luke 15:21.english: And his son said to him: My father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee, and am not worthy to be called thy son.

luke 15:22.english: But his father said to his servants: Bring forth the best robe, and clothe him, and put a ring on his hand, and supply him with shoes.

luke 15:23.english: And bring forth and slay the fatted bullock; and let us eat, and be merry.

luke 15:24.english: For, this my son was dead, and is alive; he was lost and is found. And they began to be merry.

luke 15:25.english: But his elder son was in the field; and as he came and drew near to the house, he heard the sound of the singing of many.

luke 15:26.english: And he called to one of the boys, and asked him what it meant.

luke 15:27.english: And he said to him: Thy brother hath come; and thy father hath killed the fatted bullock, because he hath received him in health.

luke 15:28.english: And he was angry, and would not go in: and his father went out and entreated him.

luke 15:29.english: And he said to his father: Lo, these many years have I labored in thy service, and never transgressed thy command; and thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends.

luke 15:30.english: But for this thy son, when he had dissipated thy property with harlots, and came home, thou hast slain the fatted bullock for him.

luke 15:31.english: His father said to him: My son, thou hast been ever with me, and all that I have, is thine.

luke 15:32.english: But it was proper for us to be merry, and to rejoice; because this thy brother was dead, and is alive; he was lost, and is found.

luke 16:1.english: And he spoke a parable to his disciples. There was a certain rich man, who had a steward; and accusations were brought to him of him, that he squandered his property.

luke 16:2.english: And his lord called him, and said to him: What is this that I hear of thee? Render to me an account of thy stewardship; for thou canst no longer be my steward.

luke 16:3.english: And the steward said with himself: What shall I do, since my lord is about to take from me the stewardship? To dig, I am unable; and to become a beggar, I am ashamed.

luke 16:4.english: I know what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me to their houses.

luke 16:5.english: And he called each one of his lord's debtors; and he said to the first, How much owest thou to my lord?

luke 16:6.english: And he said to him, One hundred measures of oil. And he said to him: Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write Fifty measures.

luke 16:7.english: And he said to another: And how much owest thou to my lord? And he said to him, One hundred cors of wheat. And he said to him: Take thy bill, and sit down, and write Eighty cors.

luke 16:8.english: And our Lord praised the unrighteous steward, for having acted sagaciously: for the children of this world are more sagacious than the children of light, in this their generation.

luke 16:9.english: And I also say to you: Make to yourselves friends, with this unrighteous mammon; so that when it is finished, they may receive you to their everlasting tabernacles.

luke 16:10.english: He that is faithful in the little, is also faithful in the much; and he that is unjust in the little, is also unjust in the much.

luke 16:11.english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will intrust to you the reality?

luke 16:12.english: And if ye have not been found faithful in that which is not yours, who will give to you that which is yours?

luke 16:13.english: There is no servant, who can serve two lords. For, either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will honor the one and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

luke 16:14.english: And the Pharisees, when they heard all these things, because they loved money, derided him.

luke 16:15.english: And Jesus said to them: Ye are such as justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your heart: for that which is exalted among men, is abominable before God.

luke 16:16.english: The law and the prophets were until John: since then, the kingdom of God is proclaimed, and every one presseth it to enter in.

luke 16:17.english: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one letter to pass from the law.

luke 16:18.english: Whoever putteth away his wife, and taketh another, committeth adultery; and whoever taketh her that is put away, committeth adultery.

luke 16:19.english: And there was a certain rich man, who was clothed in fine linen and scarlet, and passed every day in splendid luxury.

luke 16:20.english: And there was a certain poor man, whose name was Lazarus; and he was laid at the gate of the rich man, smitten with ulcers.

luke 16:21.english: And he desired to fill his belly with the fragments that fell from the rich man's table: and the dogs also came and licked his ulcers.

luke 16:22.english: And so it was, that the poor man died; and angels transported him to Abraham's bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.

luke 16:23.english: And being tormented in hell, he raised his eyes from afar off, and saw Abraham, and Lazarus in his bosom.

luke 16:24.english: And he called with a loud voice, and said: Abraham, my father, have pity on me; and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and moisten my tongue; for, lo, I am tormented in this flame.

luke 16:25.english: And Abraham said to him: My son, remember, that thou receivedst thy good things in thy lifetime, and Lazarus his evil things: and now, behold he is here at rest, and thou art tormented.

luke 16:26.english: And with all these, there is a great barrier between us and you; so that they who would pass from here to you, cannot; neither can they pass from there to us

luke 16:27.english: He said to him: I pray thee, therefore, my father, that thou wouldst send him to my father's house;

luke 16:28.english: for I have five brothers; that he may go and protest to them; lest they also come to this place of torment.

luke 16:29.english: Abraham said to him: They have Moses and the prophets, let them hear them.

luke 16:30.english: But he said to him: No, my father Abraham: but if one shall go to them from the dead, they will repent.

luke 16:31.english: Abraham said to him: If they hear not Moses and the prophets, they will not believe, though one should rise from the dead.

luke 17:1.english: And Jesus said to his disciples: It cannot be, but that offences will come: but woe to him, by whom they come.

luke 17:2.english: Better for him were it, if a millstone were suspended to his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

luke 17:3.english: Take heed to yourselves. If thy brother transgress, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

luke 17:4.english: And if he shall offend against thee seven times in a day, and, seven times in a day, shall turn himself to thee, and say, I repent; forgive him.

luke 17:5.english: And the Legates said to our Lord: Increase our faith.

luke 17:6.english: He said to them: If ye had faith like a grain of mustard seed, ye might say to this mulberry-tree, Be thou torn up by the roots, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.

luke 17:7.english: Which of you, having a servant driving a yoke of oxen, or tending sheep, will say to him when he cometh from the field, Pass on at once, and recline for supper?

luke 17:8.english: But he will say to him: Prepare for me what I may sup upon, and gird thy loins and serve me, until I have eaten and drunken; and afterwards thou shalt eat and drink.

luke 17:9.english: Hath he thanks for him, because the servant did what was commanded him? I think not.

luke 17:10.english: So also ye, when ye have done all the things commanded you, say: We are unprofitable servants, for we have done only what we were obligated to do.

luke 17:11.english: And it occurred as Jesus advanced towards Jerusalem, that he passed among the Samaritans into Galilee.

luke 17:12.english: And when he drew near to enter a certain village, there met him ten leprous men; and they stood at a distance,

luke 17:13.english: and raised their voice, and said: Our Rabbi, Jesus, have compassion upon us.

luke 17:14.english: And when he had looked upon them, he said to them: Go, show yourselves to the priests. And as they were going, they were cleansed.

luke 17:15.english: And one of them, when he saw that he was cleansed, returned, and with a loud voice, glorified God.

luke 17:16.english: And he fell on his face, at the feet of Jesus, and thanked him. And he was a Samaritan.

luke 17:17.english: And Jesus answered, and said: Were they not ten who were cleansed? Where are the nine?

luke 17:18.english: Have they so gone as not to come and give glory to God; except this one, who is of another nation?

luke 17:19.english: And he said to him; Arise, and go: thy faith hath given thee life.

luke 17:20.english: And as some of the Pharisees asked him, When the kingdom of God would come; he answered, and said to them: The kingdom of God will not come with observables.

luke 17:21.english: And they will not say: Behold, here it is! or, Behold, it is there! For lo, the kingdom of God is within you

luke 17:22.english: And he said to his disciples: The days will come, when ye will long to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye will not see them.

luke 17:23.english: And if they shall say to you: Lo, here he is! or, Lo, there he is! go not forth.

luke 17:24.english: For, as the lightning darteth from the heavens, and illuminateth all beneath the heavens; so will the Son of man be, in his day.

luke 17:25.english: But, previously, he is to suffer many things, and to be rejected by this generation.

luke 17:26.english: And as it was in the days of Noah, so will it be in the days of the Son of man.

luke 17:27.english: They ate and drank, they took wives and were given to husbands, until the day that Noah entered the ark; and the flood came, and destroyed every one.

luke 17:28.english: And again, as it was in the days of Lot; they ate and drank, bought and sold, planted and built.

luke 17:29.english: But in the day that Lot went out of Sodom, the Lord rained fire and sulphur from heaven, and destroyed them all.

luke 17:30.english: Thus will it be, in the day when the Son of man shall be revealed.

luke 17:31.english: In that day, let him that is on the house-top, and his goods in the house, not come down to take them: and let him that is in the field, not return after what is behind him.

luke 17:33.english: He that desireth to preserve his life, will lose it; and he that will lose his life, shall preserve it.

luke 17:34.english: I tell you, that, in that night, two will be in one bed; one will be taken, and the other left.

luke 17:35.english: And two females will be grinding together; one will be taken, and the other left.

luke 17:36.english: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken, and the other left.

luke 17:37.english: They answered, and said to him: Whither, our Lord? He said to them: Where the body is, there will the eagles assemble themselves.

luke 18:1.english: And he spoke to them a similitude also, that men should pray at all times, and not become weary.

luke 18:2.english: There was a judge in a certain city, who feared not God, and regarded not men.

luke 18:3.english: And there was a certain widow in that city; and she came to him, and said: Vindicate me against my adversary.

luke 18:4.english: And he would not, for a long time: but afterwards, he said to himself: Though I fear not God, and regard not men,

luke 18:5.english: yet, because this widow troubleth me, I will vindicate her; that she may not be always coming and troubling me.

luke 18:6.english: And our Lord said: Hear what the unjust judge saith.

luke 18:7.english: And will not God, much more, vindicate his chosen, who call upon him by day and by night; and have patience with them?

luke 18:8.english: I tell you, He will vindicate them speedily. Yet the Son of man will come; and will he find faith on the earth?

luke 18:9.english: And he spake this similitude, against certain persons, who had confidence in themselves that they were righteous, and despised every one.

luke 18:10.english: Two men went up to the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

luke 18:11.english: And the Pharisee stood by himself, and prayed thus: God, I thank thee that I have not been like the rest of men, rapacious, oppressive, and adulterous; nor like this publican.

luke 18:12.english: But I fast twice in a week, and tithe all I possess.

luke 18:13.english: And the publican stood afar off, and would not even lift his eyes to heaven, but smote upon his breast, and said: God, be merciful to me, a sinner.

luke 18:14.english: I say to you, that this man went down to his house justified, rather than the Pharisee. For every one that exalteth himself, will be humbled; and every one that humbleth himself, will be exalted.

luke 18:15.english: And they brought to him infants, that he might touch them: and his disciples saw them, and rebuked them.

luke 18:16.english: But Jesus called them, and said to them: Suffer little children to come to me, and forbid them not; for of those that are like them, of such is the kingdom of heaven.

luke 18:17.english: Verily I say to you, That he who shall not receive the kingdom of God, as a little child, will not enter it.

luke 18:18.english: And one of the chiefs asked him, and said to him: Good Teacher, what shall I do, that I may inherit eternal life?

luke 18:19.english: Jesus said to him: Why callest thou me, good? For, there is none good, except one; God.

luke 18:20.english: Thou knowest the commandments: Thou shalt not kill; and thou shalt not commit adultery; and thou shalt not steal; and thou shalt not testify a false testimony; honor thy father and thy mother.

luke 18:21.english: He said to him: All these have I kept, from my childhood.

luke 18:22.english: And when Jesus heard these words, he said to him: One thing is lacking to thee: go, sell all that thou hast, and give to the poor; and thou wilt have a treasure in heaven; and come after me.

luke 18:23.english: And he, when he heard these words, was dejected; for he was very rich.

luke 18:24.english: And when Jesus saw that he was dejected, he said: How difficult it is, for those that have wealth to enter into the kingdom of God!

luke 18:25.english: It is easier for a camel to enter the eye of a needle, than a rich man the kingdom of God.

luke 18:26.english: They who heard it, said to him: Who then can have life?

luke 18:27.english: And Jesus said: Those things which, with men, cannot be, with God, can be.

luke 18:28.english: Simon Cephas said to him: Lo, we have left every thing, and come after thee.

luke 18:29.english: Jesus said to him: Verily I say to you: There is no man, who hath left houses, or parents, or brothers, or wife, or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,

luke 18:30.english: that shall not receive manifold in the present time, and, in the coming world, eternal life.

luke 18:31.english: And Jesus took his twelve, and said to them: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem; and all the things written in the prophets, concerning the Son of man, will be fulfilled.

luke 18:32.english: For he will be delivered over to the Gentiles; and they will mock him, and spit in his face;

luke 18:33.english: and will scourge him, and will treat him with ignominy, and will kill him; and, the third day, he will arise.

luke 18:34.english: But not one of these things, did they understand; but this subject was hidden from them, and they knew not the things told to them. And as they came near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the side of the way, begging.

luke 18:35.english: : And he heard the noise of the multitude that passed, and inquired what it was.

luke 18:36.english: : And he heard the noise of the multitude that passed, and inquired what it was.

luke 18:37.english: They say to him: Jesus the Nazarean is passing by.

luke 18:38.english: And he called out, and said: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

luke 18:39.english: And they that went before Jesus rebuked him, that he might be silent. But he cried out the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.

luke 18:40.english: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be called to him. And when he came to him, he asked him,

luke 18:41.english: and said to him: What wilt thou, that I do for thee? And he said: My Lord, that I may see.

luke 18:42.english: And Jesus said to him: See thou; thy faith hath vivified thee.

luke 18:43.english: And immediately he saw. And he followed after him, and glorified God. And all the people who beheld, gave glory to God.

luke 19:1.english: And as Jesus entered and passed through Jericho,

luke 19:2.english: there was a certain man, whose name was Zaccheus, who was rich, and chief of the publicans;

luke 19:3.english: and he wished to see Jesus, who he was; and could not, on account of the crowd; because Zaccheus was small in stature.

luke 19:4.english: And he ran forward of Jesus, and climbed a wild fig-tree, in order to see him; for he was to pass that way.

luke 19:5.english: And when Jesus came to the place, he saw him, and said to him: Make haste and come down, Zaccheus; for I must be at thy house to-day.

luke 19:6.english: And he hastened, and came down, and received him with gladness.

luke 19:7.english: And when they all saw it, they murmured, and said: He hath gone in to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

luke 19:8.english: And Zaccheus stood up, and said to Jesus: Behold, my Lord, the half of my riches I give to the poor; and to every man, whom I have wronged in any thing, I restore fourfold.

luke 19:9.english: Jesus said to him: This day, life is to this house; for he also is a son of Abraham.

luke 19:10.english: For the Son of man came, to seek and to vivify that which was lost.

luke 19:11.english: And when they heard these things, he proceeded to utter a similitude; because he was near to Jerusalem, and they supposed that the kingdom of God was to be soon developed.

luke 19:12.english: And he said: A certain man of high birth was going to a distant place, to obtain royalty, and return again.

luke 19:13.english: And he called his ten servants, and gave them ten pounds: and he said to them, Traffic until I come.

luke 19:14.english: But the inhabitants of his city hated him; and they sent envoys after him, saying: We wish this man not to reign over us.

luke 19:15.english: And when he had obtained the royalty, and had returned, he commanded those servants to be called, to whom he had committed his money; that he might know what each of them had gained by trading.

luke 19:16.english: And the first came, and said: My Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

luke 19:17.english: He said to him: Well done, good servant! As thou hast been faithful over a little, thou shalt have authority over ten towns.

luke 19:18.english: And the second came, and said: My lord, thy pound hath produced five pounds.

luke 19:19.english: He said likewise to him: Thou also shalt have authority over five towns.

luke 19:20.english: And another came, and said: My lord, lo, this is thy pound, which hath been with me, laid up in fine linen.

luke 19:21.english: For I was afraid of thee, because thou art a hard man, and takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou sowedst not.

luke 19:22.english: He said to him: Out of thy own mouth will I judge thee, thou evil servant. Thou knewest me, that I am a hard man, and that I take up what I laid not down, and reap what I sowed not!

luke 19:23.english: Why didst thou not put my money into the broker's hands, that when I came, I might have demanded it with interest?

luke 19:24.english: And he said to them that stood before him: Take from him the pound, and give it to him with whom are the ten pounds.

luke 19:25.english: They say to him: Our lord, there are with him ten pounds.

luke 19:26.english: He said to them: I tell you, that to every one that hath, will be given; and from him that hath not, even what he hath will be taken away.

luke 19:27.english: But as for those my enemies, who would not have me to reign over them, bring them and slay them before me.

luke 19:28.english: And when Jesus had spoken these things, he went forward, to go to Jerusalem.

luke 19:29.english: And when he arrived at Bethphage and Bethany, near to the mount called the place of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

luke 19:30.english: and said to them: Go ye to the village that is over against us, and as ye enter it, ye will find a colt tied, on which no man ever rode; loose him and bring him.

luke 19:31.english: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? say to him: Our Lord needeth him.

luke 19:32.english: And they went who were sent, and they found, as he said to them.

luke 19:33.english: And as they loosed the colt, the owner of him said to them: Why do ye loose that colt?

luke 19:34.english: And they said: Because our Lord needeth him.

luke 19:35.english: And they brought him to Jesus. And they cast their garments upon the colt, and set Jesus upon him.

luke 19:36.english: And as he went, they spread their garments in the way.

luke 19:37.english: And when he came near to the descent of the place of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice, and to praise God, with a loud voice, for all the mighty deeds which they had seen.

luke 19:38.english: And they said: Blessed be the king, that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory on high.

luke 19:39.english: And some of the Pharisees from among the crowd, said to him: Rabbi, rebuke thy disciples.

luke 19:40.english: He said to them: I tell you, that, if these should be silent, the stones would cry out.

luke 19:41.english: And as he drew near, and beheld the city, he wept over it:

luke 19:42.english: and said: O, hadst thou known the things that are of thy peace, at least in this thy day: but now they are hidden from thy eyes.

luke 19:43.english: For the days will come upon thee, when thy enemies will encompass thee, and besiege thee on every side.

luke 19:44.english: And they will destroy thee, and thy children within thee; and will not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

luke 19:45.english: And when he entered the temple, he began to expel those who bought and sold in it.

luke 19:46.english: And he said to them: It is written, My house is a house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of robbers.

luke 19:47.english: And he taught daily in the temple: and the chief priests and Scribes and Elders of the people, sought to destroy him.

luke 19:48.english: But they found not, what they could do to him; for all the people hung upon him to hear him.

luke 20:1.english: And on one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple, and preaching, the chief priests and Scribes, with the Elders, came upon him,

luke 20:2.english: and said to him: Tell us, by what authority thou doest these things? And who is it, that gave thee this authority?

luke 20:3.english: Jesus answered, and said to them: I also will ask you a word, and tell ye me.

luke 20:4.english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?

luke 20:5.english: And they reasoned with themselves, and said: If we say, From heaven; he will say to us, And why did ye not believe him?

luke 20:6.english: But if we say, From men; all the people will stone us; for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

luke 20:7.english: And they said to him: We do not know, whence it was.

luke 20:8.english: Jesus said to them: Neither do I tell you, by what authority I do these things.

luke 20:9.english: And he began to utter this similitude to the people: A certain man planted a vineyard, and leased it to cultivators, and went abroad for a long time.

luke 20:10.english: And in time, he sent his servant to the cultivators, that they might give him of the fruits of the vineyard. But the cultivators beat him, and sent him away empty.

luke 20:11.english: And again he sent another servant; and him also they beat, and treated with rudeness, and sent empty away.

luke 20:12.english: And again he sent the third. And they wounded him, and cast him out.

luke 20:13.english: The lord of the vineyard said: What shall I do? I will send my dear son. Perhaps they will look upon him, and be ashamed.

luke 20:14.english: But when the cultivators saw him, they reasoned with themselves, and said: This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.

luke 20:15.english: And they cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

luke 20:16.english: He will come, and destroy those cultivators, and will lease the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said: This shall not be.

luke 20:17.english: And he looked upon them, and said: What is that which is written, The stone, which the builders rejected, is become the chief corner stone?

luke 20:18.english: And whoever shall fall upon this stone, will be broken; and on whomsoever it shall fall, it will crush him in pieces.

luke 20:19.english: And the chief priests and Scribes sought to lay hands on him, at that time; but they were afraid of the people; for they knew, that he spoke this similitude against them.

luke 20:20.english: And they sent to him spies, who feigned themselves righteous men, that they might insnare him in discourse, and deliver him up to a court, and to the authority of the president.

luke 20:21.english: And they questioned him, and said to him: Teacher, we know that thou speakest and teachest correctly, and hast no respect of persons, but teachest the way of God in truth.

luke 20:22.english: Is it lawful for us to pay head-money to Caesar, or not?

luke 20:23.english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said: Why tempt ye me?

luke 20:24.english: Show me a denarius. Whose is this image and superscription upon it? They said to him, Caesar's.

luke 20:25.english: Jesus said to them: Then, give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's.

luke 20:26.english: And they could not catch from him a word of accusation before the people: and they were surprised at his answers, and were silent.

luke 20:27.english: And some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came and questioned him,

luke 20:28.english: and said to him: Teacher, Moses wrote to us, that if a man's brother die, who had a wife without children, his surviving brother shall take his wife, and raise up seed to his deceased brother.

luke 20:29.english: Now, there were seven brothers; and the first took a wife, and died without children.

luke 20:30.english: And the second took her to wife; and he died without children.

luke 20:31.english: And again, the third took her, and in like manner also all the seven; and they died, and left no children.

luke 20:32.english: At last, the woman likewise died.

luke 20:33.english: In the resurrection, therefore, of which of them will she be the wife, for the seven took her?

luke 20:34.english: Jesus said to them: The children of this world take wives, and wives are given to husbands.

luke 20:35.english: But they who are worthy of that world, and of the resurrection from the dead, do not take wives, nor are wives given to husbands.

luke 20:36.english: Neither can they die any more; for they are as the angels, and are the children of God, because they are children of the resurrection.

luke 20:37.english: But that the dead will arise, even Moses showed; for, at the bush, he maketh mention, while he saith: The Lord, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

luke 20:38.english: Now God is not the God of the dead, but of the living; for they all live to him.

luke 20:39.english: And some of the Scribes answered, and said to him: Teacher, thou hast spoken well.

luke 20:40.english: And they did not again venture to question him, on any matter.

luke 20:41.english: And he said also to them: How do the Scribes say of Messiah, that he is the son of David?

luke 20:42.english: And David himself said, in the book of Psalms: The Lord said to my Lord, seat thyself at my right hand,

luke 20:43.english: until I shall place thy foes under thy feet.

luke 20:44.english: If David, therefore, called him, My Lord; how is he his son?

luke 20:45.english: And while all the people heard, he said to his disciples:

luke 20:46.english: Beware of the Scribes, who choose to walk in long robes, and love a salutation in the streets, and the chief seats in the synagogues, and the chief couches at suppers:

luke 20:47.english: who eat up the houses of widows, under pretence that they prolong their prayers. They will receive a greater condemnation.

luke 21:1.english: And Jesus looked upon the rich, who cast their oblations into the treasury.

luke 21:2.english: And he saw also a certain poor widow, who cast in two mites.

luke 21:3.english: And he said: Truly I say to you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than any one.

luke 21:4.english: For all they, from what was superfluous to them, have cast into the receptacle of oblations to God; but she, from her penury, hath cast in all that she possessed.

luke 21:5.english: And when some spoke of the temple, as adorned with goodly stones and oblations, Jesus said to them:

luke 21:6.english: As for these things, on which ye gaze, the days will come, in which there will not be left a stone upon a stone, that is not cast down.

luke 21:7.english: And they questioned him, and said: Teacher, when will these things be? And what is the sign that they are near to take place?

luke 21:8.english: And he said to them: See, that ye be not deceived; for many will come in my name, and will say: I am Messiah and the time is near. But go ye not after them.

luke 21:9.english: And when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not afraid; for these things are previously to take place, but the end is not yet come.

luke 21:10.english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom;

luke 21:11.english: and great earthquakes will occur in several places, and famines, and pestilences; and there will be terrors, and trepidations, and great signs from heaven will be seen, and there will be great tempests.

luke 21:12.english: But before all these things, they will lay hands upon you, and will persecute you, and will deliver you up to councils and to prison, and will arraign you before kings and governors, on account of my name.

luke 21:13.english: But it will be to you for a testimony.

luke 21:14.english: And settle it in your hearts, that ye will not previously seek instruction for making a defence.

luke 21:15.english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your enemies will be unable to withstand.

luke 21:16.english: And your parents, and your brothers, and your relatives, and your friends, will deliver you up, and cause some of you to die.

luke 21:17.english: And ye will be hated by every one, on account of my name.

luke 21:18.english: But a hair of your head shall not perish.

luke 21:19.english: And by your patience, will ye preserve your souls.

luke 21:20.english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem with an army encompassing it, then know ye, that its destruction draweth nigh.

luke 21:21.english: Then let them who shall be in Judaea, flee to the mountain district; and let them, who are in the midst of it, flee away; and those in the fields, not enter it.

luke 21:22.english: For these are days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.

luke 21:23.english: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that nurse children, in those days; for then will be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

luke 21:24.english: And they will fall by the edge of the sword, and be carried captive to every place. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles shall be completed.

luke 21:25.english: And there will be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and distress of nations on the earth; and clasping of hands, from astonishment at the noise of the sea;

luke 21:26.english: and dismay that driveth out the souls of men, from fear of that which is to come on the earth; and the powers of heaven will be moved.

luke 21:27.english: And then will they see the Son of man coming in the clouds, with much power, and with great glory.

luke 21:28.english: And when these things shall begin to be, take courage, and lift up your heads, for your deliverance draweth nigh.

luke 21:29.english: And he uttered a similitude to them. Look at the fig-tree, and all the trees.

luke 21:30.english: When they bud forth, ye at once understand from them that summer approacheth.

luke 21:31.english: So also, when ye shall see all these things take place, know ye that the kingdom of God is near.

luke 21:32.english: Verily I say to you, That this generation will not pass away, until all these things occur.

luke 21:33.english: Heaven and earth will pass away; but my word will not pass away.

luke 21:34.english: Take heed to yourselves, that your hearts be, at no time, stupefied by gluttony and ebriety and worldly care; and so that day come upon you unawares.

luke 21:35.english: For, like a hunter's snare, it will spring upon all them that dwell upon the face of the whole land.

luke 21:36.english: Be ye therefore vigilant, at all times, and prayerful; that ye may be worthy to escape the things that are to take place, and may stand before the Son of man.

luke 21:37.english: And, in the daytime he taught in the temple, and at night he went out and lodged in the mount, called the Place of Olives.

luke 21:38.english: And all the people came early to him in the temple, to hear his discourse.

luke 22:1.english: And the feast of unleavened cakes, which is called the passover, drew near.

luke 22:2.english: And the chief priests and Scribes sought how they might kill him, for they were afraid of the people.

luke 22:3.english: And Satan entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was of the number of the twelve.

luke 22:4.english: And he went and conferred with the chief priests and Scribes, and the military commanders of the temple, how he might betray him to them.

luke 22:5.english: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

luke 22:6.english: And he promised them, and sought opportunity to betray him to them, in the absence of the multitude.

luke 22:7.english: And the day of unleavened cakes arrived, on which it was customary for the passover to be slain.

luke 22:8.english: And Jesus sent Cephas and John, and said to them; Go, prepare for us the passover, that we may eat it.

luke 22:9.english: And they said to him: Where wilt thou, that we prepare?

luke 22:10.english: He said to them: Lo, when ye enter the city, there will a man meet you, bearing a vessel of water. Go after him;

luke 22:11.english: and where he entereth, say ye to the lord of the house: Our Rabbi saith, Is there a place of refreshment, in which I may eat the Passover, with my disciples?

luke 22:12.english: And lo, he will show you a large upper room that is furnished; there prepare ye.

luke 22:13.english: And they went, and found as he had said to them: and they made ready the passover.

luke 22:14.english: And when the time arrived, Jesus came and reclined; and the twelve Legates with him.

luke 22:15.english: And he said to them: I have greatly desired to eat this passover with you, before I suffer.

luke 22:16.english: For I say to you, That henceforth I shall not eat it, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

luke 22:17.english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said: Take this, and divide it among you.

luke 22:18.english: For I say to you, That I shall not drink of the product of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

luke 22:19.english: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to them, and said: This is my body, which is given for your sakes. This do ye, in remembrance of me.

luke 22:20.english: And in like manner also concerning the cup, after they had supped, he said: This cup is the new testament in my blood, which, for your sakes, is poured out!

luke 22:21.english: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is on the table.

luke 22:22.english: And the Son of man goeth, as it was determined; but woe to that man, by whom he is betrayed.

luke 22:23.english: And they began to inquire among themselves, which of them it was, that would do this.

luke 22:24.english: And there was contention also among them, who among them would be greatest.

luke 22:25.english: And Jesus said to them: The kings of the nations, are their lords; and those exercising authority over them, are called benefactors.

luke 22:26.english: But ye, not so: but he that is great among you, must be as the least; and he that is chief, as the servitor.

luke 22:27.english: For, which is the greater, he that reclineth, or he that serveth? Is not he that reclineth? But I am among you, as he that serveth.

luke 22:28.english: Ye are they who have continued with me in my trials:

luke 22:29.english: and I promise to you, as my Father hath promised to me, a kingdom:

luke 22:30.english: that ye may eat and drink at the table of my kingdom, and may sit on thrones, and judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

luke 22:31.english: And Jesus said to Simon: Simon, lo, Satan hath desired to sift thee, as wheat:

luke 22:32.english: but I have prayed for thee, that thy faith may not fail. And thou also, in time, turn; and confirm thy brethren.

luke 22:33.english: And Simon said to him: My Lord, with thee I am ready, both for prison and for death.

luke 22:34.english: Jesus said to him: 1 tell thee, Simon, the cock will not crow this day, until thou hast three times denied that thou knowest me.

luke 22:35.english: And he said to them: When I sent you without purses, without wallets and shoes, lacked ye any thing? They say to him: Nothing.

luke 22:36.english: He said to them: Henceforth, let him that hath a purse, take it; and so likewise a wallet. And let him that hath no sword, sell his garment, and buy himself a sword.

luke 22:37.english: For I say to you, That this also, which was written, must be fulfilled in me: I shall be numbered with transgressors. For, all that relates to me, will be fulfilled.

luke 22:38.english: And they said to him: Our Lord, lo, here are two swords. He said to them: They are sufficient.

luke 22:39.english: And he went out, and proceeded, as was his custom, to the mount of the place of Olives; and his disciples followed him.

luke 22:40.english: And when he arrived at the place, he said to them: Pray ye, that ye enter not into temptation.

luke 22:41.english: And he retired from them, about a stone's throw; and kneeled down, and prayed,

luke 22:42.english: and said: Father, if it please thee, let this cup pass from me. Yet not my pleasure, but thine, be done.

luke 22:43.english: And there appeared to him an angel from heaven, who strengthened him.

luke 22:44.english: And as he was in fear, he prayed earnestly; and his sweat was like drops of blood; and it fell on the ground.

luke 22:45.english: And he arose from his prayer, and came to his disciples: and he found them sleeping, from sorrow.

luke 22:46.english: And he said to them: Why sleep ye? Arise, and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

luke 22:47.english: And while he was speaking, lo, a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, came at their head. And he came up to Jesus, and kissed him. For he had given them this sign: Whom I shall kiss, he it is.

luke 22:48.english: Jesus said to him: Judas, is it with a kiss thou betrayest the Son of man?

luke 22:49.english: And when they that were with him, saw what occurred, they said to him: Our Lord, shall we smite them with the sword?

luke 22:50.english: And one of them smote a servant of the high priest, and took off his right ear.

luke 22:51.english: And Jesus answered and said: Sufficient, thus far. And he touched the ear of him that was smitten, and healed him.

luke 22:52.english: And Jesus said to those who had come upon him, the chief priests and Elders and military captains of the temple: Have ye come out against me, as against a robber, with swords, and with clubs, to take me?

luke 22:53.english: I was with you daily in the temple, and ye laid not hands upon me. But this is your hour, and the reign of darkness.

luke 22:54.english: And they took him, and conducted him to the house of the high priest. And Simon followed after him, at a distance.

luke 22:55.english: And they kindled a fire in the middle of the court, and sat around it; and Simon also sat among them.

luke 22:56.english: And a certain maid saw him sitting at the fire, and she looked upon him, and said: This man also was with him.

luke 22:57.english: But he denied, and said: Woman, I have not known him.

luke 22:58.english: And a little after, another person saw him, and said to him: Thou too art one of them. And Cephas said: I am not.

luke 22:59.english: And an hour after, another contended and said: Certainly, this man also was with him, for he likewise is a Galilean.

luke 22:60.english: Cephas said: Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he was speaking, the cock crew.

luke 22:61.english: And Jesus turned, and looked upon Cephas. And Simon remembered the word of our Lord, which he spoke to him: Before the cock shall crow, thou wilt deny me three times.

luke 22:62.english: And Simon went out, and wept bitterly.

luke 22:63.english: And the men who had taken Jesus, insulted him, and blinded him,

luke 22:64.english: and smote him on his face, and said: Prophesy thou, who smote thee?

luke 22:65.english: And many other things they revilingly uttered, and spoke against him.

luke 22:66.english: And when the day dawned, the Elders and chief priests and Scribes assembled together; and they led him to the place of their meeting,

luke 22:67.english: and said to him: If thou art the Messiah, tell us. He said to them: If I tell you, ye will not believe in me.

luke 22:68.english: And if I should ask you, ye will not return me an answer; nor will ye release me.

luke 22:69.english: From this time, the Son of man will sit on the right hand of the majesty of God.

luke 22:70.english: And they all said: Thou art then, the Son of God? Jesus said to them: Ye say that I am.

luke 22:71.english: They say: What further need have we of witnesses? For we have heard from his own mouth.

luke 23:1.english: And the whole company of them arose, and carried him before Pilate.

luke 23:2.english: And they began to accuse him, and said: We have found this man seducing our people, and forbidding to pay the capitation money to Caesar, and declaring himself to be king Messiah.

luke 23:3.english: And Pilate interrogated him, and said to him: Art thou king of the Jews? He said to him: Thou hast said.

luke 23:4.english: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the company: I find no crime upon this man.

luke 23:5.english: And they vociferated, and said: He raiseth disturbance among our people, by teaching in all Judaea, commencing from Galilee, and quite to this place.

luke 23:6.english: And Pilate, when he heard the name Galilee, inquired if the man were a Galilean.

luke 23:7.english: And having learned that he was from under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod; for he was at Jerusalem on those days.

luke 23:8.english: And Herod rejoiced greatly when he saw Jesus, for he had been desirous to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things of him, and he hoped to see some sign from him.

luke 23:9.english: And he asked him many questions; but Jesus gave him no reply.

luke 23:10.english: And the chief priests and Scribes stood up, and accused him vehemently.

luke 23:11.english: And Herod and his warriors contemned him. And when he had mocked him, he clothed him in a purple robe, and sent him to Pilate.

luke 23:12.english: And on that day, Pilate and Herod became friends to each other; for there had previously been enmity between them.

luke 23:13.english: And Pilate called the chief priests and the rulers of the people,

luke 23:14.english: and said to them: Ye have brought this man before me, as a disturber of your people; and lo, I have examined him before you, and I find in the man no crime, among all that ye charge upon him.

luke 23:15.english: Neither yet Herod: for I sent him to him, and lo, nothing deserving death hath been done by him.

luke 23:16.english: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

luke 23:17.english: For it was a custom, that he should release one at the festival.

luke 23:18.english: And all the company vociferated, and said: Away with this man; and release to us Barabbas.

luke 23:19.english: He was one who had been thrown into prison, on account of a sedition and murder which had occurred in the city.

luke 23:20.english: And Pilate, being disposed to release Jesus, conversed with them again.

luke 23:21.english: But they cried out, and said: Crucify him; crucify him.

luke 23:22.english: And he said to them the third time: But, what evil hath he done? I find no crime in him deserving of death. I will scourge him, therefore, and release him.

luke 23:23.english: But they were urgent, with a loud voice; and demanded of him, that they might crucify him.

luke 23:24.english: And Pilate decreed, that their request be granted.

luke 23:25.english: And he released to them him, who for sedition and murder had been cast into prison, for whom they petitioned; and he delivered up Jesus to their pleasure.

luke 23:26.english: And as they led him away, they seized Simon the Cyrenian, coming from the fields. and laid upon him the cross, to bear it after Jesus.

luke 23:27.english: And there followed after him a great multitude of people; and those women also who wailed and lamented over him.

luke 23:28.english: And Jesus turned to them, and said to them: Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me; but weep rather for yourselves, and for your children.

luke 23:29.english: For lo, the days are coming, in which they will say: Happy the barren, and the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.

luke 23:30.english: Then will they begin to say to the mountains, Fall upon us! and to the hills, Cover us!

luke 23:31.english: For if they do these things in a green tree, what will be in the dry?

luke 23:32.english: And there went along with him two others, malefactors, to be crucified.

luke 23:33.english: And when they came to a certain place which is called a Skull, they crucified him there; and the two malefactors, the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

luke 23:34.english: And Jesus said: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they divided his garments, casting a lot upon them.

luke 23:35.english: And the people stood and looked on; and the rulers also derided him, and said: He quickened others; let him quicken himself, if he is the Messiah, the chosen of God.

luke 23:36.english: And the soldiers like wise mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

luke 23:37.english: and saying to him: If thou art the king of the Jews, quicken thyself.

luke 23:38.english: And there was likewise a superscription over him, written in Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

luke 23:39.english: And one of the malefactors who were crucified with him, reproached him, and said: If thou art the Messiah, rescue thyself, and rescue us.

luke 23:40.english: But his fellow Malefactor rebuked him, said to him: Art thou not afraid even of God, seeing thou art under the same sentence?

luke 23:41.english: And we justly; for we have a retribution according to our deserts, and according to our deeds; but nothing hateful hath been done by him.

luke 23:42.english: And he said to Jesus: My Lord, remember me, when thou comest into thy kingdom.

luke 23:43.english: Jesus said to him: Verily I say to you, That this day thou shalt be with me in paradise.

luke 23:44.english: And it was about the sixth hour; and darkness was over all the land, until the ninth hour.

luke 23:45.english: And the sun was darkened, and the curtain of the door of the temple was rent through its middle.

luke 23:46.english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and said: My Father, into thy hand I commit my spirit. Thus he spake, and expired.

luke 23:47.english: And when the centurion saw what occurred, he glorified God and said: Certainly, this was a righteous man.

luke 23:48.english: And all the multitudes who had assembled at this spectacle, on seeing what occurred, returned, smiting upon their breasts.

luke 23:49.english: And there were standing at a distance, all they that knew Jesus, and those women who came with him from Galilee; and they beheld these things.

luke 23:50.english: And there was a certain man, whose name was Joseph, a counsellor, from Ramath a city of Judaea, who was a good man and righteous;

luke 23:51.english: and he had not consented to their decision and deed; and he was waiting for the kingdom of God.

luke 23:52.english: This man went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

luke 23:53.english: And he took it down, and wrapped it in a winding-sheet of linen; and laid it in an excavated sepulchre, in which no one had hitherto been laid.

luke 23:54.english: And it was the day of preparation, and the sabbath began to dawn.

luke 23:55.english: And those women who came with him from Galilee, approached, and viewed the sepulchre, and the manner in which the body was deposited.

luke 23:56.english: And they returned, and prepared perfumes and aromatics; and they rested on the sabbath, as it is commanded.

luke 24:1.english: And on the first day of the week, in the morning, while it was yet dark, they came to the sepulchre, and brought the aromatics they had prepared. And there were other women with them.

luke 24:2.english: And they found the stone rolled from the sepulchre.

luke 24:3.english: And they entered, and found not the body of Jesus.

luke 24:4.english: And as they wondered at this, behold, two men stood opposite them; and their raiment was effulgent.

luke 24:5.english: And they were in fear, and bowed their faces to the ground. And the men said to them: Why seek ye the living among the dead?

luke 24:6.english: He is not here; he is risen. Remember how he conversed with you, when he was in Galilee,

luke 24:7.english: and said, That the Son of man was to be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and to be crucified, and to rise on the third day.

luke 24:9.english: And they returned from the sepulchre, and related all these things to the eleven, and to the rest.

luke 24:10.english: Now they were Mary Magdalena, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and the others with them, who related these things to the Legates.

luke 24:11.english: And these words appeared in their eyes as dreams: and they believed them not.

luke 24:12.english: But Simon arose, and ran to the sepulchre, and looked in, and saw the linen lying by itself: and he went away wondering in himself at what had occurred.

luke 24:13.english: And lo, two of them, on the same day, were going to a village named Emmaus, distant sixty furlongs from Jerusalem.

luke 24:14.english: And they talked together of all that had occurred.

luke 24:15.english: And as they conversed, and questioned each other, Jesus came, and drew near, and walked with them.

luke 24:16.english: And their eyes were held, that they did not recognize him.

luke 24:17.english: And he said to them: What are these discourses, which ye hold with each other, as ye walk and are sad?

luke 24:18.english: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered and said to him: Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, that thou knowest not the things that have occurred there in these days?
