john 13:12.english: And when he had washed their feet, he resumed his long garments, and reclined. And he said to them: Understand ye what I have done to you?

john 13:13.english: Ye call me, Our Rabbi, and Our Lord; and ye speak well; for I am so.

john 13:14.english: If then I, your Lord and your Rabbi, have washed your feet, how much more ought ye to wash the feet of one another?

john 13:15.english: For I have given you this example, that ye might do, as I have done to you.

john 13:16.english: Verily, verily, I say to you, That no servant is greater than his lord; and no legate is greater than he who sent him.

john 13:17.english: If ye know these things, happy will ye be if ye do them.

john 13:18.english: Not of you all, do I speak: I know whom I have chosen. But that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me, hath lifted his heel against me.

john 13:19.english: From this time, I tell you, before it occurs, that when it shall occur, ye may know that I am he.

john 13:20.english: Verily, verily, I say to you: He that receiveth him whom I send, receiveth me; and he that receiveth me, receiveth him that sent me.

john 13:21.english: These things said Jesus, and he was agitated in his spirit; and he testified, and said: Verily, verily, I say to you, That one of you will betray me.

john 13:22.english: And the disciples stared at one another; because they knew not, of whom he spake.

john 13:23.english: And there was one of his disciples, who was reclining on his bosom, he whom Jesus loved;

john 13:24.english: to him Simon Cephas beckoned, that he should ask him, who it was of whom he spoke.

john 13:25.english: And that disciple fell upon the breast of Jesus, and said to him: My Lord, which is he?

john 13:26.english: Jesus answered and said: He it is, to whom I give the bread when I have dipped it. And Jesus dipped the bread, and gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

john 13:27.english: And after the bread, then Satan entered into him. And Jesus said to him: What thou doest, do quickly.

john 13:28.english: And no one of those reclining, knew, wherefore he said this to him.

john 13:29.english: For some of them supposed, because the purse was in the hands of Judas, that Jesus expressly charged him to buy something needful for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.

john 13:30.english: And Judas took the bread at once, and went out of the house. And it was night when he went out.

john 13:31.english: And Jesus said: Now is the Son of man glorified; and God is glorified in him.

john 13:32.english: And if God is glorified in him, God will glorify him in himself; and will glorify him speedily.

john 13:33.english: My children, a little longer I am with you; and ye will seek for me; and, as I said to the Jews, Whither I go ye cannot come, so I now say to you.

john 13:34.english: A new commandment I give to you, that ye be affectionate to each other. As I have loved you, do ye also love one another.

john 13:35.english: By this will every one know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love for each other.

john 13:36.english: Simon Cephas said to him: Our Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered, and said to him: Whither I go, thou canst not now come after me; but thou wilt at last come.

john 13:37.english: Simon Cephas said to him: My Lord, why can I not come after thee? I would lay down my life for thee.

john 13:38.english: Jesus said to him: Wouldst thou lay down thy life for me? Verily, verily, I say to thee, The cock will not crow, until thou hast three times denied me.

john 14:1.english: Let not your heart be troubled: believe in God, and, believe in me.

john 14:2.english: There are many mansions in the house of my Father: and if not, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.

john 14:3.english: And if I go to prepare for you a place, I will come again and take you to myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

john 14:4.english: And whither I go, ye know; and the way ye know.

john 14:5.english: Thomas said to him: Our Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

john 14:6.english: Jesus said to him: I am the way, and truth, and life: no one cometh unto my Father, but by me.

john 14:7.english: If ye had known me, ye would also have known my Father: and henceforth, ye know him, and have seen him.

john 14:8.english: Philip said to him: Our Lord, show us the Father, and it will suffice for us.

john 14:9.english: Jesus said to him: Have I been all this time with you, and hast thou not known me, Philip? He that seeth me, seeth the Father: and how sayest thou, Show us the Father?

john 14:10.english: Believest thou not, that I am in my Father, and my Father in me? And the words which I speak, I speak not from myself: but my Father, who dwelleth in me, he doeth these works.

john 14:11.english: Believe, that I am in my Father, and my Father in me. And if not, believe, at least, on account of the works.

john 14:12.english: Verily, verily, I say to you: He that believeth in me, the works which I do, will he also do. And greater than these will he do, because I go unto my Father.

john 14:13.english: And what ye shall ask in my name, I will do for you; that the Father may be glorified in his Son.

john 14:14.english: And if ye shall ask of me, in my name, I will do it.

john 14:15.english: If ye love me, keep my commands.

john 14:16.english: And I will ask of my Father, and he will give you another Comforter, that he may be with you for ever,

john 14:17.english: the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, and knoweth him not: but ye know him, because he abideth with you, and is in you.

john 14:18.english: I shall not leave you orphans: for I shall come to you in a little while.

john 14:19.english: And the world will not see me; but ye will see me. Because I live, ye will live also.

john 14:20.english: In that day ye will know, that I am in my Father; and that ye are in me, and I in you.

john 14:21.english: He, with whom are my commands, and who keepeth them, he it is that loveth me. And he that loveth me, will be loved by my Father: and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

john 14:22.english: Judas, not Iscariot, said to him: My Lord, how is it that thou art to manifest thyself to us, and not to the world?

john 14:23.english: Jesus answered, and said to him: He that loveth me, observeth my instruction; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our abode with him.

john 14:24.english: But he that loveth me not, observeth not my instruction. And the instruction which ye hear, is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

john 14:25.english: These things have I said to you, while I was with you.

john 14:26.english: But the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you every thing, and will remind you of all that I say to you.

john 14:27.english: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. It is not as the world giveth, that I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, nor be afraid.

john 14:28.english: Ye have heard what I said to you that I go away, and come again to you. If ye had loved me, ye would have rejoiced, that I go to my Father; for my Father is greater than I

john 14:29.english: And now, lo, I have told you, before it occurreth; so that when it shall have occurred, ye may believe.

john 14:30.english: Hereafter I shall not converse much with you; for the ruler of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

john 14:31.english: But that the world may know, that I love my Father, and as my Father commanded me, so I do. Arise; let us go hence.

john 15:1.english: I am the true vine; and my Father is the cultivator.

john 15:2.english: Every branch in me, which yieldeth not fruits, he taketh it away: and that which yieldeth fruits, he cleanseth it, that it may yield more fruits.

john 15:3.english: Ye henceforth are clean, on account of the discourse I have held with you.

john 15:4.english: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot yield fruits of itself, unless it abide in the vine; so also, neither can ye, unless ye abide in me.

john 15:5.english: I am the vine, and ye are the branches. He that abideth in me, and I in him, he yieldeth much fruit; for without me, ye can do nothing.

john 15:6.english: And if a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a withered branch; and they gather it up, and cast it into the fire to be burned.

john 15:7.english: But if ye shall abide in me, and my instructions shall abide in you, whatever ye shall be pleased to ask, it will be given to you.

john 15:8.english: In this is the Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; and ye will be my disciples.

john 15:9.english: As my Father hath loved me, I also have loved you: abide ye in the love of me.

john 15:10.english: If ye shall keep my commands, ye will abide in the love of me, as I have kept the commands of my Father, and abide in his love.

john 15:11.english: These things have I spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be complete.

john 15:12.english: This is my command, that ye love one another, as I have loved you.

john 15:13.english: There is no greater love than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

john 15:14.english: Ye are my friends, if ye do all that I command you.

john 15:15.english: I no longer call you servants; because a servant knoweth not what his lord doeth; but I have called you my friends; because, whatever I have heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

john 15:16.english: It is not ye that chose me, but I that have chosen you; and I have appointed you, that ye also should go and yield fruits, and that your fruits should continue; so that whatever ye may ask of my Father in my name, he may give it you.

john 15:17.english: These things I command you, that ye should love one another.

john 15:18.english: And if the world hate you, know ye, that it hated me before you.

john 15:19.english: And if ye were of the world, the world would love what is of it. But ye are not of the world, for I have chosen you out of the world; for this cause, the world hateth you.

john 15:20.english: Remember the word that I spoke to you, That there is no servant, who is greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; and if they have observed my teaching, they will also observe yours.

john 15:21.english: But all these things will they do to you, on account of my name, because they know not him that sent me.

john 15:22.english: If I had not come and discoursed with them, sin would not have been to them; but now there is no excuse for their sins.

john 15:23.english: He that hateth me, hateth my Father also.

john 15:24.english: If I had not wrought before them works which no other person ever did, sin would not have been to them: but now they have seen, and have hated, both me and my Father;

john 15:25.english: so that in them will be fulfilled the word which is written in their law: They hated me, without a cause.

john 15:26.english: But when the Comforter shall come, whom I will send to you from my Father, that Spirit of truth who proceedeth from the Father, He will testify of me.

john 15:27.english: And do ye also testify; for ye have been with me from the beginning.

john 16:1.english: These things have I said to you, that ye may not be stumbled.

john 16:2.english: For they will eject you from their synagogues; and the hour will come, that whoever shall kill you, will suppose that he presenteth an offering to God.

john 16:3.english: And these things will they do, because they have not known either my Father, or me.

john 16:4.english: These things have I spoken to you, that when the time of them cometh, ye may recollect, that I told you of them. And I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

john 16:5.english: But now, I am going to Him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

john 16:6.english: And because I have told you these things, sorrow hath come and hath filled your hearts.

john 16:7.english: But I tell you the truth, that it is profitable for you that I go away; for, if I go not away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

john 16:8.english: And when he is come, he will convict the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment.

john 16:9.english: Of sin because they believe not in me:

john 16:10.english: and of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more:

john 16:11.english: and of Judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.

john 16:12.english: Moreover, I have much to say to you: but ye cannot comprehend it now.

john 16:13.english: But when the Spirit of truth shall come, he will lead you into all the truth. For he will not speak from his own mind; but whatever he heareth, that will he speak: and he will make known to you things to come.

john 16:14.english: He will glorify me; because he will receive of what is mine, and will show it to you.

john 16:15.english: Whatever the Father hath, is mine: therefore said I to you that he will receive of what is mine, and will show it to you.

john 16:16.english: A little while, and ye will not see me; and again a little while, and ye will see me; because I go to the Father.

john 16:17.english: And his disciples said one to another: What is this that he saith to us, A little while, and ye will not see me and again a little while, and ye will see me, because I go to my Father?

john 16:18.english: And they said: What is this little while, of which he speaketh? We know not what he saith.

john 16:19.english: And Jesus knew, that they desired to ask him; and he said to them: Are ye debating with each other, of what I said to you, A little while, and ye will not see me, and again a little while, and ye will see me?

john 16:20.english: Verily, verily, I say to you, That ye will weep and lament: And the world will rejoice, while to you will be sorrow. But your sorrow will be turned to joy.

john 16:21.english: A woman, in bringing forth, hath sorrow, for the day of her travail hath come: but when she hath brought forth a son, she remembereth not her anguish, because of the joy that a human being is born into the world.

john 16:22.english: Ye also now have sorrow; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will deprive you of your joy.

john 16:23.english: And in that day ye will ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say to you, That whatsoever ye shall ask of my Father in my name, he will give to you.

john 16:24.english: Hitherto ye have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and ye will receive; that your joy may be complete.

john 16:25.english: These things have I spoken to you in allegories: but the hour will come, when I shall not speak to you in allegories, but I will speak to you plainly of the Father.

john 16:26.english: In that day ye will ask in my name; and I do not say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you;

john 16:27.english: for the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I proceeded from the presence of the Father.

john 16:28.english: I proceeded forth from before the Father, and came into the world; and again I leave the world, and go to the Father.

john 16:29.english: His disciples say to him: Lo, now thou speakest plainly, and thou utterest no allegory.

john 16:30.english: Now know we, that thou knowest every thing; and thou hast no need, that any one should ask thee: by this we believe, that thou didst proceed from God.

john 16:31.english: Jesus said to them: Do ye believe?

john 16:32.english: Behold, the hour cometh, and hath now come, when ye will be dispersed, each to his place; and ye will leave me alone. But I am not alone, for the Father is with me.

john 16:33.english: These things have I said to you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye will have trouble: but, take courage, I have vanquished the world.

john 17:1.english: These things spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said: My Father, the hour is come: glorify thy Son, that thy Son may glorify thee.

john 17:2.english: As thou hast given him authority over all flesh, that he might give life eternal to as many as thou hast given him.

john 17:3.english: And this is life eternal, that they may know thee, that thou art the only true God, and whom thou hast sent, Jesus Messiah.

john 17:4.english: I have glorified thee on the earth; the work which thou gavest me to do, I have finished.

john 17:5.english: And now, my Father, glorify thou me, with that glory which I had with thee before the world was.

john 17:6.english: I have made known thy name to the men, whom thou gavest me from the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.

john 17:7.english: Now I have known, that whatever thou hast given me, was from thee.

john 17:8.english: For, the words thou gavest to me, I have given to them; and they have received them, and have known certainly, that I came from thy presence; and they have believed that thou didst send me.

john 17:9.english: And I pray for them; it is not for the world that I pray, but for them whom thou hast given me, for they are thine.

john 17:10.english: And all that is mine is thine, and what is thine is mine; and I am glorified in them.

john 17:11.english: Henceforth I am not in the world; but these are in the world, and I go to thee. Holy Father, keep them in that thy name, which thou hast given to me; that they may be one, as we are.

john 17:12.english: While I have been with them in the world, I have kept them in thy name. Those thou gavest me, have I kept; and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition, that the scripture might be fulfilled.

john 17:13.english: But now I come to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that my joy may be complete in them.

john 17:14.english: I have given them thy word: and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

john 17:15.english: I pray not, that thou wouldst take them out of the world, but that thou wouldst keep them from evil:

john 17:16.english: for they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

john 17:17.english: Father, sanctify them by thy truth, thy word is the truth.

john 17:18.english: As thou didst send me into the world, so have I also sent them into the world.

john 17:19.english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified by the truth.

john 17:20.english: And it is not for them only that I pray, but also for those who shall believe in me through their discourse;

john 17:21.english: that they all may be one; as thou, my Father, art in me, and I in thee; that they also may be one in us; so that the world may believe, that thou didst send me.

john 17:22.english: And the glory which thou gavest me, I have given them; that they may be one, as we are one.

john 17:23.english: I in them, and thou in me; that they may be perfected into one; and that the world may know that thou didst send me, and that thou hast loved them as also thou hast loved me.

john 17:24.english: Father, I desire that those whom thou hast given me, may also be with me where I am; that they may see that glory of mine which thou hast given me, as thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

john 17:25.english: My righteous Father, the world hath not known thee; but I have known thee, and these have known, that thou didst send me.

john 17:26.english: And I have made known to them thy name; and I will make it known; so that the love, with which thou lovedst me, may be in them, and I in them.

john 18:1.english: These things spake Jesus, and went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

john 18:2.english: And Judas also, the betrayer, knew the place; because Jesus often there met with his disciples.

john 18:3.english: Then Judas received a regiment, and from the presence of the chief priests and Pharisees he had officials; and he came to the place with lanterns and lamps and weapons.

john 18:4.english: And Jesus, as he knew every thing that was to befall him, went forth and said to them: Whom seek ye?

john 18:5.english: They say to him: Jesus the Nazarean. Jesus said to them: I am he. And Judas the betrayer was also standing with them.

john 18:6.english: And when Jesus said to them, I am he, they drew back and fell upon the ground.

john 18:7.english: And again Jesus asked them: Whom seek ye? And they said: Jesus the Nazarean.

john 18:8.english: Jesus said to them: I have told you that I am he; and if ye seek me, let these go away:

john 18:9.english: that the speech might be fulfilled, which he uttered: Of them, whom thou hast given me, I have lost not even one.

john 18:10.english: And Simon Cephas had upon him a sword; and he drew it, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear. And the servant's name was Malchus.

john 18:11.english: And Jesus said to Cephas: Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

john 18:12.english: Then the regiment and the chiliarchs and the officials of the Jews laid hold of Jesus, and bound him;

john 18:13.english: and they led him first to the presence of Annas; for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was the high priest of that year.

john 18:14.english: And it was Caiaphas who counselled the Jews, that it was expedient, one man should die for the people.

john 18:15.english: And Simon Cephas and one other of the disciples went after Jesus. And that other disciple knew the high priest; and he entered with Jesus into the hall.

john 18:16.english: But Simon stood without at the door; and that other disciple, who knew the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought in Simon.

john 18:17.english: And the maid who kept the door, said to Simon: Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? And he said: I am not.

john 18:18.english: And the servants and officials were standing, and had placed a fire to warm themselves

john 18:19.english: And the high priest interrogated Jesus respecting his disciples, and respecting his doctrine.

john 18:20.english: And Jesus said to him: I have discoursed openly with the people, and have at all times taught in the synagogue and in the temple, where all the Jews assemble; and I have uttered nothing in private.

john 18:21.english: Why dost thou interrogate me? Ask them who have heard, what I said to them: lo, they know what I have said.

john 18:22.english: And as he said these things, one of the officials standing by, smote the cheek of Jesus, and said to him: Givest thou such an answer to the high priest?

john 18:23.english: Jesus replied, and said to him: If I have spoken evil bear witness of that evil; but if well, why smitest thou me?

john 18:24.english: Now Annas had sent Jesus bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

john 18:25.english: And Simon Cephas was standing and warming himself; and they said to him: Art not thou also one of his disciples? And he denied, and said: I am not.

john 18:26.english: And one of the servants of the high priest, a kinsman of him whose ear Simon cut off, said to him: Did I not see thee with him in the garden?

john 18:27.english: And again Simon denied: and at that moment the cock crew.

john 18:28.english: And they led Jesus from the presence of Caiaphas unto the Praetorium; and it was morning. But they did not enter the Praetorium, lest they should defile themselves before they had eaten the passover.

john 18:29.english: And Pilate went forth to them without, and said to them: What accusation have ye against this man?

john 18:30.english: They replied, and said to him: If he were not a malefactor, we should not have delivered him up to thee.

john 18:31.english: Pilate said to them: Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews said to him: It is not lawful for us to put a man to death:

john 18:32.english: that the speech of Jesus might be fulfilled, when he made known by what death he was to die.

john 18:33.english: And Pilate went into the Praetorium, and called Jesus, and said to him: Art thou the king of the Jews?

john 18:34.english: Jesus said to him: Sayest thou this of thyself, or have others said it to thee of me?

john 18:35.english: Pilate said to him: Am I a Jew? Thy countrymen and the chief priests have delivered thee to me. What hast thou done?

john 18:36.english: Jesus said to him: My kingdom is not of this world. If my kingdom were of this world, my servants would have fought, that I might not be delivered up to the Jews: but now, my kingdom is not from hence.

john 18:37.english: Pilate said to him: Then thou art a king? Jesus said to him: Thou hast said, that I am a king. For this was I born; and for this came I into the world, that I might bear testimony to the truth. Every one that is of the truth, heareth my voice.

john 18:38.english: Pilate said to him: What is the truth? And as he said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them: I find not any crime in him.

john 18:39.english: And ye have a custom that I should release one to you at the passover; will ye, therefore, that I release to you this king of the Jews?

john 18:40.english: And they all cried out, and said: Not this man, but Barabbas. Now this Barabbas was a robber.

john 19:2.english: And the soldiers braided a crown of thorns, and put it on his head; and they clothed him in purple garments:

john 19:3.english: and they said: Hail, king of the Jews! and smote him on his cheeks.

john 19:4.english: And Pilate went out again, and said to them: Lo, I bring him out to you, that ye may know that I find against him no offence whatever.

john 19:5.english: And Jesus went forth, having on him the crown of thorns, and the purple garments. And Pilate said to them: Behold, the man!

john 19:6.english: And when the chief priests and officials saw him, they cried out, and said: Hang him; hang him. Pilate said to them: Take ye him, and crucify him; for I find no offence in him.

john 19:7.english: The Jews say to him: We have a law, and, according to our law, he deserveth death, because he made himself the Son of God.

john 19:8.english: And when Pilate heard that declaration, he feared the more.

john 19:9.english: And he went again into the Praetorium; and he said to Jesus: Whence art thou? And Jesus gave him no answer.

john 19:10.english: Pilate said to him: Wilt thou not speak to me? Knowest thou not, that I have authority to release thee, and have authority to crucify thee?

john 19:11.english: Jesus said to him: Thou wouldst have no authority at all over me, if it were not given to thee from on high: therefore his sin who delivered me up to thee, is greater than thine.

john 19:12.english: And for this reason, Pilate was disposed to release him. But the Jews cried out: If thou release this man, thou art not Caesar's friend: for whoever maketh himself a king, is the adversary of Caesar.

john 19:13.english: And when Pilate heard this declaration, he brought Jesus forth, and sat upon the tribunal, in a place called the pavement of stones; but in Hebrew it is called Gabbatha.

john 19:14.english: And it was the preparation for the passover; and it was about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jews: Behold, your king.

john 19:15.english: But they cried out: Away with him, away with him; hang him, hang him. Pilate said to them: Shall I crucify your king? The chief priests said to him: We have no king, but Caesar.

john 19:16.english: Then he delivered him to them, that they might crucify him. And they took Jesus, and led him away,

john 19:17.english: bearing his cross, to a place called a Skull, and in Hebrew called Golgotha;

john 19:18.english: where they crucified him; and two others with him, the one on this side, and the other on that, and Jesus in the middle.

john 19:19.english: And Pilate also wrote a tablet, and affixed it to his cross. And thus it was written: THIS IS JESUS THE NAZAREAN, KING OF THE JEWS.

john 19:20.english: And many of the Jews read this label; because the place where Jesus was crucified, was near to Jerusalem; and it was written in Hebrew and Greek and Latin.

john 19:21.english: And the chief priests said to Pilate: Write not that he is king of the Jews, but that he said I am king of the Jews.

john 19:22.english: Pilate said: What I have written, I have written.

john 19:23.english: And the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parcels of them, a parcel for each of the soldiers. And his tunic was without seam from the top, woven throughout.

john 19:24.english: And they said one to another: We will not rend it, but will cast the lot upon it, whose it shall he. And the scripture was fulfilled, which said: They divided my garments among them; and upon my venture they cast the lot. These things did the soldiers.

john 19:25.english: And there were standing near the cross of Jesus, his mother, and his mother's sister, and Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalena.

john 19:26.english: And Jesus saw his mother, and that disciple whom he loved, standing by, and he said to his mother: Woman, behold, thy son.

john 19:27.english: And he said to that disciple: Behold, thy mother. And from that hour, the disciple took her near himself.

john 19:28.english: After these things, Jesus knew that every thing was finished; and, that the scripture might be fulfilled, he said: I thirst.

john 19:29.english: And a vessel was standing there, full of vinegar. And they filled a sponge with the vinegar, and put it on a hyssop stalk, and bore it to his mouth.

john 19:30.english: And when Jesus had received the vinegar, he said: Lo; Done. And he bowed his head, and yielded up his spirit.

john 19:31.english: And because it was the preparation, the Jews said: These bodies must not remain all night upon the cross: because the sabbath was dawning; and the day of that sabbath was a great day. And they requested of Pilate, that they should break the legs of those crucified, and take them down.

john 19:32.english: And the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other that was crucified with him.

john 19:33.english: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead; and they broke not his legs.

john 19:34.english: But one of the soldiers thrust a spear into his side; and immediately there issued out blood and water.

john 19:35.english: And he who saw it, hath testified: and his testimony is true: and he knoweth, that he speaketh the truth, that ye also may believe.

john 19:36.english: For these things occurred, that the scripture might be fulfilled, which said: A bone of him shall not be broken.

john 19:37.english: And again another scripture, which saith: They will look on him, whom they pierced.

john 19:38.english: After these things, Joseph of Ramath, (for he was a disciple of Jesus, and kept concealed through fear of the Jews,) requested of Pilate, that he might take away the body of Jesus. And Pilate permitted. And he came, and bore away the body of Jesus.

john 19:39.english: And there came also Nicodemus, (he who previously came to Jesus by night,) and he brought with him a compound of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.

john 19:40.english: and they bore away the body of Jesus, and wound it in linens and aromatics, as it is the custom of the Jews to bury.

john 19:41.english: And there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new sepulchre in which no person had ever been laid.

john 19:42.english: And there they laid Jesus, because the sabbath had commenced, and because the sepulchre was near.

john 20:1.english: And the first day of the week, in the morning, while it was yet dark, Mary Magdalena came to the sepulchre: and she saw that the stone was removed from the grave.

john 20:2.english: And she ran, and came to Simon Cephas, and to that other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them: They have taken away our Lord from the sepulchre, and I know not where they have laid him.

john 20:3.english: And Simon set out, and the other disciple, and they were going to the sepulchre.

john 20:4.english: And they both ran together; but that disciple outran Simon, and came first to the sepulchre.

john 20:5.english: And he looked in, and saw the linen cloths lying: but he did not go in.

john 20:6.english: And after him came Simon; and he entered the sepulchre, and saw the linen cloths lying;

john 20:7.english: and the napkin, that had been wrapped about his head, was not with the linen cloths, but was folded up, and laid in a place by itself.

john 20:8.english: Then entered also the disciple who came first to the sepulchre; and he saw, and believed.

john 20:9.english: For they had not yet learned from the scriptures, that he was to arise from the dead.

john 20:10.english: And those disciples went away again to their place.

john 20:11.english: But Mary remained standing at the sepulchre, and weeping; and as she wept, she looked into the sepulchre

john 20:12.english: and saw two angels in white, who were sitting, one at the pillows and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus was laid.

john 20:13.english: And they said to her: Woman, why weepest thou? She said to them: Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him

john 20:14.english: Having said this, she turned round, and saw Jesus standing, but did not know that it was Jesus.

john 20:15.english: Jesus said to her: Woman, why weepest thou? and, whom dost thou seek? And she supposed that he was the gardener: and she said to him: My lord, if thou hast borne him away, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will go and take him away.

john 20:16.english: Jesus said to her: Mary! And she turned, and said to him in Hebrew: Rabbuni; which is interpreted Teacher.

john 20:17.english: Jesus said to her: Touch me not; for not yet have I ascended to my Father. But go to my brethren, and say to them: I ascend to my Father and your Father, and to my God and your God.

john 20:18.english: Then came Mary Magdalena, and told the disciples that she had seen our Lord; and that he had said these things to her.

john 20:19.english: And on the evening of that first day of the week, the doors being shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came, and stood in the midst of them, and said to them: Peace be with you.

john 20:20.english: Having said this, he showed them his hands and his side. And the disciples rejoiced, when they saw our Lord.

john 20:21.english: And Jesus said to them; Peace be with you. As my Father hath sent me, I also send you.

john 20:22.english: And as he said these things, he breathed on them, and said to them: Receive ye the Holy Spirit.

john 20:23.english: If ye shall remit sins to any one, they will be remitted to him; and if ye shall retain those of any one, they will be retained.

john 20:24.english: But Thomas, who was called the Twin, one of the twelve, was not there with them, when Jesus came.

john 20:25.english: And the disciples said to him: We have seen our Lord. But he said to them: Unless I see in his hands the places of the nails, and put my fingers into them, and extend my hand to his side, I will not believe.

john 20:26.english: And after eight days, the disciples were again within, and Thomas with them: and Jesus came, while the doors were closed, stood in the midst, and said to them: Peace be with you.

john 20:27.english: And he said to Thomas: Reach hither thy finger, and look at my hands; and reach out thy hand and extend it to my side: and be not incredulous, but believing.

john 20:28.english: And Thomas answered, and said to him: My Lord, and my God!

john 20:29.english: Jesus said to him: Now, when thou hast seen me, thou believest: blessed are they, who have not seen me, yet believe.

john 20:30.english: And many other signs did Jesus before his disciples, which are not written in this book.

john 20:31.english: But these are written, that ye may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God; and that when ye believe, ye may have life eternal by his name.

john 21:1.english: After these things, Jesus showed himself again to his disciples, at the sea of Tiberias: and he showed himself thus:

john 21:2.english: There were together, Simon Cephas, and Thomas called the Twin, and Nathaniel who was of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of the disciples.

john 21:3.english: Simon Cephas said to them: I will go and catch fishes. They said to him: We will go with thee. And they went, and embarked in a ship: and that night, they caught nothing.

john 21:4.english: And when it was morning, Jesus stood on the shore of the sea: and the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.

john 21:5.english: And Jesus said to them: Lads, have ye any thing to eat? They say to him: No.

john 21:6.english: He said to them: Cast your net on the right side of the ship, and ye will find them. And they cast; and they could not draw up the net, because of the multitude of fishes it contained.

john 21:7.english: And that disciple whom Jesus loved, said to Cephas That is our Lord. And Simon, when he heard that it was our Lord, took his tunic, and girded his loins, (for he had been naked,) and threw himself into the sea, to go to Jesus.

john 21:8.english: But the other disciples came in the ship, (for they were not very far from the land, only about two hundred cubits,) and they dragged the net with the fishes.

john 21:9.english: And when they came upon the land, they saw coals placed, and fish laid on them, and bread.

john 21:10.english: And Jesus said to them: Bring some of the fishes, which ye have just caught.

john 21:11.english: And Simon Cephas embarked, and drew the net to land, full of huge fishes, one hundred and fifty and three. And with all this weight, the net was not rent.

john 21:12.english: And Jesus said to them: Come and dine. And no one of the disciples presumed to ask him, who he was; for they knew that it was our Lord.

john 21:13.english: And Jesus came, and took bread and fishes, and gave to his disciples.

john 21:14.english: This is the third time that Jesus appeared to his disciples when he had arisen from the dead.

john 21:15.english: And when they had dined, Jesus said to Simon Cephas: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me, more than these do? He said to him: Yes, my Lord: thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus said to him: Feed my lambs for me.

john 21:16.english: Again, he said to him the second time: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He said to him: Yes, my Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus said to him: Feed my sheep for me.

john 21:17.english: Again, Jesus said to him the third time: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? And it grieved Cephas, that he said to him the third time, Lovest thou me; and he said to him: My Lord, thou understandest all things, thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus said to him: Feed my sheep for me.

john 21:18.english: Verily, verily, I say to thee: When thou wast young, thou girdedst thy own loins, and walkedst whither it pleased thee: but when thou shalt be old, thou wilt extend thy hands, and another will gird thy loins for thee, and will conduct thee whither thou wouldst not.

john 21:19.english: And this he said, to show by what death he was to glorify God. And having said these things, he said to him: Follow me.

john 21:20.english: And Simon turned himself, and saw coming after him, that disciple whom Jesus loved, who fell on the breast of Jesus at the supper, and said, My Lord, who is it will betray thee?

john 21:21.english: Him Cephas saw, and said to Jesus: My Lord, as for this man, what?

john 21:22.english: Jesus said to him: If I will, that he abide here until I come, what is that to thee? Follow thou me.

john 21:23.english: And this saying went forth among the brethren, that this disciple would not die. Yet Jesus did not say, that he would not die; but, If I will that he abide here until I come, what is that to thee.

john 21:24.english: This is the disciple who hath testified of all these things, and hath written them: and we know, that his testimony is true.

john 21:25.english: And there are also many other things, which Jesus did; which, if written out with particularity, the world itself, as I suppose, would not suffice for the books that would be written. Completion of the Holy Gospel, the announcement of John the Evangelist; which he uttered, in Greek, at Ephesus.
